assets.title: Vase between two female chimeras
assets.description: An upright engraved panel. A lidded fluted vase with a bearded mask on its bowl stands at the centre on a pair of scaly serpent coils; a female chimera stands at either side, with a woman's head and torso, a scaled lower body curling into a serpent tail and lion-pawed feet, each gripping the vase rim. From the vase rise acanthus leaves and thin stems that curl symmetrically into two large tulip-like flowers, two round blossoms and small leaf tendrils up to a central finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall upright panel (about 1 to 2); the chimeras and the vase form its base, so place it standing, not rotated.

assets.title: Bearded mask with eagle, cornucopias and fauns
assets.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with a furrowed brow stares out from the centre under a pine-cone finial on a stand; two fruit-filled cornucopias hung with ribbons flank it, and a parrot-like bird perches on a scroll in each upper corner. At the lower sides two horned fauns with scaled fish tails face inward, holding a cloth that drapes behind an eagle with spread wings and talons at the bottom centre. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

assets.title: Grotesque with mask, goat heads and children
assets.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with an open mouth fills the centre; above it a small bearded man sits astride its crest and stretches a cloth to two horned goat heads in the upper corners, while a booted man in a jerkin perches on a cornucopia at either side. Below, a nude child rides a woman's bust at the left and another stands on a bearded satyr's head at the right; a lion mask with a draped cloth and a small lower mask among acanthus leaves close the bottom. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

assets.title: Branching leaf scroll with bell flower
assets.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. From a leafy base at the bottom centre a straight stem rises to a bell-shaped flower on a ringed collar, and symmetrical stems branch to either side, curling into volutes dressed with broad lobed leaves and drooping buds. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece; the central flower marks the axis.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1912.85

assets.title: Putto gripping a wide leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude putto crouches at the centre with its head turned to the left, gripping the stems that run through both hands, while a small bell flower rises above its head; broad lobed leaves on thin curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with a small bud at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The scroll is cut by the plate edge at both ends; it suits a headpiece or a band but will not tile.

assets.title: Candelabrum with female-headed beasts and lizards
assets.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque. A hairy mask at the top holds ribbons and stems in its mouth; below it two feline-bodied beasts with raised tails stand back to back, their long necks ending in two women's heads at the sides, and a blank tablet hangs between them above a palmette. Two flaming bowls stand on fluted brackets at the sides, and two lizard-like beasts grip the stems at the bottom around a cup with ears of grain. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The blank tablet in the middle can carry a short caption.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O2013.2

assets.title: Candelabrum with fish and roses
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate candelabrum. A thin central shaft rises through tiers of acanthus leaves and volutes; two fish-tailed dolphins with open jaws face each other across the middle, two more look outward at the base, and round roses sit in the volutes near the top under a small finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Fluted vase with trumpet horns and leaf scroll
assets.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. A gadrooned vase at the bottom centre sends up a straight stem with layered acanthus leaves, and two flared trumpet-shaped horns lean outward above it; broad curled leaves, hanging bell flowers and pea-pod-like buds spread symmetrically to both sides, with a bell flower cut off at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece with the vase as its base.

assets.title: Leafy shaft with bearded mask and lion mask
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. From a hairy bearded mask at the base, flanked by two pod-like gourds on curled stems that end in lion paws, a central shaft rises through a lion mask set in a shield-shaped cartouche, two roses, a ribbon and a bearded mask with wild hair, up to a leafy calyx with two volute horns, beads and hanging buds at the top; thin acanthus stems curl outward along the whole height. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Leafy stems on a hairy base
assets.description: A narrow upright strip cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. Grass-like stalks with small lobed leaves and buds rise from a rounded tuft of hair-like hatching at the bottom; the left side is a straight cut where the couple stood in the print. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the tall grotesque; the straight left edge is where it abutted the couple, so place something against that side or keep it at the right of a composition.

assets.title: Nude couple standing
assets.description: A nude man and woman stand side by side, cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. The woman at the left faces the viewer with her head turned toward the man, her braided hair streaming out to the left, a girdle at her hips and a small rod held upright in her right hand; the man at the right stands in profile facing left, one arm around her shoulders and his open hand under hers. Fine black engraved hatching with cream paper-toned skin on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the leafy stems and the tall grotesque; the figures touch at shoulder, hands and feet and must stay together.

assets.title: Two horns with vine-leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. Two short horns rise from a central pair of volutes and are tied together by a bow at the top, with an upright vine leaf between them; broad lobed leaves on curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with volutes along the base and a curled leaf at each outer corner. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete at both ends; reads as a headpiece or a band.

assets.title: Tendril panel with AG monogram
assets.description: A horizontal opaque engraved panel on a dark cross-hatched ground. A stem rises from a small block bearing the AG monogram at the bottom centre to a bud at the top, and two leafy tendrils curl outward from it into large volutes at either end, with lobed leaves filling the corners. Cream leaves on a black hatched ground; only the margin outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground; place it as a plate, not as a cut-out.
The AG monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Seated putto holding a leaf scroll
assets.description: An upright foliate ornament. A nude putto sits at the bottom centre facing the viewer, holding an upright stem in one hand and a curling stem in the other; from these a tall acanthus scroll branches upward and sideways with broad curled leaves, tulip-like buds and a trumpet flower, filling a roughly rectangular field. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The putto is the base of the composition; keep it upright.

assets.title: Dagger sheath with soldier's head
assets.description: A tall tapering ornament designed for a dagger sheath. At the top a helmeted soldier's head in profile faces left inside a wreath of leaves and buds; below it a stem runs down the centre through curled acanthus leaves, a volute and rows of pod-like fruits hanging from short stems, narrowing to a point at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall and narrow (about 1 to 4.5); it suits a page margin or a vertical rule, head at the top.

assets.title: Candelabrum with sphinxes and cornucopias
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum grotesque. Two winged sphinxes with women's heads sit back to back at the base, their wings rising into volutes; above them two fruit-filled cornucopias cross under a knotted ribbon, two roses sit in the scrolls, a bearded mask with leafy hair faces out from the upper middle between two butterflies, and two large flowers hang from the volutes under a small vase finial, all joined by thin acanthus stems and strings of beads. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 2.8); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Grotesque with winged woman and lion heads
assets.description: A tall narrow foliate grotesque cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. A woman's bust with curled ram's horns and leafy wings faces the viewer at the top under two hanging bell flowers; below her a layered acanthus calyx carries two lion-like heads in profile facing inward, a frowning cat-like mask stares out from the centre, and curled leaves descend to a scalloped cup terminal at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.2); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.
Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the leafy stems.

assets.title: Leafy shaft with two masks and dolphins
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. Under a leafy crown at the top two bearded grotesque masks in profile face outward; below them two dolphin-like creatures with open jaws curl away from the shaft, two small roses sit on the stems, a fluted collar holds hanging pear-shaped pods, and tiers of broad acanthus leaves, volutes and pea pods descend to a leafy base. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.4); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Two putti in a vine-leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude boy stands at the far left facing right, one hand on his hip and the other raised to a stem; a second nude boy stands near the centre facing right, grasping a stem above his head and stretching his other arm along the scroll; thin curling stems with broad lobed vine leaves fill the rest of the panel to the right edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads left to right as a headpiece or a band; the figures anchor the left half.

assets.title: Two putti under a tall leaf scroll
assets.description: A tall narrow foliate panel. Two putti sit at the bottom, one in a short tunic facing right behind a nude one facing the viewer, both holding stems; above them a dense scroll of thin stems with lobed leaves, buds and pod-like fruits fills the whole height. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.3); it suits a page margin at a small size.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.751

assets.title: Candelabrum with two pairs of satyrs
assets.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque in two tiers. At the top two satyrs seated on scrolls, a long-haired one at the left and a goat-horned bearded one at the right, raise a tiered fluted vase of foliage with a small lizard among its leaves; a palmette separates the tiers. Below, a female satyr with a plumed headdress at the left and a bearded male at the right sit facing a horned goat skull at the centre, each holding a curved horn; all four have goat legs and hooves. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Upright piece (about 1 to 2); the two tiers can be cropped apart at the palmette if a shorter piece is needed.

assets.title: Urn candelabrum with three tiers of flowers
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum. From a gadrooned urn at the bottom a central shaft rises through three tiers of paired volutes, each holding a large round flower, past a shouting mask in the lower middle and a blank tablet in the upper middle, to a cup with ears of grain at the top; thin acanthus stems with small leaves and beads fill the sides. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The blank tablet in the upper middle can carry a short caption.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.754

assets.title: Penwork acanthus tailpiece
assets.description: An upright spray in black penwork rising from a short cut stem at the bottom, a tall curling acanthus leaf in the centre with finely hatched lobes, two large acanthus leaves curling down and outward to the left and right, a small ivy leaf and a thin tendril at the upper right, a tendril at the upper left and a hanging flower bud below the stem, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place centred below the last paragraph of a chapter or section; pairs with songbirds-headpiece at the head of the text.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Clasped book among ivy
assets.description: A closed book seen from above in three-quarter view, in black penwork, with its spine of raised bands at the left, two strap clasps on the right edge of the hatched front cover, a bevelled cover border with corner bosses, visible page edges and a ribbon bookmark hanging out of the fore-edge at the bottom, surrounded on both sides and below by an ivy vine of pointed leaves and curled tendrils, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete vignette; keep the book and its ivy together and keep the proportions.
Open line art; the cover and page interiors are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Gold cinquefoil divider, centre
assets.description: A painted five-petalled flower in textured gold with dark brown contours, pale cream highlights along the petal veins and a dark brown centre, with a short gold stem ending in a round knob on each side, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the knobbed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

assets.title: Gold ivy-leaf divider terminal
assets.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a three-lobed ivy leaf pointing left with a smaller lobe curling up and one curling down behind it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

assets.title: Gold lozenge divider, centre
assets.description: A painted lozenge-shaped fleuron in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a tall pointed leaf above and below and a curled leaf to the left and right around a small dark brown centre, with a straight gold stem ending in a pointed tip on each side, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the pointed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

assets.title: Gold acanthus divider terminal
assets.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a pointed acanthus leaf pointing left with a scroll curling up above it and one curling down below it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

assets.title: Ivy corner, bottom-left
assets.description: A bottom-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, bottom-right
assets.description: A bottom-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, top-left
assets.description: A top-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and along the horizontal one, pointed three-lobed ivy leaves with veined interiors, small curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, top-right
assets.description: A top-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a large curled acanthus leaf, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and a shorter run of tendrils along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the top-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy fleuron
assets.description: A compact symmetric fleuron in black penwork, three pointed three-lobed ivy leaves on short stems that join at a single stalk below, the middle leaf upright and the outer two turned outward, with a heavy outer contour and fine veins inside, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Small standalone mark for a section break or a line end; the stalk at the bottom is where it meets a rule or baseline.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy and flower divider
assets.description: A long horizontal divider in black penwork, a waving stem carrying pointed ivy leaves, three five-petalled flowers with hatched petals, two curling hatched acanthus leaves and small spiral tendrils, ending in an ivy leaf at the left and an ivy leaf with a tendril at the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete flourish with two different finished ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 6:1 piece; it sits as a section break or beneath a heading.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves and petals are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy line filler
assets.description: A slender horizontal line filler in black penwork, a gently waving stem with four pointed ivy leaves on short stalks, a five-petalled flower at the centre, small curled tendrils above and below the stem and a small lozenge terminal at each end, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete piece with finished lozenge ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Thin and about 6:1; it sits between paragraphs or fills the end of a short line.

assets.title: Ruled ivy frame
assets.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame in black penwork, a thin double rule on all four sides with an ivy vine of pointed three-lobed leaves and curled tendrils running along the outside of the rules, curled acanthus leaves and small finials at the four corners and a small ivy spray at the middle of the top and bottom rules, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame with a transparent centre; scale it proportionally as one image, its sides are not repeat tiles and it is not a border-image atlas.
Same double rule and ivy as the four separate ivy corners, which serve the same kit on pages of another proportion.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy margin vine
assets.description: A tall narrow vertical vine in black penwork, a sinuous stem with alternating pointed ivy leaves and curled, hatched acanthus leaves to either side, small spiral tendrils along its length, a pointed ivy leaf as the top terminal and a curled leaf as the bottom terminal, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament about 1:4; keep it upright and use it whole, it has no rule and no repeat unit.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Songbirds headpiece
assets.description: A wide symmetric headpiece in black penwork, two long-tailed songbirds perched on a branching stem and facing each other across a central upright ivy leaf, with solid black ivy leaves, curled tendrils and small berry clusters spreading to both sides, the birds and leaves drawn with transparent hatching, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place above a title or at the head of a chapter; do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 3:1 piece; pairs with acanthus-tailpiece at the end of the text.
Heavier than the other penwork pieces, with solid black leaves; it holds up on darker grounds better than the open line art.

assets.title: Candelabrum carried by two blindfolded women
assets.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical engraved candelabrum. At the top a winged putto stands on a leafy cushion with both arms raised, gripping the curled tips of two acanthus volutes. Below him a lobed cup, a gadrooned bowl and a baluster stem with a second small bowl, each stage flanked by mirrored acanthus scrolls and leaf sprays. At the base two nude blindfolded women kneel back to back with spiral volutes in place of arms and carry the shaft on their heads. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical ornament about six times taller than wide; it reads as a column or a page edge, not as a divider.
The date and monogram panel that sits below the two women in the print is not included.

assets.title: Frieze of four centaurs with riders
assets.description: A horizontal engraved frieze of four centaurs, two on each side, rearing toward the centre. The two inner centaurs, bearded and leaf-crowned, each carry a young rider and together grip a leafy spray that rises from a small bowl at the bottom centre; the two outer centaurs carry nude women who hold long feathery fronds arching over the ends. Trefoil sprigs and a low band of acanthus scrolls run between the hooves. Black ink line work on cream paper, no rules, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete band about three times wider than tall; the fronds at both ends are its natural terminals, so no cropping is needed.

assets.title: Double cup with two putti
assets.description: A tall, symmetrical engraved double cup. A round foot and knopped stem carry a bulbous lower bowl, a wide band decorated with masks, lozenges and strapwork, and an inverted upper bowl topped by a small cup; thin leafy tendrils with two small birds rise from the sides and tasselled pendants hang at the left and right. At the base two winged putti sit on either side of the stem, each resting a hand on a blank strapwork cartouche. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The two cartouches at the base are blank and small; the piece is a goldsmith's design, not a frame for text.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1919.19

assets.title: Coat of arms with horned helmet
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a diagonal band charged with three small shields. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a crest of two tall curved horns with trumpet-shaped ends. Leafy mantling hangs from knotted ties on each side of the helmet and curls down around the shield in scalloped acanthus fronds. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The shield is tilted and the helmet faces right; mirror the whole piece for a left-facing use.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1915.1

assets.title: Bearded mask in a leaf scroll
assets.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel centred on a large frontal mask of a bearded man with an open mouth, small curled horns at the temples and a ribbed cap bound with a leaf garland; his beard flows down into leaf fronds. From the cap two long swags of overlapping leaves fall to either side, and thin stems with acanthus volutes, lobed leaves and small buds fill both halves. Halfway down each side a leafy beaked head bites a stem. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete symmetrical panel; the mask reads from a distance, so it works as a headpiece above a title.

assets.title: Coat of arms with rampant lion and feather crest
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a rampant lion with a curled tail, facing left. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a tall crest of two fans of feathers rising from a twisted wreath. Plain cloth mantling with scalloped edges hangs in long folds on both sides of the helmet and tucks behind the shield. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The lion faces left and the helmet right, so the piece has no single direction; mirroring it changes the lion's heraldic side.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1906.118

assets.title: Palmette between two dolphin heads
assets.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel. A large palmette fan rises from a small pedestal with two volutes at the bottom centre; below it two scaly dolphin heads with open toothed jaws face each other. To each side thin stems curl into acanthus volutes with lobed leaves, a trumpet-shaped horn, a round berry, a bud and a small flower head, ending in upright leaf clusters at the outer edges. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete band; crop inside the outer leaf clusters when their cut edges would show against a plain ground.

assets.title: Coat of arms with rooster and banderoles
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A rounded shield bears a strutting rooster facing left on a stippled ground. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the left carries a coronet on which a crowned rooster stands between two curved horns, also facing left. Leafy acanthus mantling curls down both sides of the shield, and long blank banderoles loop above and beside the helmet. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The banderoles are blank and narrow; they are decoration, not a text field.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg JB1891.590

assets.title: Square goldsmith's ornament with a central medallion
assets.description: A square, four-fold symmetrical ornament engraved as solid black shapes. A central medallion holds a rosette among fine leaf scrolls; a broad ring of dense black scrollwork encloses it, drawn out into a pointed lobe on each side, inside a thin ruled square whose spandrels hold four small animals, a long-tailed quadruped and three birds. Outside the square the ornament spreads as open scrollwork with large black flowers, tulip-shaped buds and rows of round berries, ending in sprays at the corners. Black ink on a transparent background; a faint film of paper tone remains over the square.
usage_notes: Near-square and symmetrical; it reads as a tailpiece, a tile centrepiece or a backing medallion.
The central medallion and the ruled inner square each crop out as a complete smaller ornament.
Black ink on light grounds only; on a dark page the ornament disappears and only the faint paper film shows.

assets.title: Acanthus scroll border with vase and horn-blowing satyr
assets.description: Complete lower border of the recto. A grey acanthus scroll with gold-edged leaves runs the full width, curling at the left into a spiral that holds a red five-petalled flower. At the centre a copper-orange vase with a blue mouth sits on green acanthus leaves, with red and blue leaf tips on either side. At the right end a horned, bearded, goat-legged satyr with a brown body sits facing left and blows a long curved blue horn with red dots along its rim. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete lower border about 3.3:1; the satyr sits at the right end, so keep the whole width or crop from the left spiral.
The vertical grapevine border and the thin leaf spindle come from the same page and frame text together with it.

assets.title: Red and blue bud on a leafy stem, pointing left
assets.description: A closed bud pointing left: two red petals with cream streaks and dots lie over a deep blue outer petal striped in white. The green stem curves off to the right and carries two broad green leaves with yellow veins, one above and one below. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Blue curled flower with red lobes
assets.description: A large blue flower at the upper left, its striped petals curling inward and one petal spiralling down to the left, with a brown and pale blue bract behind it, sits on a cluster of four rounded red lobes with cream striping. From the lower right a green stem carries two broad green leaves with pale veins and dark outlines, one pointing up and one down-left. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe at the edges; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: From the left border of the recto; the flower head leans left, so it sits naturally at the left of a block of text.

assets.title: Blue folded flower on a tall stem
assets.description: A deep blue flower with three folded, pale-striped petals and a long lower petal that curls down to the left, rising from a small green calyx of rounded sepals. A tall, slender green stem runs straight down with one pointed leaf on the right at mid height and one on the left near the foot, both with pale veins and dark outlines. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe at the edges; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:2.9); suits a side margin.

assets.title: Blue and rose flower on an upright stem
assets.description: An upright flower whose pointed blue outer petal rises to the upper left over three dusky rose inner petals, set in a scalloped green calyx. The straight green stem below carries two green leaves with yellow veins and gold flecks along its length. Transparent background.

assets.title: Stylised flower with blue scrolls and a gray cap
assets.description: A symmetrical fanciful flower without a stem: a gray domed knob striped in white sits on a green and yellow ringed disk over a red lobed body hatched in white, and six blue curled scrolls with white hatching fan out around the rim. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Blue and rose flower on a tall stem with three leaves
assets.description: A tall upright flower: a folded gray petal rises from blue petals above three rounded dusky rose lobes. The thin green stem drops straight down, with two long green leaves rising on either side from its middle and a third shorter leaf at the lower right. Transparent background.

assets.title: Green leaf spray on a curving stem
assets.description: A spray of broad lobed green leaves with yellow veins and black outlines on a thin stem that runs from the left down to the lower right: a large cluster at the top, a smaller one at the lower left and a curled cluster at the right end. No flowers. Transparent background.

assets.title: Broad red flower with a blue and gray crown
assets.description: A wide red flower seen from the front, a scalloped red cup with white and gold striping, topped by four round blue petals and a gray pointed petal curling up from the centre, above a fan of about nine finger-like red lobes with gold striping that spread out and curl at the tips. No stem or leaves; dark outlines. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: The centrepiece of the bottom border of the verso; symmetrical, so it sits centred under a block of text.

assets.title: Brown fan flower with strawberry on a leafy stem
assets.description: A brown fan-shaped flower with fluted petals and a green calyx sits at the top of a long green stem. Three large green leaves with dark outlines and pale vein strokes grow from the stem, two rising on either side and one hanging to the right. At the foot the stem curls into a loop that ends in a green bud cluster and a small red strawberry-like fruit with crosshatched seeds. Tall piece on a transparent background.

assets.title: Round purplish-brown bud on a straight leafy stem
assets.description: A round purplish-brown bud or seed head with pale yellow-green rings and a small knob at the top sits on a long, straight green stem. Two green leaves with pale vein strokes grow out at mid height, one to each side, and a third leaf hangs to the lower left near the foot. Tall narrow piece on a transparent background.

assets.title: Cook with a ladle and dish beside a cauldron
assets.description: A cook in a red hood and belted white tunic, gray hose and black shoes bends to the right, holding up a blue ladle in one hand and a blue dish in the other; in front stands a brown three-legged cauldron with gold highlights. Figure and cauldron rest on a small patch of tan ground. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Pairs with girl-kneading-bread-at-table-with-basket, the kitchen figure on the recto of the same leaf, at about the same scale.

assets.title: Couple sharing a goblet in a bathtub
assets.description: A woman in a white head-cloth and gold necklace at the left and a man with curly golden hair at the right sit facing each other, nude to the waist, in a round brown wooden tub bound with gold hoops; between them they hold a dark blue-gray goblet. The tub's staves rise higher behind them and the water inside is pale blue. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The middle vignette of three-couples-in-garden-under-painted-arcade; in the scene the jug gray-metal-water-jug-with-small-foot stands on the ground in front of the tub.

assets.title: Two blue leaves on a crossed stem, horizontal
assets.description: Two broad deep blue leaves with pale edges and white veining lie end to end, their tips pointing left and right, joined at a short gray-blue stem that crosses in the middle and ends in a stub below. Gold flecks edge the leaves. Transparent background.

assets.title: Two slate-blue leaves on crossed stems, upright
assets.description: Two long slate gray-blue leaves with white hatched veins and brown edges, one rising to the upper left and one hanging to the lower right, on two thin stems that cross between them. Transparent background.

assets.title: Two green leaves on crossed stems, upright
assets.description: Two green leaves with yellow hatched veins and dark midribs, one pointing up and one hanging down, on two stems that cross between them; the lower stem ends in a stub to the left and the upper one in a short gold-flecked stub to the right. Transparent background.

assets.title: Crossed pair of horizontal leaves
assets.description: Two long pointed green leaves lie left and right, joined at the middle where their short stems cross and curl outward up and down. Each leaf is two-toned, teal green with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black band on the other, with a black outline. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The centre of the top border of the verso, flanked by horizontal-red-and-blue-bud-with-two-leaves (pointing left) and hanging-red-bud-on-long-horizontal-stem (pointing right); the three make a symmetrical header.
The same motif stands upright as upright-crossed-green-leaf-pair and crossed-upright-green-leaf-pair.

assets.title: Two blue leaves on crossed stems, upright
assets.description: Two blue leaves with pale gray edges and dark midribs, one pointing up and one hanging down, on two pale stems that cross between them, the upper stem ending in a short stub to the left. Transparent background.

assets.title: Two gray-green leaves on crossed stems, upright
assets.description: Two long gray-green leaves with white hatched veins, brown midribs and gold-flecked edges, one pointing up and one hanging down, on two pale stems that cross between them. Transparent background.

assets.title: Crossed pair of upright leaves, recto
assets.description: Two long pointed green leaves, one rising and one hanging, joined at the middle where their two short stems cross and curl outward to the left and right. Each leaf is two-toned, pale green on one side of the midrib and dark green on the other, with cream hatching and a black outline. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The same leaf-pair motif is painted again on the verso as upright-crossed-green-leaf-pair (vertical) and crossed-horizontal-green-leaf-pair (horizontal); this one is the raggedest of the three.

assets.title: Gray cat crouching with a mouse
assets.description: A dark gray cat crouches low on a patch of green grass, its body stretched to the right and its head turned toward the viewer with round gold eyes and pricked ears; its long, faintly banded tail curls back along the left. A dark mouse hangs from its mouth, the thin black tail trailing on the grass. The fur is painted in fine pale strokes; the grass patch is streaked green with gold speckling and is cut flat along the bottom. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide and low (about 2.6:1); reads well as a bottom-margin piece, which is where it sits on the leaf.

assets.title: Thin red and grey leaf spindle with blue bud
assets.description: A very long, thin horizontal ornament. At the centre a round blue bud is held between two petal collars, red on the left and grey on the right. From the collars two tapering leaves stretch outward to a point, a grey one to the left and a red one to the right, each with a fine gold edge line and a curled tip. Transparent background.
usage_notes: About 11:1; works as a rule between blocks of text at any width, the bud marking the centre.
From the same page as the acanthus scroll border and the grapevine border.

assets.title: Embracing nude couple, one fist raised
assets.description: Two nude figures with curly red-gold hair embrace standing. A man at the left, seen from behind, cups the back of the woman's head with his right hand; the woman at the right faces him, her left arm raised high with a clenched fist and her other hand on his shoulder. Pale pink flesh with brown outlines and bluish shadows; the feet rest on the ground line of the scene and are cut flat there. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The right-hand vignette of three-couples-in-garden-under-painted-arcade; give it a ground line, since the soles are cut flat.

assets.title: Rose-brown flower seen from behind on a leafy stem
assets.description: A flower turned away from the viewer: four rounded dusky rose-brown petals with faint gold veining are overlaid by a green five-pointed calyx. A long green stem curves down from it and carries two broad green leaves with yellow hatching near the bottom. Transparent background.

assets.title: Young woman kneading dough at a table
assets.description: A young woman in a white dress with a black-trimmed bodice, her hair in a brown net, stands at a brown wooden table facing left; her raised right hand swings a wooden paddle while her left presses a pale mound of dough. A wooden pail with gold hoops stands under the table. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Pairs with cook-with-ladle-dish-and-soup-cauldron, the kitchen figure on the verso of the same leaf, at about the same scale.

assets.title: Gold leaf scroll fragment from an initial
assets.description: A small gold foliate scroll taken from inside a decorated initial: a C-shaped curl at the left joins a lobed leaf at the right. The gold is speckled with gaps where it has flaked, and the ends are cut where they met the letter, which is not included. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gold curling vine from an initial
assets.description: A gold foliate vine taken from inside a decorated initial: a central stem rises and splits into curling tendrils ending in spirals, with a trefoil of round leaves at the top, a small spiral at the left and a hooked leaf at the right. The gold is textured and flecked with brown where it has worn; the letter is not included. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gold curling vine from a round initial
assets.description: A gold foliate vine taken from inside a round decorated initial: a central stem rises to three curled buds, two spiral tendrils curl at the lower left, and a long stroke with a hooked tip runs up the right side. The gold is speckled and gappy where it has flaked; the letter is not included. Transparent background.

assets.title: Tiny gold pointed leaf
assets.description: A single tiny gold leaf, pointed at the top and notched on the right side, speckled where the gold has worn, taken from inside a decorated initial. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gold five-petal flower fragment
assets.description: Five separate gold blobs arranged in a ring, the petals of a small flower whose centre has flaked away, with a faint scrap of gold below, taken from inside a decorated initial. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gold cross-hatched fruit on a leafy stem
assets.description: A round pale gold fruit, cross-hatched in a diamond pattern and splitting open in a dark red slit at its lower right, hangs below three rounded pale green sepals. Above it a thin dark stem rises with two pairs of pointed green leaves, pale-veined with black outlines. The gold paint is worn, with cream parchment showing through, and a gold-ground fringe follows the edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:3); the fruit alone crops to a near-square ornament.

assets.title: Gold three-lobed leaf fragment
assets.description: A small gold leaf with three lobes running diagonally from the upper left to the lower right, with a few detached flakes beside it, taken from inside a decorated initial. Transparent background.

assets.title: Grapevine border with crane pecking at grapes
assets.description: Complete vertical border of the recto. A grapevine fills the upper half with lobed green leaves, curling tendrils and four bunches of green grapes. Below it a grey long-necked bird with raised wings stands on a vine stem and reaches up to peck at the lowest bunch. Under the bird a large blue six-pointed flower, and at the foot a cluster of red, grey and blue acanthus leaves with gold edges. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall piece about 1:4.7; the vine, the bird and the flower are stacked, so it can be cropped between them to a shorter margin ornament.
From the same page as the acanthus scroll border and the thin leaf spindle.

assets.title: Gray flower with a red petal on an acanthus leaf spray
assets.description: A gray-blue five-petalled flower with a curled red petal at its centre sits at the upper right of a large deep green lobed leaf with yellow veins. A thin green stem runs out to the lower left and a small red bud with green sepals hangs at the lower right. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Gray and red bud on a horizontal stem, pointing right
assets.description: A large bud pointing right: a folded gray petal shaded in white lies over a dark red petal with yellow streaks, held in green sepals. The green stem runs left and carries two green leaves with yellow veins, one above and one below, with gold flecks along it. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gray metal jug
assets.description: A small blue-gray metal jug seen from the front, with a round belly with a dotted band and a dark arc, a short cylindrical neck topped by a flat round rim with a spiral, a small loop handle at the left and a short spout at the right, standing on a flat base with a sliver of the blue-gray puddle it sits in. Black outlines, soft edges. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto, where it stands in front of the bathtub; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: A prop of three-couples-in-garden-under-painted-arcade; it belongs at the foot of couple-sharing-goblet-in-wooden-bathtub.
Tiny; keep it near native size.

assets.title: Red bud pointing right on a long stem
assets.description: A red bud with gold and white striping points to the right, held in a rounded green calyx with pale striping and two small green bracts. A long green stem runs straight to the left from the bud and carries two rounded green leaves near its left end, one above and one below, pale-veined with black outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The right-hand piece of the top border of the verso; its mirror partner is horizontal-red-and-blue-bud-with-two-leaves, with crossed-horizontal-green-leaf-pair between them.

assets.title: Brown fan flower on a long horizontal stem
assets.description: A very long, thin horizontal sprig. At the left end a small brown fan-shaped flower with a green calyx points left; from it a thin green stem runs the full width to the right, with two long, narrow, undulating green leaves lying along it, one lighter and one darker. Transparent background.
usage_notes: About 8:1; lies well under a line of text or as a rule, with the flower marking the left end.

assets.title: Open pea pod on a leafy stem, pointing right
assets.description: An open green pea pod pointing right shows five round peas inside; its stem curves back to the left and carries two broad green leaves with yellow hatching, one above and one below. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Red and blue bud pointing left on a long stem
assets.description: A round red bud with pale striping and a deep blue lower lobe points to the left, held in a spray of pointed green sepals. A long green stem runs straight to the right and carries two rounded green leaves near its right end, one above and one below, pale-veined with black outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The left-hand piece of the top border of the verso; its mirror partner is hanging-red-bud-on-long-horizontal-stem, with crossed-horizontal-green-leaf-pair between them.

assets.title: Large blue flower with drooping petals on a tall stem
assets.description: A large deep blue flower stands upright at the top; three rounded petals with gold anthers rise at the back, and the outer petals fold over and droop down on either side, with pale blue highlights and black outlines. It sits on a green calyx above a long straight stem, from whose foot two long narrow green leaves sweep upward on either side, teal and dark green with cream hatching. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Very tall (about 1:3.1), the right-border piece of the verso; suits a side margin.

assets.title: Red carnation with a bud on a branching stem
assets.description: A large red carnation with fringed, gold-streaked petals at the right and a smaller carnation bud with dark red fringed petals in a green calyx at the lower centre, both on a green stem that arcs in from the lower left and carries about seven small green leaves. Transparent background.

assets.title: Red tulip-like flower with blue calyx and side bud
assets.description: A tall red flower of pointed, finely striped petals, closed like a tulip with a small green tip, rises from a scalloped deep blue calyx with pale striping. A long green stem descends, with a smaller red bud on a side shoot to the right and two large lobed green leaves, one at the upper left and one at the lower right, teal with cream hatching and dark green edges. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Very tall (about 1:2.5), the top-right corner piece of the verso; suits a side margin.

assets.title: Two crossed green leaves on a short twig
assets.description: Two long green leaves with gold-edged margins and pale vein strokes cross at a short stem, the upper one pointing up to the right and the lower one hanging down to the left with a curled tip. A short twig with a gold tip sticks out to the left at the crossing. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The middle of three sprigs stacked in one margin of the recto, between the red flower and the oval bud.
The verso carries the same leaf-pair motif as upright-paired-green-leaves.

assets.title: Two pale yellow flowers on a leafy branch
assets.description: Two pale yellow five-petalled flowers with orange centres, seen from the front, sit at the left on thin green stems, one above the other. The stems join a branch at the right that carries two large curling green leaves, one sweeping up and one down, teal with cream hatching on one side and dark green on the other, with dark outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The bottom-left corner piece of the verso; the flowers point left and the leaves right, so it reads as an opening ornament.

assets.title: Pale yellow fan carnation on a curved stem, pointing right
assets.description: A pale yellow-ochre carnation opens as a pleated fan to the right from pointed green sepals; its green stem curves in from the left with gold flecks along it and carries two long green leaves, one curling upward and one hanging below. Transparent background.

assets.title: Yellow daisy with red centre on a leafy stem
assets.description: A pale yellow daisy with many rounded petals and a red centre dotted with yellow is seen from the front at the left. Its green stem runs to the right and ends in a curl, carrying three lobed, serrated green leaves with pale vein strokes, two above the stem and one below. Wide horizontal piece on a transparent background.
usage_notes: About 2:1 with the flower at the left end; the curled stem at the right can be cropped without losing the flower.

assets.title: Yellow five-petalled flower with looping stem
assets.description: A yellow flower with five broad petals outlined in orange and a green knobbed centre sits at the top left. Its green stem loops up over the flower and runs down to the right, carrying three tiers of paired green leaves with dark outlines and pale vein strokes. Tall piece on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The stem reaches the right edge of the master at the top of its loop, so leave a small margin on that side.

assets.title: Peasant carrying a large wicker basket
assets.description: A bearded man in a gray tunic with gold edging, a gray cap, blue hose and black shoes walks to the left, bent forward under a tall rectangular wicker basket strapped to his back. He leans on a brown staff in his right hand and holds a second brown rod level in his left. He walks on a patch of green grass, cut flat below. Opaque gouache with dark outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The bottom-right corner figure of the verso; he walks left, so place him at the right of a line or block so he moves into it.

assets.title: Blue and red flower with a pointed tip on a tall stem
assets.description: An upright flower: a green pointed tip rises above blue pointed petals streaked in white, which emerge from a red fringed corolla hatched in cream. The long green stem below carries two leaves with yellow hatching halfway down. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Red bud in gray sepals on a horizontal stem, pointing right
assets.description: A pointed red bud streaked in yellow points right, held in folded gray-blue sepals; the green stem runs left with gold flecks along it and carries two green leaves with yellow veins, one above and one below. Transparent background.

assets.title: Round red flower with a blue cap
assets.description: A round red flower with a pale striped central lobe and a dotted deep blue cap stands upright on a straight green stem; two rounded green leaves spread left and right at mid height, teal with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black outline on the other. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:2.5); suits a side margin.

assets.title: Red and blue bud on an upright stem
assets.description: An upright closed bud: a crimson petal streaked in white stands in front of a deep blue outer petal, rising from green sepals on a long green stem that curves to the lower right, with two green leaves near the base. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Red four-petalled flower on a curved stem
assets.description: A large red flower seen from the front at the right, with four broad notched petals edged in dark red, each with gold striping, around a pale pink centre. From the left a long green stem curves in, carrying two broad leaves that curl up at the left and down at the lower right, pale green on one side of the midrib and dark on the other, with cream hatching and a black outline. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The flower head alone crops to a near-square rosette; the stem and leaves make it a corner piece that fills the lower right of the leaf.

assets.title: Red bowl flower with gray inner petals on a leaf spray
assets.description: At the top a red bowl-shaped flower with cream striping, a gray-blue folded inner petal and a brown curling bract behind it, sits on a green and cream collar. Below, a thin stem runs down with three large green leaves, pale-veined with black outlines, and a small gray-tipped green bud on a side shoot at the right. Opaque gouache with a gold-ground fringe; the brown bract at the top left and the leaf at the right are clipped by the page edge. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: The top-left corner piece of the recto border; tall (about 1:2.2), best against a left margin where the clipped left edge is hidden.

assets.title: Red carnation with two long leaves
assets.description: A red carnation with five fringed, scalloped petals marked by pale radiating lines fills the right half, seen from the front. Its green stem curves down to the left and carries two long, narrow green leaves with pale vein strokes, one rising up and one lying along the bottom, meeting at a short stalk at the lower left. Wide horizontal piece on a transparent background.
usage_notes: About 2.2:1 with the flower at the right end; the leaves at the left can be cropped without losing the flower.

assets.title: Red umbrella-shaped flower on a tall stem
assets.description: A red flower shaped like a bell or umbrella, with gold streaks down its skirt and a small gold tuft at the top, hangs over a green calyx of pointed sepals. A tall straight green stem runs down with two rounded green leaves, one at the right and one lower at the left, teal with cream hatching and dark green edges. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:2.8); suits a side margin.

assets.title: Rose bud with a blue tip on a curved stem
assets.description: A rounded rose-pink bud with a small deep blue pointed petal at its upper left sits in two green sepals at the top. A green stem curves down to the right and back, carrying two pairs of rounded green leaves, pale green with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black outline on the other. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:2.4); suits a side margin.

assets.title: Layered rose, blue and brown flower
assets.description: A wide fantastical flower built in layers, a rose-pink striped base petal, two deep blue petals scrolling outward into spirals at either side, a tall brown and gold folded petal in the centre and two spiky red and gold petals flanking it. Three rounded pale green sepals sit below, and a short dark stem carries two pointed green leaves, pale-veined, spreading left and right. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The centrepiece of the bottom border of the recto; near-square and symmetrical enough to sit centred under a block of text.

assets.title: Crimson fan flower on a long budding stem
assets.description: A crimson fan-shaped flower with fine striping opens at the top, held in small green sepals. A long green stem descends and branches, carrying four pairs of rounded green leaves with pale veins, a small red bud with a blue petal on a side shoot at the right about a third of the way down, and a blue and rose bud hanging at the very bottom. Opaque gouache; the thin stems have small gaps and a gold-ground fringe. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Very tall (about 1:2.5), the left-border piece of the recto; the fan flower with the first leaf pair crops to a compact sprig.

assets.title: Seated embracing couple
assets.description: A woman in a blue gown with gold edging and a red hat sits on the ground at the left, seen from behind in three-quarter view, and embraces a man with golden hair in a red doublet with gold trim, green and blue striped hose and black shoes, who sits close behind her with his legs stretched to the right; their faces touch. Cut from the bas-de-page scene of the recto; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The left-hand vignette of three-couples-in-garden-under-painted-arcade; the figures sit on the ground, so give them a base line.

assets.title: Red squirrel sitting on a patch of grass
assets.description: A reddish-brown squirrel sits upright on a small patch of green grass, seen from the side and facing right, with both forepaws raised in front of its chest. Its large bushy tail curls up behind the back to above the head, and the ears stand up with pale tufts. The fur is modelled in fine dark strokes with white highlights. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Sits on its own strip of ground, so it stands well on a baseline or a rule without a shadow.

assets.title: Sideways red, blue and gray flower with two leaves
assets.description: A flower lying on its side points to the lower right, with a red striped lobe at the tip, a gray curling petal above it and three small round blue petals at its base. From the upper left a green stem runs down to it, carrying two large green leaves that curl up and down, teal with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green on the other, with dark outlines. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: From the bottom border of the verso; the flower points right, so it reads as a closing ornament.

assets.title: Faded brown flower with a yellow upper petal
assets.description: A worn flower with three dusty pinkish-brown petals and one yellow-ochre petal bent upward sits at the top of a slender green stem; the paint of the petals is abraded. A green leaf with pale vein strokes grows to the right at mid height and a second leaf hangs to the lower left at the foot. Tall narrow piece on a transparent background.

assets.title: Blue bud with brown bracts on a long stem
assets.description: A round deep blue bud with pale stripes and dots and a small curled tip at the right, held between two rounded brown bracts with cream rims above and below, at the right end of a long thin green stem that runs straight to the left with a pale highlight along its length. Opaque gouache with a thin gold-ground fringe; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide and low (about 2.8:1), the bud at the right end; the long bare stem crops away for a small round ornament.

assets.title: Red flower with gray sepals on a long curved stem
assets.description: A round red flower with gold stripes and dots and a small dark red knob at its base hangs at the right end of a long thin green stem that curves up to the left; three pale gray-white rounded sepals with gray shading sit behind the flower at its top. Dark outlines, opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide and low (about 1.9:1), the flower at the right end; the bare stem crops away for a small round ornament.

assets.title: Round red bud on a long stem, hanging left
assets.description: A round red bud banded and dotted in yellow hangs at the lower left in a three-lobed green calyx; its long green stem rises to the upper right. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Brown cap flower on a tall upright stem
assets.description: A tall upright flower: a rounded, fringed brownish-red cap sits on a bulbous green calyx with yellow highlights. The long straight green stem carries two paired green leaves with yellow hatching two thirds of the way down, with gold flecks along it. Transparent background.

assets.title: Red carnation bud on a tapering stem
assets.description: An upright bud: red fringed petals streaked in yellow burst from a bulbous green calyx with yellow highlights, on a long green stem that tapers to a point at the bottom. Black outlines; transparent background.

assets.title: Spiny green thistle head with two serrated leaves
assets.description: A round green thistle head covered in black spines, with a fan of dusky rose-brown petals opening at its upper left; a short stem leads to two long serrated green leaves with yellow veins, one rising at the right and one lying along the bottom. Transparent background.

assets.title: Split oval bud with red interior on a tall stem
assets.description: An oval pinkish-brown bud with a small knob at the top sits at the head of a long green stem; its front is split open to show a red interior dotted with cream. Two green leaves with gold-edged margins cross the lower stem, one rising to the left and one hanging to the right. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The lowest of three sprigs stacked in one margin of the recto, under the red flower and the leaf pair.

assets.title: Three couples in a garden under an arcade
assets.description: The bas-de-page scene of the recto, a wide strip under three painted arches (red, blue, red) on blue and red columns with gold capitals. At the left a seated couple in blue and red embrace; in the middle a couple sits in a wooden tub sharing a goblet, a gray jug on the ground before it; at the right a nude couple embraces, one fist raised. Behind them green trees, a blue sky and pale buildings at the right, on a sandy ground with pebbles and grass. Opaque, with a thin red-brown rule along the top and bottom; transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete opaque scene, about 3.4:1; place it as a picture, for example as a header strip.

The three couples and the jug are also cut out separately as seated-embracing-couple, couple-sharing-goblet-in-wooden-bathtub, embracing-nude-couple-with-raised-clasped-hands and gray-metal-water-jug-with-small-foot.

assets.title: Red three-petalled flower on a tall stem
assets.description: A red flower with three broad cup-shaped petals and cream highlight strokes sits at the top of a long, slightly curved green stem. Two green leaves with gold-edged margins and pale vein strokes grow from the stem, one to the right at mid height and one to the left near the foot. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The topmost of three sprigs stacked in one margin of the recto; the leaf pair and the oval bud hang below it.

assets.title: Crossed pair of upright leaves, verso
assets.description: Two long pointed green leaves, one rising and one hanging, joined at the middle where their short stems cross and curl outward to the left and right. Each leaf is two-toned, teal green with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black band on the other, with a black outline. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The cleanest of the three leaf-pair cut-outs; the same motif is crossed-upright-green-leaf-pair on the recto and crossed-horizontal-green-leaf-pair lying flat.

assets.title: Two crossed green leaves on a short twig
assets.description: Two long green leaves with dark outlines and pale vein strokes cross at a short stem; the upper one rises to the right, the lower one hangs down to the left with a curled, lobed tip. A short twig sticks out to the left at the crossing. Tall narrow piece on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The recto carries the same leaf-pair motif with gold edges as middle-two-green-leaf-curved-twig.

assets.title: Hanging pea vine with six pods
assets.description: A tall pea vine hanging the full height of the piece: six long green pods bulging with peas hang from thin winding stalks among small round green leaves and curling tendrils, with yellow highlights and gold flecks along the pod edges. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece suited to a side margin; crop between pods for a shorter run.

assets.title: Pointed red bud in a gray cup
assets.description: A pointed red bud with gold streaks rises from a cup of three gray-blue sepals with pale highlights, set on three rounded pale green bracts. A straight green stem runs down with two rounded green leaves spreading left and right at mid height, teal with cream hatching on one side of the midrib and dark green with a black outline on the other. Opaque gouache; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow (about 1:2.5), the top-left corner piece of the verso; suits a side margin.

assets.title: Apostle before a walled city, framed miniature
assets.description: The whole miniature from the leaf. A grey-haired, bearded apostle with a gold halo stands centred on a pale green ground facing the viewer, in a blue tunic and orange-brown mantle, right hand raised in speech and a rolled white scroll in his left. Pink and ochre city towers rise on either side with red cloth draped between them, on a burnished gold ground. A painted frame of a blue band with white curling vines between two narrow red and gold bands encloses the scene, with leaf flourishes at the four corners; it runs slightly askew. Opaque inside the frame, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature with its own gold ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The emptied frame is finite-blue-vine-and-red-gold-miniature-frame and the figure alone is standing-apostle-with-rolled-scroll.

assets.title: Blue vine miniature frame
assets.description: The painted frame of the miniature with its interior removed. A wide blue band carries a white curling vine with leaves and spiral tendrils, between a narrow outer and inner red band bearing a gold chain-like pattern, with a thin gold rule along the inside edge. Gold and red leaf finials spring outward from the two upper corners and blue, gold-edged leaf flourishes from the two lower corners. The frame is slightly trapezoidal as painted. Only the paint is opaque; the interior and everything outside the frame are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, scaled as a whole with content placed in its transparent interior; it is not a border-image because the top and right bands run askew and the four corner flourishes all differ.
For a band of the same ornament at any length use the two repeat tiles white-curling-vine-on-blue-repeat and gold-s-shaped-leaf-on-red-repeat.

assets.title: Gold S-leaf on red, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the narrow red band of the miniature frame, a gold S-shaped leaf with a darker lobe painted on a dull red ground with gold speckling. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; the band's painted edges are slightly ragged and the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band. In the frame this band runs on both sides of the blue vine band.
Keep it at native size; the source band is only 70 px tall and blurs when enlarged.

assets.title: Haloed man facing left with open hand
assets.description: A small bearded man with a red-rimmed gold halo stands turned to the left with his head bowed, his right hand held out open towards the left, in a blue tunic under an orange mantle with white highlights, on a small red and gold base. The paint is worn, with pale parchment showing through the halo and face. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-man-gesturing-in-blue-and-green-robes, which faces right at the same scale; set them facing each other.

assets.title: Haloed man in profile pointing right
assets.description: A small bearded man with a gold halo stands in profile facing right, his right arm stretched out and pointing, in an olive-green tunic and a blue mantle wrapped around the lower body, on a small red and gold base. The paint is heavily flaked, with pale parchment showing through the halo, face and mantle. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-man-in-blue-and-orange-robes, which faces left at the same scale; set them facing each other.

assets.title: Standing apostle with a scroll
assets.description: A grey-haired, bearded apostle stands facing the viewer in a blue tunic and an orange-brown mantle with white highlights, draped over his left shoulder and wrapped around his body; his right hand is raised before his chest in a gesture of speech and his left holds a white rolled scroll. He wears sandals. His halo is kept as a thin gold ring with the gold ground inside it removed. Cut from the framed miniature of the leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut-out of the figure in complete-apostle-city-scene-with-blue-vine-frame; the halo is an open ring, so it reads best on a plain or gold background.

assets.title: White vine on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the blue band of the miniature frame. A white, grey-shaded vine stem curls into a spiral at the left, throws a three-lobed leaf upward at the centre and a hooked tendril downward, on a deep blue ground with dark speckling. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; the thin strips above and below the painted band are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band. In the frame it is flanked by gold-s-shaped-leaf-on-red-repeat on both sides.
Keep it at or below native size; the source band is 111 px tall.

assets.title: Coronation of the Virgin with six angels
assets.description: Christ in a blue mantle over a red robe sits at the right of a gray Gothic throne with orange-red pinnacles and a gabled back, and sets a crown on Mary, who sits at the left in a white mantle patterned with red and blue florets over a peach robe, hands crossed on her chest. Two standing angels in blue and green flank each side and two more kneel in front of the white marble base; all have burnished gold haloes. The miniature's blue ground is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The whole miniature without its ground; the two kneeling angels in front are also available as separate pieces, and the frame from the same leaf surrounds it on the page.

assets.title: Kneeling angel in blue, facing right
assets.description: An angel kneels in profile facing right with hands joined, its face lifted upward, in a long blue robe with yellow-green highlights and gold hems that pools on the ground behind it. Two long pointed wings in blue and yellow-green sweep back to the lower left; the hair is bound with a red fillet and the burnished gold halo carries red flame marks. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left foreground of the Coronation; it faces right and pairs with the green angel facing left, kneeling on either side of a title or image.

assets.title: Kneeling angel in green, facing left
assets.description: An angel kneels in profile facing left with hands joined at its chest, its face lifted upward, in a long blue-green robe with yellow-green highlights and gold hems that spreads on the ground around it. Two long pointed green wings sweep back to the lower right; the hair is bound with a red fillet and the burnished gold halo carries red flame marks. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the right foreground of the Coronation; it faces left and pairs with the blue angel facing right, kneeling on either side of a title or image.

assets.title: Floral page frame with knotted medallions
assets.description: A complete rectangular page frame built on thin blue rods. The top bar carries a band of blue, orange and cream acanthus on gold between two knotted roundels; the left bar strings together knotted medallions, two six-pointed stars with red centres, gold bosses and leaf sprays; the right bar is a chain of acanthus leaves with a blue and orange pendant; the wide bottom bar is a gold band of scrolling acanthus with a quatrefoil medallion at its centre and small buds hanging below. Gold bosses with fine black rays are scattered around the outside; the centre and the background are transparent.
usage_notes: A complete non-repeating frame with its own corners; place content inside the transparent centre and keep the proportions, there is no atlas.
The rayed gold bosses extend outside the rods, so leave margin around the frame rather than cropping to the bars.

assets.title: Blue cornflower head
assets.description: A single blue cornflower seen from the front, its ragged fringed petals radiating in two layers around a dark navy centre with pale dots; the petals are mid blue with lighter streaks and a few white highlights at the tips. No stem or leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the bottom band of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Crimson double rose head
assets.description: A dense double rose seen from the front, its many overlapping petals in deep pink shading to crimson at the folds, with fine darker hatching, around a slightly off-centre cluster of golden yellow stamens. No stem or leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the bottom band of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Strewn-flower border with arched opening
assets.description: A complete page border on a textured gold ground with a tall round-arched transparent opening edged by a thin dark red rule; the left pillar is wide, the right one narrow, the bottom band widest and the top only a sliver above the arch. Scattered on the gold with painted shadows are pink wild roses, a crimson double rose, blue cornflowers and star flowers, pansies, pale lilac flowers, green buds, grey stems and curled silvery acanthus leaves, three butterflies (orange, grey, brown) and a small grey-brown bird with a blue wing patch at the lower left. The outside is transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame; place it as one image and put content inside the arched opening. The four sides are of different thickness and the opening is arched, so it is not a nine-slice border and has no frame atlas.
The five single flowers, butterflies and bird of this set are cut from this border and can be scattered around it in the same manner.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Grey butterfly in profile
assets.description: A grey butterfly seen from the side with its wings closed over its back, facing right. The pale grey-beige wings carry darker mottled bands and several black eyespots ringed in white, one large on the forewing and a row of smaller ones on the hindwing; the dark body, thin legs and two long clubbed antennae point to the right. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left pillar of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Orange butterfly in profile
assets.description: A small butterfly seen from the side with its wings closed over its back, facing right. The forewing is orange with brown mottling and black eyespots ringed in yellow; the larger hindwing below is pale grey with a row of black eyespots ringed in white. The dark body, thin legs and two clubbed antennae point to the right. The background is transparent.
