usage_notes: Cut from the top left corner of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Small bird with blue wing patch
assets.description: A small songbird standing in profile and facing left, with a grey-brown head and back, a dark pointed beak, a round dark eye, a cream breast streaked with brown, a bright blue patch on the folded wing, a short barred tail and two thin dark legs with spread claws. There is no ground under the feet; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the lower left of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included. The feet rest on nothing, so give it a baseline or let it perch on an edge.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Christ carrying the cross
assets.description: Christ, barefoot in a blue robe hatched with gold and with a gold halo, walks to the right carrying a large wooden cross over his shoulder. Behind him at the left stand three haloed mourners in blue, white and yellow and a soldier in a red tunic and dark helmet who holds the cross; at the right a man in a tan tunic, red cap and white hood grasps the cross beam and a soldier in a patterned red tunic and dark helmet is seen from behind. Flat colours with gold hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The figures touch and overlap, so keep the group whole; the cross beam is the widest element and the feet are the lowest.

assets.title: Silver acanthus with roses and blue flowers
assets.description: A tall vertical border piece. A silver-gray acanthus scroll with white highlights curls through two large C-shapes in the middle, threaded by thin red stems that carry four red roses with gold centres at the top, bell-shaped blue flowers and two brownish-red blossoms below, and green leaves and small round buds throughout. Painted with fine dark contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Runs down an outer margin; the roses sit at the top, so flip vertically only if the flowers may hang.

assets.title: Saint Paul with sword and book
assets.description: A standing bearded man with receding brown hair and a blue halo dotted in white, in a long cream mantle over a blue robe, holds a tall sword upright against his shoulder in one hand and a closed book in the other; his head turns to the left and the mantle falls in deep folds to his feet. Black contours and flat colours with pale shading; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Faces left, toward saint-peter-with-large-key in the initial; place the two saints facing each other on either side of a heading.

assets.title: Saint Peter with a large key
assets.description: A standing bearded man with curly gray hair and a cream halo, in a blue mantle lined in gray over an orange-red robe, holds a large cream key over his shoulder in one hand and raises the other hand open; his head turns to the right and the mantle hangs in long folds edged with white dots. Black contours and flat colours with pale shading; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Faces right, toward saint-paul-with-long-sword-and-book in the initial; place the two saints facing each other on either side of a heading.

assets.title: Kneeling saint seized by the hair, left scene
assets.description: A haloed man in a blue mantle over a red robe kneels at the left with hands joined in prayer, facing right, while a bareheaded man in a short cream tunic, orange-red hose and black shoes strides toward him from the right, grips the top of his head with one hand and holds a pale object at his hip with the other, looking back over his shoulder. Black contours, gold halo, flat colours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The two figures touch, so keep the scene whole; it sits at the lower left of the initial and pairs with the mirror scene at the lower right.

assets.title: Kneeling saint seized by the hair, right scene
assets.description: A bearded, haloed man in an orange-red robe kneels at the left with hands joined in prayer, facing right, while a curly-haired man in a blue tunic with red sleeves and buttons, red hose and black shoes stands over him, bends to grip his hair with one hand and raises the other arm high holding a small pale object. Black contours, gold halo, flat colours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The two figures touch, so keep the scene whole; it sits at the lower right of the initial and pairs with the mirror scene at the lower left.

assets.title: Crested gray bird with long tail
assets.description: A small pale gray-green bird stands in profile facing right with its head raised, a short crest of black strokes behind the head, a dark eye and beak, black-lined wing feathers folded along the back, a long tail dropping to the lower left and thin black legs with spread claws. Black contours over mottled pale pigment with a few pink flecks; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Perches naturally on a rule or the top of a frame; the claws are the lowest point.

assets.title: Angel chasing a devil, roundel
assets.description: The whole round miniature from the recto. A white-robed angel with a pale gold halo and dark red wings strides to the right holding a long thin gold staff diagonally, one hand reaching towards a black horned devil who runs off to the right while looking back at the angel; the devil is painted black with fine gold hatching. They stand on a yellow-green hillside with blue-green trees under a blue sky with a few gold streaks. A thin gold rim closes the scene. Opaque inside the rim, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete roundel with its own rim and painted ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The figures alone are white-robed-winged-angel and black-horned-devil; the empty gold ring at the right of blue-gold-floral-frame is this roundel's seat.

assets.title: Bearded man's head in profile
assets.description: The head and shoulders of a man in left-facing profile with a large hooked nose, a pointed grey beard, long ochre-brown hair falling behind the ear and a gold hoop earring. The skin is pale with grey-blue shading and he wears a plain white collar. Cut from the recto text block; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Only the head and collar are kept; the initial it belongs to is not included.

assets.title: Running black devil looking back
assets.description: A slender black devil with two straight horns and pointed ears strides to the right on long legs while its head turns back to the left in profile. The body, limbs and face are drawn in fine gold hatching over black; one arm is bent before the chest, the other stretched back, and a thin curved tail hangs between the legs. The feet end in claws. Cut from the recto roundel; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval; pairs with white-robed-winged-angel at the same scale, placed to its left.

assets.title: Discs and diamonds line filler, eight motifs
assets.description: A finite horizontal line filler from the verso, a burnished gold bar with a black outline carrying eight motifs that alternate blue and brown, each with fine gold hatching, from left to right a blue diamond, brown disc, blue diamond, brown disc, blue disc, brown disc, blue diamond and brown diamond. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite strip at a fixed length; for a band of any length use discs-and-diamonds-repeat-b, which carries the same motifs as a seamless tile.

assets.title: Discs and diamonds on gold, recto repeat tile
assets.description: One six-motif cycle of the recto line fillers, a burnished gold band between two black rules carrying, from left to right, a brown disc, blue disc, brown diamond, blue diamond, brown diamond and blue disc, each with fine gold hatching. The pattern continues across the left and right edges. Only the painted band is opaque; the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band and the generated atlas for a border-image frame.
Keep it at or below native size; the band is 117 px tall and blurs when enlarged.

assets.title: Discs and diamonds on gold, verso repeat tile
assets.description: One six-motif cycle of the verso line fillers, a burnished gold band between two black rules carrying a brown diamond split across the join, then a blue disc, brown disc, blue disc, brown disc and blue diamond, each with fine gold hatching. The pattern continues across the left and right edges. Only the painted band is opaque; the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band and the generated atlas for a border-image frame.
Keep it at or below native size; the band is 113 px tall and blurs when enlarged.

assets.title: Discs and diamonds line filler, ten motifs
assets.description: A finite horizontal line filler from the recto, a burnished gold bar with a black outline carrying ten motifs that alternate blue and brown, each with fine gold hatching, from left to right a blue disc, brown disc, blue disc, brown diamond, blue diamond, brown diamond, blue disc, brown disc, blue disc and brown diamond. The bar is slightly thicker at the left end than at the right. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite strip at a fixed length; for a band of any length use discs-and-diamonds-repeat-a, which carries the same motifs as a seamless tile.

assets.title: Acanthus wave line filler
assets.description: A short finite horizontal line filler from the recto, a burnished gold bar with a black outline in which two curling acanthus leaves lie end to end in a wave, a brown and gold leaf on the left and a blue and gold leaf on the right, their lobes drawn in black line over gold. Only the painted bar is opaque; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite strip at a fixed length; the bar is too short to carry a repeating cycle. Its height matches the discs-and-diamonds fillers of the same page.

assets.title: Walking bird with a bearded man's head
assets.description: A grotesque bird walking to the right on two thin legs with spread claws. Its brown body carries a folded wing dotted with rows of yellow-gold spots, a pointed tail of three feathers to the left and a long curved neck ending in a pale bearded man's head with short brown hair, turned slightly towards the viewer. Cut from the lower margin of the recto border; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the lower margin of blue-gold-floral-frame; the verso has a second human-headed bird, human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.

assets.title: Lying bird with a bearded man's head
assets.description: A grotesque bird lying with its brown body and pointed tail stretched to the right and a long gold neck curving up and over to the left, ending in a pale bearded man's head that hangs face down. The folded wing carries rows of yellow-gold spots and the gold neck is shaded with brown. Cut from the lower margin of the verso border; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the lower margin of blue-gold-floral-manuscript-frame; the recto has a walking counterpart, human-headed-bird.

assets.title: Verso floral page border with devils roundel
assets.description: The complete painted border of the verso, a dense field of hairline tendrils with gold dots, green and yellow leaves, blue and red flowers and red fruits, with large blue and gold acanthus scrolls in the four corners and along the top. The round miniature of two dancing black devils in a landscape sits in the left margin and a human-headed bird with a gold neck lies in the lower margin. The text block is framed by a thin brown and gold rule with a blue finial at each upper corner. The text block is transparent; the parchment between the sprigs is kept at partial opacity.
usage_notes: Fixed page border, scaled as a whole with content placed in the transparent text block; it is not a border-image, the four sides and corners all differ.
The roundel and the bird are painted into the border and are also available alone as two-dancing-devils-in-gold-landscape-oval and human-headed-bird-with-gold-neck.
Reads best on a light ground because of the partially opaque parchment between the sprigs.

assets.title: Two dancing devils, roundel
assets.description: The whole round miniature from the verso. Two black horned devils with fine gold hatching dance side by side facing right, the left one with hands clasped before the chest, the right one with one arm thrown out and a leg kicked up, their clawed feet meeting at the bottom. They stand on a yellow-green hillside with blue-green trees under a blue sky that carries a short white inscription and two gold streaks. A thin gold rim closes the scene. Opaque inside the rim, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete roundel with its own rim and painted ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The figures alone are two-dancing-horned-figures; the roundel is still in place in blue-gold-floral-manuscript-frame.

assets.title: Two dancing black devils
assets.description: Two black devils with straight horns and pointed ears dance side by side facing right, drawn in fine gold hatching over black. The left one holds its clawed hands before its chest and steps forward; the right one throws one arm out to the right and lifts a bent leg, its other foot overlapping the first devil's foot so the pair forms one piece. Cut from the verso roundel; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from two-dancing-devils-in-gold-landscape-oval; the figures touch at the feet and are kept as one piece.

assets.title: Recto floral page border with empty roundel
assets.description: The complete painted border of the recto, a dense field of hairline tendrils with gold dots, green and yellow leaves, red and blue flowers and red fruits, with large blue and gold acanthus scrolls at the top centre, the upper right and both lower corners. A human-headed bird walks in the lower margin. The text block is framed by a thin brown and gold rule with a blue and a red finial at its upper corners; a thin gold ring at the right is the empty seat of the removed roundel. The text block, the ring's interior and the parchment between the sprigs are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed page border, scaled as a whole with content placed in the transparent text block; it is not a border-image, the four sides and corners all differ and the text-block rule is not quite straight.
The roundel angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval fits back into the empty gold ring at the right; the bird in the lower margin is also available as human-headed-bird.

assets.title: Angel with a gold staff
assets.description: An angel in a long white robe stands turned to the right, head in three-quarter view with fair hair and a halo kept only as a thin gold line, two long dark red wings with gold speckling rising behind the shoulders. A thin gold staff with a small knob runs diagonally from the upper left across the body to the lower right; the right hand is raised before the chest and the left arm reaches forward. Cut from the recto roundel; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from angel-chasing-devil-in-gold-oval; pairs with black-horned-devil at the same scale, placed to its right.

assets.title: Ape fishing at a pond, framed miniature
assets.description: The whole pond miniature of the leaf. Between two gold columns with scroll capitals, a brown ape crouches at the left on a green bank holding a fishing rod whose line drops into a blue pond, while a grey-brown long-beaked waterbird dives head first into the water at the right. Green hills, trees with red and gold fruit, clumps of gold-lined reeds and a pale blue sky fill the ground, bounded by a thin gold bar above and a gold plinth below. Opaque inside the frame, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature; place it as a picture. The emptied frame is gold-columned-pond-frame, the ape is crouching-hairy-figure-with-long-bent-implement and the bird is diving-long-beaked-waterbird.

assets.title: Crouching ape holding a fishing rod
assets.description: A brown ape with gold-hatched fur crouches on its haunches facing right, its tail curling behind, and holds a long thin fishing rod in both hands; the rod rises to a peak above and the line bends down to the right. Round ear, dark eye and a long muzzle. The paint is worn, with pale parchment showing through the fur. Cut from the pond miniature of the leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The ape of hairy-hunter-and-diving-bird-pond-scene; the line of the rod ends in the air, so point it at water or at diving-long-beaked-waterbird as on the leaf.

assets.title: Long-beaked waterbird diving head first
assets.description: A grey-brown waterbird with a long pointed beak plunges head first towards the lower left, both wings raised over its back with gold feather hatching and its two long gold legs trailing behind to the right. The breast is pale grey, the head dark with a small gold-ringed eye. Cut from the pond miniature of the leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The bird of hairy-hunter-and-diving-bird-pond-scene, painted diving into water; it reads best with its beak just above a surface or an edge.

assets.title: Gold leaf wave on blue and red line filler
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler. A gold stem waves along a narrow bar whose left half is blue and right half red-brown, throwing gold leaves above and below, with a small gold curl hanging under the blue half at the left end. The ends are finite and slightly ragged; the painted bar is opaque and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: A text-line filler, use it to close a short line or as a small divider at native width; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Gold columned frame of the pond miniature
assets.description: The architectural frame of the pond miniature with its interior removed. A wide horizontal rectangle bounded by two gold columns with spiral-scroll capitals and bases, a thin gold bar with a red-brown rule along the top and a slightly deeper gold plinth bar along the bottom. The gold is worn and shows green and tan ground in places. Only the paint is opaque; the interior and the surround are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, scaled as a whole with content placed in its transparent interior; the top and bottom bars are thin and the two columns differ, so it is not a border-image.

assets.title: Acanthus and flower L-border, top and right
assets.description: An L-shaped page border along the top and right edges with its vertex at the top right. The top bar is a gold band speckled with black dots carrying green leaf sprigs, a red-brown caterpillar and a red fruit with a green calyx, ending in blue and red-brown acanthus curls at the left. The vertex is a knot of blue, red and gold acanthus. The long right bar alternates diagonal panels of speckled gold with green leaves, a blue flower, a red flower and red buds against openwork sections of blue and gold acanthus scrolls. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed L-border for the top-right of a page; the top bar is short and the right bar long, so place the vertex at the corner and let the arms set the margins. It does not repeat.

assets.title: Man in blue tunic hauling on a stem overhead
assets.description: A full-length man in a blue tunic and a white coif, with orange hose and shoes, bends sideways with his head tilted to the right and his left hand on his hip while his right arm reaches over his head to grip a stem; only a small cream stub of the stem remains above his hand. Black outlines, pale pink face with red cheeks, white highlights on the folds. Cut from the foliate extension of the initial P; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The raised arm ends in a short stub of the stem it pulled on; hang the figure from a vine or border end to make sense of the pose.

assets.title: Half-length man in tan robe gesturing right
assets.description: A half-length man in a tan robe and a flat red cap, turned to the right, holding both hands up before him with the index fingers raised in speech. Brown curls, a short beard and a pale face outlined in black. The figure ends at the thighs where the gold ground of the initial stopped. Cut from the left half of the two-figure scene; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with right-blue-red-robed-man-visible-half-figure at the same scale, facing each other as in two-facing-men-on-gold-with-central-tan-band; the body ends at the thighs, so stand it behind a band or edge.

assets.title: Half-length man in orange mantle, hand on chest
assets.description: A half-length man turned to the left with his face raised, in an orange-red mantle over a dark blue robe, his right hand laid flat on his chest. Brown curls, a short beard and a pale face outlined in black. The figure ends at the hips where the gold ground of the initial stopped. Cut from the right half of the two-figure scene; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with left-tan-robed-man-visible-half-figure at the same scale, facing each other as in two-facing-men-on-gold-with-central-tan-band; the body ends at the hips, so stand it behind a band or edge.

assets.title: Saint Paul with sword and book, cut-out
assets.description: Saint Paul to the waist, bald with brown hair at the sides and a pointed beard, his head turned up to the right. He wears a tan tunic under a dark blue mantle and carries a large blue sword over his left shoulder, its round pommel at his hand, while his left hand holds a closed book with a brown cover and pink edges. A blue arc around the head stands for the halo. Cut from the gold counter of the initial P; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The figure alone from saint-paul-with-sword-and-book; it ends at the waist, so stand it behind a band or in a roundel.

assets.title: Saint Paul with sword and book on gold
assets.description: The oval counter of the initial P. Saint Paul to the waist, bald with brown hair at the sides and a pointed beard, head turned up to the right, in a tan tunic under a dark blue mantle, a large blue sword over his left shoulder and a closed brown book with pink edges in his left hand, a blue arc for the halo. He fills a burnished gold ground that is crazed and worn, cut along the letter strokes to a rough oval with a flat base. Opaque inside the oval, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Place it as a picture with its own gold ground; the figure alone is saint-paul-visible-bust-with-sword-and-book.

assets.title: Two men conversing across a tan bar on gold
assets.description: Two half-length men face each other across a vertical tan bar with a darker stripe, on a burnished gold ground cut along the letter strokes. At the left a man in a tan robe and flat red cap gestures with both hands raised; at the right a man in an orange-red mantle over a dark blue robe looks up at him with a hand on his chest. Both have brown curls and short beards. Opaque on the gold, transparent outside its irregular edge.
usage_notes: Place it as a picture with its own gold ground; the two figures are cut out separately as left-tan-robed-man-visible-half-figure and right-blue-red-robed-man-visible-half-figure.

assets.title: Gray acanthus with three curls, lower margin
assets.description: A wide gray acanthus ornament from the lower margin of the calendar frame. Three large curling stems, a spiral at the left, a tall S-bend in the middle and a spiral at the right, grow from a common root at the bottom centre and throw off smaller folded and hooked leaves with pale knobs; the leaves are blue-gray with white highlights and darker gray shadows. Transparent background, the stems ending where they met the frame's flowers.
usage_notes: Wide and low, it sits under a block of text or along a footer; the root at the bottom centre is the natural anchor.

assets.title: Gray acanthus S-scroll, right margin
assets.description: A tall gray acanthus scroll from the right margin of the calendar frame. A long stem rises from a spiral at the bottom, swings through a large reverse curve in the middle and narrows to a point at the top, with folded leaves and a bud-like knob at the centre and hooked sprigs branching left and right; the leaves are blue-gray with white highlights and dark gray shadows. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall and narrow, it runs down the outer margin of a page; the pointed top is where the stem thinned under the frame's flowers.

assets.title: May calendar page frame with two arches
assets.description: The complete frame of a calendar page. Across the top, two round arches on gold columns hold scenes against dense green foliage: a couple riding a white horse with a hawk at the left and a nude couple standing among trees at the right. The right and bottom margins carry flowers in pink, red and blue with green leaves and gray acanthus scrolls on a tan ground flecked with gold; a blue rule edges the left and divides the two text columns, which are transparent, as is the outside of the leaf.
usage_notes: A complete non-repeating frame; place content in the two transparent columns under the arches and keep the proportions, there is no atlas.
The two arches are a header band of their own; crop below the red baseline of the scenes for a banner.

assets.title: Couple riding a white horse with a hawk
assets.description: A young man in a blue tunic hatched with gold, a red cap and black boots rides a white horse to the left, holding the red and gold reins in one hand and a brown hawk perched on the other, raised hand. Behind him sits a woman in an orange-red gown with gold hatching and a white veil under long black hair, one hand resting at her waist. Thin brown contours and gold highlights; the ground under the hooves and the background are transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left arch of the calendar frame; the horse moves left, so place it at the right of a heading or riding into a margin.

assets.title: Red and violet acanthus infill of an initial
assets.description: The painted infill of a decorated initial from the text, a two-lobed field shaped like a B and outlined by a thin blue band. Inside it blue stems coil through both lobes and throw off red and violet acanthus leaves with cream-white folded tips, with the spaces between the leaves open. The letter stroke, its square field and the gold ground are removed; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Reads as a medallion on a plain ground; the open spaces between the leaves show whatever is behind it.

assets.title: Angel on clouds with a blank scroll
assets.description: An angel with blond hair and a gold halo flies to the left on a bank of blue clouds edged in white, in a red robe, with long red wings sweeping back to the right over white feathered underwings, and holds a large blank white scroll that curls down in front of the clouds. Cut from the upper lobe of the miniature; the starry sky is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with four-contacting-shepherds-with-dog-and-two-sheep, above which it hovers in the miniature; the scroll is blank and can carry a line of text.

assets.title: Annunciation to the Shepherds, framed miniature
assets.description: The whole arched miniature of the leaf. In the upper lobe an angel in a red robe flies to the left on a bank of blue and white clouds under a deep blue sky with gold stars, holding a blank white scroll; a gold, red and blue diaper ground fills the spandrels. Below, four shepherds in red, blue and pink hooded tunics stand on a green meadow before a dark hill with two green trees and look up, a white dog leaps between them and two white sheep graze; a pink rock rises at the left. A gold and blue painted frame with an arched top encloses the scene. Opaque inside the frame, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out. The angel and the shepherd group are also supplied as separate cut-outs.
On the leaf it sits in the open top of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy, above the text.

assets.title: Blue bloom on a red stalk, lower margin left
assets.description: A small sprig from the lower margin of the border. A blue cup-shaped bloom with a cream underside, its petals curling back to the right, sits on a tapering red stalk that points to the left. Painted in thick, speckled pigment; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the small blooms scattered along the bottom margin of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy; small-right-red-and-blue-leaf-terminal is the other, both with the stalk pointing left.

assets.title: Blue bloom on a red stalk, lower margin right
assets.description: A small sprig from the lower margin of the border. A blue cup-shaped bloom with a cream underside at its base, its petals curling back to the right, sits on a tapering red stalk that points to the left. Painted in thick, speckled pigment; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the small blooms scattered along the bottom margin of fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy; small-left-red-and-blue-leaf-terminal is the other, both with the stalk pointing left.

assets.title: Blue cornflower chain, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the cornflower chain that forms the vertical stems of the border. A blue fan-shaped bloom seen from the side sits above a round blue bloom seen from the front, both with pale-blue ribbed petals, threaded on a green stem that runs through the tile from top to bottom. The stem continues across the top and bottom edges; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along y for a vertical chain; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal one.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with the mitred corner; use it with border-image and round fitting. The leaf's own corners are large plants, supplied as separate cut-outs.
Keep it near native size; the cycle is 262 px wide and softens when enlarged.

assets.title: Flowered U-shaped page border with gold ivy
assets.description: The complete painted border of the leaf, open at the top where the miniature sat. Two vertical chains of blue cornflowers on a green stem are joined by a third along the bottom, over a loose ground of gold ivy leaves and dots on fine black penwork. Large plants fill the corners, a red and blue acanthus with a gold bird at the top left, a pot of pink flowers at the top right, a leafy pink-flowered branch at the bottom left and a clump of blue cornflowers at the bottom right; a gray-blue acanthus scroll and a second red acanthus grow from the left margin. Centre and background are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed page border scaled as a whole; it is open at the top, so a heading or picture goes in the gap and text inside the U. It is not a border-image, the four corners all differ and the chains are not evenly spaced.
For a cornflower chain at any length use blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem; the four corner plants, the margin scroll and the two small blooms are supplied as separate cut-outs.

assets.title: Four shepherds with a dog and two sheep
assets.description: Four shepherds stand in a close group looking up at the sky. From the left, a bearded man in a blue hood and red tunic with a staff over his shoulder, a youth in a pink tunic, a man in a red hood and blue tunic holding a long staff, and a bearded man in a blue hood and red tunic striped in gold, leaning on a crook and gesturing. A white dog leaps up between them and two white sheep graze at their feet; hose in blue, red and pink, black shoes. Cut from the miniature; the meadow and hill are removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The shepherds look up and to the left; pair the group with announcing-angel-with-blank-scroll placed above it, as in the miniature.

assets.title: Gray-blue acanthus scroll with a pink bud
assets.description: A tall acanthus sprig from the left margin of the border. A gray-blue stem rises from a round pink bud at the bottom, which sprouts a short green stalk to the right, and curls twice to the right into dotted gray-blue scrolls, each carrying a green leaf. The stem is cut flat at the left where the page was trimmed; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Vertical margin sprig; it sits on the outer side of the chain in fixed-floral-u-border-with-gold-and-black-ivy, with the scrolls turning in towards the text.

assets.title: Blue and gold line filler, long
assets.description: A long horizontal line filler from the text, a worn band of gold leaf over a strip of blue paint with small curled hooks at the ends, made of three short segments set end to end with narrow gaps between them. The gold is cracked and partly bare and the blue mottled, as painted; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Fills the end of a text line; scale it to the line height with the gold band at the top. short-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar is the one-segment version.

assets.title: Leafy branch with pink trumpet flowers
assets.description: The bottom-left corner plant of the border. Slender green stems with oval leaves fan up and to the right and carry four pink trumpet-shaped flowers with fringed, darker pink rims on green calyxes; a smaller leafy shoot sits at the bottom left. The paint is thin, with the parchment tone showing through the green; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Bottom-left corner plant; lower-right-green-leaf-branch-with-blue-flowers is its counterpart at the other end of the bottom margin.

assets.title: Clump of blue cornflowers on tall stems
assets.description: The bottom-right corner plant of the border, a clump of blue cornflowers. Five fringed blue blooms, three seen from the side and two from the front, one with a small yellow centre, grow on tall green stems with narrow leaves and two green buds, rising from a mound of grass at the bottom. The paint is thin, with the parchment tone showing through the green; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Bottom-right corner plant, standing on its own grassy base; lower-left-green-leaf-branch-with-pink-flowers is its counterpart at the other end of the bottom margin.

assets.title: Blue and gold line filler, short
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler from the text, a worn band of gold leaf over a strip of blue paint, with a curled hook turning up at the right end and a few blue flecks above the band. The gold is cracked and the blue mottled, as painted; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Fills the end of a text line; scale it to the line height with the gold band at the top. long-blue-and-gold-line-end-scroll-bar is the three-segment version.

assets.title: Blue and gold line-end floret
assets.description: A tiny four-pointed floret of gold leaf with blue paint between the arms, of the kind that closes a short text line. The gold is lumpy and cracked and the outline is soft; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Use at text size as a line-end mark or bullet; the two line-filler bars are its companions from the same text block.

assets.title: Red and blue acanthus branch with a gold bird
assets.description: The top-left corner plant of the border. From a pink bud with a blue calyx at the bottom, red and blue acanthus stems fan upward and out to both sides, their leaves curling into dotted scrolls, the right-hand stem ending in a green knot with a red tip. A small gold bird perches on the left stem facing left. The paint is thick and speckled; the leftmost leaves are cut flat at the trimmed page edge. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Top-left corner plant; the bud at the bottom is where the border's vertical chain starts, so it sits naturally on top of a vertical run of blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem. upper-right-pink-flowers-on-green-leaf-sprays is its counterpart at the other top corner.

assets.title: Potted plant with pink four-petalled flowers
assets.description: The top-right corner plant of the border. A bushy plant of long, ribbed green leaves spreads from an orange-red pot and carries four pinkish-violet four-petalled flowers along the top and a pink bud at the right; under the pot a blue cornflower bloom marks where the border's vertical chain begins. The green is thin and speckled with the parchment tone; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Top-right corner plant; the cornflower under the pot lets it sit on top of a vertical run of blue-cup-and-burst-flowers-on-stem. upper-left-red-and-blue-acanthus-branch is its counterpart at the other top corner.

assets.title: Frieze of Cupid subduing two lions in acanthus scrolls
assets.description: A long horizontal etched frieze. At the centre a winged Cupid, seen from the front with his head bowed, grips the manes of two lions that crouch to either side of him; the lions' hindquarters dissolve into large acanthus volutes that curl outward, and a further volute closes each end, the left one wrapping a cluster of berries. At the far left and far right a fragment of a neighbouring shaggy lion's head, cut by the plate edge, is included. Loose dark brown ink line work; the faint paper tone of the plate area is kept at low opacity.
usage_notes: Symmetrical about Cupid, so it sits well centred under a title; crop about 4 percent off each end to drop the cut lion-head fragments.
Pairs with the heads-of-the-seasons frieze from the same plate, which has the same height and ink.

assets.title: Frieze of four heads of the seasons in acanthus
assets.description: A long horizontal etched frieze of linked acanthus scrolls carrying four heads. From the left, a bearded old man's head facing right under a leafy wreath; a blank cartouche of knotted branches; a young woman's head facing left crowned with flowers; a central burst of large feathery acanthus leaves; a girl's head facing right with ears of grain in her hair; a round wreath of wheat and grapes enclosing a hanging pair of scales; and a youth's head facing left wreathed in vine at the right end. Loose dark brown ink; the faint paper tone of the plate is kept at low opacity.
usage_notes: The blank branch cartouche at the left and the wreath at the right are open fields that can carry a short word or number.
Each head with its scroll crops out as a small vignette; the central leaf burst crops as a symmetrical centrepiece.
Pairs with the Cupid-and-lions frieze from the same plate, which has the same ink and a slightly greater height.

assets.title: Arched canopy with two hanging cages
assets.description: A wide panel of thin architecture inside a ruled border. A round arch on a stepped entablature carries three vases; under it hangs a long fringed drapery with pendant drops, flanked by two slender female terms whose bodies taper into tassels, with two more terms at the outer edges. On each side a domed cage with a fringed valance hangs from the cornice, enclosing a vase that gives off a twist of smoke, above a half-round base. Foliate scrolls with lily flowers and spiky tufts sit on the entablature; bead chains with tassels hang below. Single dark gray ink; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide panel (about 7 to 5) with its thin ruled plate border; the two cages hold smoking vases, not birds.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Feathered mask between two perched birds
assets.description: A wide panel inside a ruled border. At the centre a mask with a feathered crown hangs from a knotted scroll bracket, a bead chain swagging below it to a small foliate drop; a lily-like flower rises from a volute on either side and a moth hovers beside each cheek. Two fringed pagoda canopies hang from wavy cords at the sides. On low plinths at the lower corners sit two plump birds seen from behind, heads turned inward, a cloth draped over each perch. Single dark gray ink with hatched shading; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide strip-like panel (about 2 to 1) with its thin ruled plate border; it does not repeat.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Framed reclining figure over a curled tail
assets.description: A small framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude figure reclines to the left, propped on one elbow with the head at the left, its legs stretched over a creature whose tail curls up at the right. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the middle-right framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-mounted-figure-and-attendant-vignette is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Framed rider on a lion-like beast
assets.description: A small framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude figure sits astride a lion-like beast walking to the right, its tail curling up behind the rider's back. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the middle-left framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-reclining-figure-with-round-shield is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Framed statue with two standing attendants
assets.description: A small upright framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude statue holding a tall spear stands on a round pedestal, and two draped figures stand at either side of it, the right one reaching up toward it. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the lower-right framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-statue-with-two-foreground-figures is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Framed statue with two seated figures
assets.description: A small upright framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude statue with one arm akimbo, holding a tall staff, stands on a round pedestal; two nude figures sit at its base with their backs to the viewer, turned toward each other. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the lower-left framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-statue-with-two-attending-figures is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Framed standing figure over a crouching figure
assets.description: A small framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude figure stands at the right with both arms flung up and the head turned to the left, one leg thrust against a second nude figure crouching at the left. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the upper-left framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-two-figures-with-rectangular-props is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Framed striding figure and figure seated on a block
assets.description: A small framed vignette cropped from a grotesque panel: a nude figure at the left strides to the right with one arm raised, holding a small object, while a second nude figure sits on a square block at the right with one arm raised toward the first. Thick, soft dark lines inside a double-ruled rectangle and a diagonally hatched frame band; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from the upper-right framed scene of grotesque-architecture-with-bird-canopies; framed-two-figures-contesting-on-shared-ground is its counterpart on the other side.
Small and coarse; keep it at or below the master width.

assets.title: Grotesque with eagles, musicians and a bearded mask
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a thin ruled border. Two eagles with spread wings hold bead garlands at the top corners beside a winged female half-figure, hatched tablets hanging below. Bearded foliate scrolls carry a horned satyr with a pipe and a man playing a lyre. A bat-winged, goat-headed creature spreads over a grinning bearded mask above a frieze of tiny figures. Two cranes fly in over a swag to an oval cartouche; two goat-legged satyrs blow pipes on a pedestal with a dark niche, between crossed instruments, torches, urns and two sphinxes. Warm dark gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 2 to 3) with its thin ruled plate border; place it standing.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Grotesque architecture with satyrs, framed scenes and niches
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a ruled border. Three winged busts on vases top thin scroll stems; a goose and a parrot-like bird perch on fringed canopies at the corners. Under a leafy arch with a mask at its crown two satyrs dance around a staff twined by two snakes, a basket of fruit hanging below; slender candelabra and two amphorae stand at the sides. Six hatched frames with figure scenes are stacked three per side. The base is a strapwork frieze of diamonds and dolphins with four arched niches holding standing figures between serpents. Warm dark gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 2 to 3) with its thin ruled plate border; place it standing.
The six framed scenes are also published as separate crops (the framed-* assets); use those when a single vignette is wanted.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Grotesque candelabrum with trophies, a boat and horned hybrids
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a ruled border, a faint impression. Two winged genii read books at the top corners of a rod hung with trophies of arms and tablets; an armour trophy stands above a crescent boat with ram-head prows carrying two nude figures. A winged woman holding two long trumpets is flanked by rearing horses on cups raised by reclining nudes; below her a crested term lifts two cornucopias between two horned, bearded, horse-bodied hybrids. A frieze of a triumph with elephants, a winged mask and two dragons held by nude figures close the base. Pale warm gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 2 to 3) with its thin ruled plate border; place it standing.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; the impression is pale, so it needs a light ground or a darkening filter.

assets.title: Stepped canopy with bird cages and a horsemen miniature
assets.description: A wide panel inside a ruled border. A stepped strapwork frame holds a small hatched miniature of galloping horsemen at the centre, under a half-dome lunette and two foliate C-scrolls. On either side a domed bird cage with a bird inside hangs from the upper rule between fluttering ribbons, and a bird perches on the rule beside a tall tapering vase at each outer end. Below, a slender female term stands between bead swags with tassels, and a dotted shield cartouche with pendant drops hangs under a foliate bracket at each side. Single dark gray ink; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Wide strip-like panel (about 2 to 1) with its thin ruled plate border; it does not repeat.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Grotesque vines crowded with figures and hybrids
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a ruled border, filled asymmetrically with scrolling vines. A winged putto rides a cornucopia at the top left; a leaping stag, a crane and two figures on a pedestal fill the top right; a nude man with sword and round shield strides over a scroll. A winged female bust tops the central stem above a bearded man seated over a framed miniature; a fringed canopy hangs at the right with figures swinging from its cords. A dog-headed dragon, a satyr piper, a winged siren, a boy in a hoop, a goat and a reclining man fill the lower half. Warm gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 2 to 3) with its thin ruled plate border; place it standing. The composition is not symmetric, so it does not mirror.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Hunting miniature between two bending satyrs
assets.description: A near-square panel in a stepped ruled border. At the centre a rectangular miniature of a hunt (a horseman, an archer, a seated figure and a dog) sits in a strapwork frame hung with bead chains; above it a lion mask in foliate scrolls between two spiky tufts, with a basket of fruit and bead garlands at the top. Two nude satyr-like figures with scroll legs bend backwards on either side, each holding up a smoking bowl. Pendant canopies with medallions, tassels and fans of wheat-like plumes fill the outer columns; a small doorway opens at the bottom. Single dark gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Near-square panel (about 4 to 3) with its stepped ruled plate border; the central miniature is drawn, not a separate asset.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Tall canopy with a niche figure and a winged siren
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a ruled border. At the top a fringed pavilion canopy with draperies held by two small nude figures; below it a deep perspectival box niche holds a standing nude woman with a staff under a leafy arch, with rows of hanging flower drops. A strapwork cartouche with a feather-crowned mask follows, then two flaming lamp-stands on tripods with hanging cloths and tassels. At the bottom a winged female figure ending in a scroll tail rests on foliate volutes between two flowering shrubs, over a stepped plinth with two tiny swan heads. Single dark gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 1 to 2) with its thin ruled plate border; it matches tall-grotesque-with-dragons-and-paired-griffins in width and height.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Tall grotesque with winged dragons and griffins
assets.description: A tall upright panel in a ruled border. Bead garlands swag from the top, held by two birds flying down; thin candelabrum stems with lantern-shaped vases run down both sides. Two winged, bird-headed dragons with curling scaly tails face inward in the upper register, moths between them; below, two griffins perch on a wide footed bowl holding leafy sprays. A strapwork cartouche holds an oval miniature of a reclining figure. Under a scalloped half-dome two seated griffins face each other across a mask; a winged mask closes the bottom. Single dark gray ink; transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall panel (about 1 to 2) with its thin ruled plate border; it matches tall-canopy-with-framed-figure-and-winged-mask in width and height.
Single-colour ink with its density in the alpha channel; place on any light ground or use as a mask.

assets.title: Rabbit blowing a horn, riding a hound
assets.description: A russet rabbit in a short red belted tunic sits astride a trotting gray-and-white hound facing right, holding the reins in one paw and blowing a curved gold hunting horn with the other; the hound wears a gold collar and its long tail curls up behind. Painted in a stippled manuscript manner with thin brown contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: A modern interpretation of the Macclesfield Psalter drollery, not a reproduction of the manuscript; credit adrian729 under CC-BY-4.0 when used.
Runs to the right along a baseline; the hound's forepaws are the lowest point.
assets.attribution: Fitzwilliam Museum MS 1-2005; Macclesfield Psalter, fol. 115v

assets.title: Gold leaf scroll border
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of two wave stems, one dark plum and one gold, crossing each other in opposite phase along the strip. Pointed gold leaves with a cream vein spring from the crests and troughs. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Gold quatrefoil vine border
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying gold four-lobed flowers with a gold centre and a red dot on each lobe, one on each crest and trough, with a small pointed gold leaf between them. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Gold wave ribbon on red band
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of a solid red band with dark plum edges, across which a broad gold ribbon outlined in dark plum runs in regular rising and falling waves. Flat colours; the band and the ribbon continue across the left and right edges. The band is opaque and the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The band is opaque, so it covers whatever lies under it.

assets.title: Red berry vine border
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying clusters of round red berries on short stalks, a large berry with smaller ones beside it on each crest and trough and single berries along the slopes. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Red rosette vine border
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying red six-petalled rosettes with a gold centre, one on each crest and trough, with pointed gold leaves bearing a cream vein between them. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Red trefoil vine border
assets.description: A horizontal vector border of a thin dark plum wave stem carrying groups of three small red three-lobed flowers with gold centres on each crest and trough, with a pointed gold leaf bearing a cream vein on the slopes between the groups. Flat colours with dark outlines; the pattern continues across the left and right edges. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along x at one cycle per master width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes the strip with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Abrotonum foemina, upright flowering stem
assets.description: A single tall upright stem rises from a short, many-branched root at the bottom; its lower half is bare and its upper half carries a narrow plume of side branches with finely divided leaves and small round button-like flower heads at the tips. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Very tall and narrow (about 1:2.9); suits a margin or the side of a text column.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [39]; image 543716

assets.title: Alsine media, chickweed tuft
assets.description: Common chickweed (Stellaria media), a loose sprawling tuft of thin trailing stems that spread upward and outward from a small fibrous root at the bottom centre, set with pairs of small toothed oval leaves and tiny five-petalled flowers and buds at the tips; the tuft is wider at the top than at the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The upper two thirds crop to a loose scatter of leafy stems without the root.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [54]; image 543731

assets.title: Anagallis mas, pimpernel sprig
assets.description: Scarlet pimpernel (Anagallis mas, the red-flowered pimpernel), a trailing plant whose thin stems arch up and outward from a fibrous root at the lower left, carrying pairs of pointed oval leaves, open five-petalled flowers and many round buds and seed capsules on short stalks; the arching stems leave open space in the middle. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Nearly square, with the root tucked in the lower left; crops well to the upper arch of stems and flowers.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [50]; image 543727

assets.title: Chamaemelum eranthemon, flowering branch
assets.description: An upright branching plant with a long slender root that takes up the lower third, whorls of narrow linear leaves along the thin stems, and about a dozen five-petalled flowers with hanging, parted petals at the branch tips; the crown spreads wider than the stem below it. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The long bare root can be cropped at the stem base for a shorter, airier piece.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [59]; image 543736

assets.title: Plantago maior, greater plantain
assets.description: Greater plantain (Plantago major), a rosette of six broad ribbed oval leaves on long stalks spreading left and right from a tangle of fibrous roots at the centre, with three tall narrow flower spikes rising from the middle; one leaf hangs down below the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The lowest leaf hangs below the root; crop it off at the root for a compact rosette with the spikes.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [69]; image 543746

assets.title: Sedum maius, houseleek in flower
assets.description: Common houseleek (Sempervivum tectorum), a rosette of fleshy pointed leaves at the base over a thick root and trailing runners, from which a tall column-like stem densely clad in overlapping leaves rises and opens at the top into a crown of curled, spreading branches bearing many small star-shaped flowers; the whole reads as a symmetrical upright emblem. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Keep root, rosette and flower crown together; the piece is built as one vertical emblem.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [64]; image 543741

assets.title: Seriphium absinthium, wormwood bush
assets.description: A wormwood (Artemisia), three tall upright shoots rising from a thick twisted root at the lower right, each densely set from base to tip with finely divided feathery leaves; the shoots lean slightly apart and fill a tall rectangle with little open space. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Dense foliage; reads as a textured block beside text rather than as a silhouette.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [34]; image 543711

assets.title: Armoured rhinoceros
assets.description: A rhinoceros walking to the left in profile, its body covered in plated armour with scalloped edges, mail-like hatching on the legs, a single horn on the nose and a small twisted horn on the shoulder, after Dürer's 1515 woodcut. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627406; section De rhinocerote.

assets.title: Beaver
assets.description: A beaver walking to the right in profile with its mouth open to show the long incisors, dense hatched fur, clawed feet and the flat scaly paddle tail trailing to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2.5:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626789; section De castore.

assets.title: Seated tabby cat
assets.description: A tabby cat sitting upright and looking straight at the viewer, with pointed ears, long whiskers, banded stripes across the chest and flanks and the tail curled around the front paws. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626798; section De cato seu fele.

assets.title: Crocodile
assets.description: A crocodile seen from above and slightly from the side, its head at the left with the jaws wide open to show rows of teeth, four splayed legs, a back of square plates and a long ringed tail curling up to the right. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2.4:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 2119273; section De crocodilo.

assets.title: Elephant
assets.description: An elephant walking to the right in profile, with a large fan-shaped ear, two tusks, the trunk curling down and inward, columnar legs on flat round feet and a thin tufted tail. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626863; section De elephanto.

assets.title: Elk antler
assets.description: A single palmated antler of a European elk (moose) standing upright, the broad veined palm rising from a knobbed burr at the lower right and ending in a row of pointed tines along the left edge and across the top. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the antler is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the antler is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Tall upright piece (about 3:5); pairs with a mirrored copy as a symmetrical ornament.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626455; section De alce.

assets.title: Seated fox
assets.description: A fox sitting on its haunches and facing right, with pointed ears, a narrow whiskered muzzle, shaggy hatched fur and a long bushy tail stretched out along the ground to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627534; section De vulpe.

assets.title: Grape bunch with branch stub
assets.description: A tiny bunch of grapes hanging below two broad vine leaves, the stem ending at the top in a short horizontal stub of the branch it grew from, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter. Dark brown printed ink only, a few dozen pixels across; the paper is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Render at or below the master's pixel size; it blurs when enlarged.
Ink only, so it sits on any ground; the branch stub closes the piece, so it stands alone better than the cropped variant.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Standing horse
assets.description: A stallion standing in profile and facing left, with a short upright mane, a long flowing tail reaching the ground and one hind leg raised. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626896; section De equo.

assets.title: Walking lion
assets.description: A maned lion walking to the left in profile, with a heavy shaggy mane falling over the shoulders and chest, large paws and a thin tail raised behind and ending in a tuft. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Pear with curved stalk
assets.description: A tiny pear hanging from a stem that continues upward into a short curve ending in a knob where the stalk joined the branch, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter. Dark brown printed ink only, a few dozen pixels across; the paper is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Render at or below the master's pixel size; it blurs when enlarged.
Ink only, so it sits on any ground; the curved stalk closes the piece, so it stands alone better than the cropped variant.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Closed rosebud on its stem
assets.description: A closed pink rosebud hangs with its tip toward the lower left, the folded petals wrapped by five long olive-green sepals that splay out in thin curving points, with a hairy green hip and a short thorny stem that rises to the upper right. Finely hatched watercolour and gouache on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The more open bud hoefnagel-rose-upper comes from the same plant on the folio; the two hang well one above the other with their stems to the right.
The stem is short and ends cleanly at the upper right, so the piece needs no cropping.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Apple cut in half
assets.description: A red apple cut in two, the halves lying with their pale cream cut faces toward the viewer and overlapping, the left half slightly behind the right; each cut face shows a yellow-brown core cavity with one dark brown seed, the left half carries the short brown stalk at the top and both halves keep a dried brown blossom end on the red skin. Finely hatched gouache and watercolour on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The lowest curve of the skin is cut flat by the canvas edge; rest that edge on a baseline, rule or page bottom and the cut disappears.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Opening rosebud on a long stem
assets.description: A half-open pink rosebud at the left, its outer petals loosening and shaded from pale pink to deep rose, held by olive-green sepals that curl back along the bud and over the hairy hip; a long thin green stem runs almost horizontally to the right edge. Finely hatched watercolour and gouache on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The closed bud hoefnagel-rose-lower comes from the same plant on the folio; the two hang well one above the other with their stems to the right.
Wide piece (about 2.3:1); the long stem at the right can be cropped or run under a line of text without losing the flower.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Strapwork cartouche frame
assets.description: A complete landscape rectangular cartouche frame of interlaced cream strapwork, the bands curling into scrolls and cut-leather tabs over a dark hatched ground, with a small rosette at each corner, a fleur-de-lis style finial at the middle of every side and a thin double rule around the transparent rectangular opening; fine golden-brown leafy vine tendrils spread outward from the whole outer edge. Pen and ink in brown and black on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete frame; scale proportionally as one image, it has no tile and is not sliced for border-image.
The opening is the central rectangle inside the double rule; keep content clear of the hatched inner band.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Title cartouche with horned hybrids and bears
assets.description: A wide, symmetrical etched cartouche frieze. The centre is an open blank field bounded by leafy scrolls, with a bearded mask at the top and a knot of leaves at the bottom. To each side a horned, winged female hybrid whose lower body turns into acanthus scroll leans toward the field, a cluster of grapes hanging beside her; at either end a bear bites the scaly dragon-headed terminal of the outer volute, and the frieze ends in fish-scaled curls. Dark brown ink on a transparent background; the faint paper tone of the plate is kept at low opacity, and the title lettering in the field was removed.
usage_notes: The open centre field is a title plaque about a third of the width wide; set a line of text in it.
Symmetrical about the field; either half with its bear crops out as an end ornament.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged bearded masks
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the left end a round bearded mask with feathered wings behind it faces left; at the right end a second winged bearded mask faces right. Between them run two large curled acanthus volutes, a folded leaf cup at the centre and two trumpet-shaped bell flowers hanging on stalks, all joined by one stem. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the masks and scroll alone.
Both ends terminate in a mask, so it does not repeat; use it once as a header or footer band.

assets.title: Grapevine frieze with central knot
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A single vine stem runs the whole length and is knotted into a loop at the centre; along it hang four large lobed vine leaves, two bunches of grapes (one left of centre, one right of centre) and curling tendrils with small buds. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the vine alone.
The only frieze of the sheet without a creature; the plainest choice for a text divider.

assets.title: Frieze of a horned dragon with a flowering tail
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A dragon fills the left half, facing left with open jaws, a long forked tongue, a curled horn and a small budding sprig in front of its snout; its feathered body has a raised wing and two clawed feet. Its tail flows right into a foliate scroll of acanthus volutes and leaf sprays ending in a small bud at the right end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragon and scroll alone.
The dragon faces left; mirror the band for a right-facing use.

assets.title: Frieze with back-to-back bearded heads
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the centre two bearded male heads in profile sit back to back, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; each beard flows into a trumpet-shaped horn. Vine stems with trefoil leaves and clover-like leaflets curl out from the heads to a five-petalled flower at each end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the heads and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the paired heads, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two horned dragons and twin flowers
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two scaly winged dragons with long curled horns and open mouths lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; their tails curl inward into scrolls that each hold a five-petalled flower, and a fleur-de-lis-shaped tie joins the two scrolls at the centre. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragons and flowers alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two human-headed winged creatures
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged creatures with curly-haired human heads, feathered bodies, clawed legs and long scaly tails lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right. Their tails loop toward the centre, where two small crested dragon heads face a knotted tie topped by a fleur-de-lis. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the creatures alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged beasts and a central face
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A frontal human face with leafy hair sits at the centre between two feathered volutes. On each side a lean horned, dog-like winged beast runs outward, the left one facing left and the right one facing right with open mouth, and a small leafy sprig grows between each beast and the face. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the beasts and face alone.
Symmetrical about the central face, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged putti holding a bowl
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged putti face each other at the centre and together hold a shallow bowl from which leaves sprout; their lower bodies turn into feathered, scaly scrolls that run outward to the ends, where they finish in curled acanthus leaves, a tendril with buds at the left and a leafy terminal at the right. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putti and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the bowl, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze of a scroll ending in a horned bearded head
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. From a lobed leaf with berried tendrils at the left, a stem curls through acanthus volutes and a looped, scalloped feathered stem into a hairy winged creature whose body fills the right half; its long-bearded head with a curled horn is at the right end, facing right with open mouth. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the scroll alone.
Reads from the leaf at the left to the head at the right; mirror it for a left-pointing use.

assets.title: Candelabra grotesque with two satyrs
assets.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical etched candelabrum seen frontally. From the bottom up, a stepped plinth carries an acanthus base with two bearded masks, a blank tablet, two winged dolphins, a fluted basin, two standing satyrs each raising a flaming cup with a bird-headed grotesque at either side, a second basin, two crouching bat-winged grotesques, two more dolphins, a plumed stem, a small nude figure between two balusters, and a crossbar hung with swags and flaming torches. Brownish-grey ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.5); it suits a page margin, a column or a vertical separator at full height.
The blank tablet above the base can carry a short caption.

assets.title: Thistle panel with birds
assets.description: An upright rectangular etched panel inside a thin black frame line.
