Thick, white thistle stems with spiked lobed leaves and small thistle heads curl and interlace over a dark cross-hatched ground; a bird holding a sprig flies in at the top left, a crane-like bird stands at the top right, a third bird perches at the lower left, and a few open five-petalled flowers fill the corners. The monogram DH is cut into the stem at the bottom centre. Black, grey and white; the panel is opaque with its ground kept, and only the margin outside the frame line is transparent.
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground and frame line; place it as a picture or plate, not as a cut-out.
The DH monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Frieze of a winged putto with a shield and braided scroll
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A winged putto lies at the left end facing left and holds up an empty curved-top shield; its lower body turns into two intertwined, braided stems that run to the right through a leafy calyx flower and finish at the right end in a fanned leaf terminal with a small spiral. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putto and scroll alone.
The shield at the left is blank and can carry a small monogram or device.

assets.title: Acanthus corner, bottom-left
assets.description: A bottom-left corner of thin red and gold rules with a tall red acanthus leaf rising up the left rule, blue and gold leaves at the join, gold scrolls, green ivy leaves and red finials at the ends of both rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges.
The red leaf climbs upward along the left rule.
Use as a whole image; it is not a rotation of another corner and not a border-image atlas.

assets.title: Acanthus corner, bottom-right
assets.description: A bottom-right corner of thin red and gold rules with blue and gold acanthus leaves at the join, a red leaf rising up the right rule to a red finial, green ivy leaves along both rules, gold scrolls and a red finial at the left end, on a transparent background.

assets.title: Acanthus corner, top-right

assets.title: Floral frame

assets.title: Polyhymnia playing a portative organ
assets.description: The muse Polyhymnia, a veiled young woman in a cream gown, pink sleeves and a blue mantle, sits on a stone bench and plays a portative organ, head bowed and turned to the right, before a garden and a hilly landscape with a castle. The arched scene is set in an opaque gold border strewn with pink roses, blue cornflowers, pansies, white acanthus sprays, butterflies and a bird; only the outer edge is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature for the Polyhymnia app; the painted border is part of the image, keep proportions.

assets.title: Title ivy, closing sprig
assets.description: A small closing sprig for a heading, of blue, gold and red acanthus leaves on a stem that runs from a green ivy leaf at the left to a gold three-lobed cap at the right. It sits after the last letter of a title, the cap outward; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Place after the last letter of a heading; the matching opening bracket goes before the first letter.

assets.title: Title ivy, opening bracket
assets.description: A large opening bracket for a heading, of blue and red acanthus leaves curling to the right around a gold three-lobed cap, with two green ivy leaves on short stems. It sits before the first letter of a title and faces right into the text; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Place before the first letter of a heading; the matching closing sprig goes after the last letter.
Cut from the left half of the original two-piece canvas; the two pieces were drawn together and share scale and baseline.

assets.title: Vertical margin sprig
assets.description: A slender upright sprig on a gold stem: a blue acanthus leaf curling to the right near the top, a red leaf curling to the left below it, three green ivy leaves, a red bud at the top and a curled gold root at the bottom, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament; keep it upright, it has no rule or repeat unit.

assets.title: Two linked medallions with winged children on clouds
assets.description: Two engraved circular medallion rings joined side by side by a leaf clasp, each tied with a leaf knot at top and bottom. In the left ring a naked winged putto sits on clouds facing right with a flaming torch and a bow, a quiver beside him; in the right ring a robed winged child sits on clouds facing left, one arm outstretched, holding a tall cross on a staff. Acanthus tendrils spring from the four corners and two small serpent-like creatures curl under the rings. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the forms, the field inside and around the rings is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete piece; the two children are also available on their own without the rings, as separate assets of this set.
Wide (about 1.6:1); it reads as a headpiece or a paired-roundel ornament.

assets.title: Winged child with torch and bow on clouds
assets.description: A naked winged putto sits on a rounded bank of clouds, body turned three-quarter to the viewer and head turned to the right. His raised left hand holds a flaming torch, his right hand holds a bow across his lap, a tubular quiver on a strap lies beside his right leg and a globe rests in the clouds at the lower left. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the figure and clouds, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left medallion of the double-medallion ornament; the clouds give it a soft rounded base, so it sits on a line or in a roundel.
Faces right; pairs with the cross-bearing child, which faces left.

assets.title: Winged child with a cross on clouds
assets.description: A winged child in a loose robe sits on a bank of clouds, seen three-quarter from behind and facing left. The left arm stretches straight out to the left across the face, the right hand holds a tall thin cross on a staff that leans to the upper left, and one bare foot rests on the cloud below. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the figure, robe and clouds, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the right medallion of the double-medallion ornament; the clouds give it a soft rounded base, so it sits on a line or in a roundel.
Faces left; pairs with the torch-and-bow child, which faces right.

assets.title: Oak leaf corner with a long stem and acorn
assets.description: An L-shaped engraved ornament for a top-right corner. A dense mass of large, deeply lobed oak leaves, folded and interlaced with looping ribbon-like stems, fills the top-left arm; from the vertex at the top right a long curling stem descends the right side, throwing off smaller lobed leaves and curls, and ends at the bottom in a single acorn in its scaly cup. Black ink with fine hatched shading; the pale grey-cream paper tone is kept inside the leaves and stems, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Fits a top-right corner as engraved (leaves along the top, stem down the right side); mirror or rotate it for the other corners.
The leaf mass alone crops out as a square ornament, and the stem with the acorn as a vertical sprig.

assets.title: Acanthus panel with two lovers
assets.description: A large horizontal engraved panel filled edge to edge with curling acanthus stems and lobed leaves. At the top centre a seated couple, a woman in a tall hennin with a small dog on her lap and a young man in a cap, under a banderole inscribed with the artist's name. Among the scrolls are two birds at the top corners, nude figures climbing and riding the stems, a bearded man with a spear at the right, a youth rising from a tuft of grass at the bottom, a fox at the lower left, a man raising a cup at the lower right and two hanging pod finials. Dark brown ink on cream, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel with no frame line; its outer leaves are the natural edge, so it can sit directly on a page.
The signature banderole above the couple is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Tree of Jesse in an acanthus scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal engraved panel. The bearded Jesse lies asleep at the bottom centre, and from his body a stem rises and branches into curling acanthus scrolls that carry twelve crowned kings in long robes, seated, kneeling or climbing in the loops of the stems; one at the right of centre plays a harp, others hold an orb, a book or flower heads. At the top centre the crowned Virgin sits with the Child on her lap. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper, no frame line, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel; Jesse and the rising stem are the centre of the composition, so keep the whole width or crop symmetrically.

assets.title: Circular acanthus wreath
assets.description: A ring-shaped engraved wreath of curling acanthus stems and lobed leaves around an open circular centre. Two thick stems run around the inside of the ring and are bound together at the top and at the bottom. Flower heads, buds, a netted fruit at the lower right and a large blossom at the right sit among the scrolls, which end in small leaf tips around the outer edge. No figures or masks. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper; the centre and the background are transparent.
usage_notes: The open centre is about half the diameter of the ring; in the print it holds the two musicians at the well, so place that scene or a roundel of similar size inside it.
A circular ring, not a nine-slice frame; it is placed as an image, not as a CSS border-image.

assets.title: Two musicians at a well
assets.description: An engraved scene of two musicians seated on stone blocks on either side of an octagonal well. At the left a barefoot young man with curly hair in a short tunic plays a lute with a plectrum, facing right; at the right a woman in a long gown with long hair plays a harp, facing left. Between them a small Gothic canopy on four posts with a cross finial and a perched bird rises over the water, a vessel hangs from a tripod above it, a bird drinks at the rim, and two potted trees stand behind. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The centre of the same print; it fits inside the open ring of the circular wreath at about half the wreath's width.

assets.title: Two añafil players in a framed miniature
assets.description: Two seated musicians in red and purple robes, on gold chairs inside a blue framed miniature, blow long straight gold trumpets (añafiles) hung with heraldic pennants; they face left. The frame and blue ground are part of the image; only the area outside the frame is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature with its own blue background; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

assets.title: Cattle singing at a music stand
assets.description: Three oxen and a small sheep stand on a strip of green ground and face left toward a wooden music stand holding an open score, while two small birds fly above at the right; coloured print-like line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Wide strip (about 3:1) that works as a footer or title band.
Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

assets.title: Animal musicians in a framed miniature
assets.description: A complete framed miniature on a diapered blue, gold and pink ground: on green grass a hooded dog-like animal sings from an open book on a lectern, a spotted creature plays a fiddle, a donkey plays a portative organ, white geese gather in the middle, a red fox plays beside a drum, a small white animal rings bells on a stand at the right and a harp lies on the ground. Fully opaque, with pink and green border columns; nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete opaque scene including its patterned ground and borders; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
Small master (720 px wide); do not display it larger than its pixel size.
Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

assets.title: Rosselli vertical foliate ornament
assets.description: The complete engraved vertical ornament from the left of the sheet, about five times taller than wide. A central stem carries three lily-like palmettes on banded knots, flanked at every level by mirrored acanthus leaves that curl outward into C-scrolls and small berry sprigs; a small finial closes the top and the lowest leaves close the bottom. Dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings between the leaves and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: Whole strip with its original end terminals; it does not repeat, so use rosselli-foliate-border for a tiled run.
The sheet pairs it as the vertical side of a page frame with the mask frieze running horizontally and a roundel in each corner.

assets.title: Rosselli foliate border, one repeat
assets.description: One repeat of the engraved vertical foliate ornament, cut so the top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. A central lily-like palmette on a banded stem is flanked by mirrored acanthus leaves that curl outward into C-scrolls, with small berry sprigs at the two sides; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings between the leaves and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from rosselli-foliate-strip at one repeat (438 px of the 1400 px strip); interior pixels are unchanged and only a two-pixel collar at the join is averaged.
Repeats along its length; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes this repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The corner is not a recovered historical motif.

assets.title: Rosselli mask frieze
assets.description: The complete engraved frieze from the right of the sheet, about five times longer than wide, stored upright as on the sheet so the masks lie on their side. Along its length four bearded masks in beaded crowns with plumes of acanthus leaves alternate with heart-shaped foliate cartouches and scrolling leaves, a fifth mask is cut off at the top end, and a chain of small rosettes runs along the right edge; both ends stop on cut foliage. Dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: The frieze is horizontal by design; rotate it 90 degrees clockwise to bring the masks upright with the rosette chain at the bottom edge.
Whole strip; its ends are not a seamless join, so use rosselli-mask-border for a tiled run.
The sheet pairs it as the horizontal side of a page frame with the vertical foliate ornament and a roundel in each corner.

assets.title: Rosselli mask frieze, one repeat
assets.description: One repeat of the engraved frieze of masks and foliage, cut so the ends join seamlessly when stacked. A bearded mask in a beaded crown with a plume of acanthus leaves fills the lower half and a heart-shaped foliate cartouche with scrolling leaves the upper half, with a chain of small rosettes along the right edge; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent. Stored upright as on the sheet, so the masks lie on their side; the frieze reads upright when run horizontally.
usage_notes: Cropped from rosselli-mask-strip at one repeat (290 px of the 1400 px strip); interior pixels are unchanged and only a two-pixel collar at the join is averaged.
The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along the master's height, or use rosselli-mask-strip for a long run.
The frame atlas composes this repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The corner is not a recovered historical motif.

assets.title: Rosselli roundel, palmettes and inner ring
assets.description: The engraved roundel from the lowest of the sheet's four square corner panels, cut to the circle without the panel's ruled square. Inside an egg-and-dart rim a central rosette sits in a fluted boss ringed by a second thin circle; acanthus palmettes with a bud reach out to the four cardinal points, and shell fans with small scrolling leaves fill the four diagonals; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four corner roundels of the sheet's page-frame scheme; the four are interchangeable and read as a set at the corners of a frame made from the two strips.
Closest to rosselli-roundel-top, which lacks the inner ring.

assets.title: Rosselli roundel, masks and leaf tufts
assets.description: The engraved roundel from the second of the sheet's four square corner panels, cut to the circle without the panel's ruled square. Inside an egg-and-dart rim a central rosette sits in a fluted boss; at the four cardinal points a shell-topped cup holds a small human mask over paired C-scrolls, and tufts of acanthus leaves tied with a band fill the four diagonals; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four corner roundels of the sheet's page-frame scheme; the four are interchangeable and read as a set at the corners of a frame made from the two strips.

assets.title: Rosselli roundel, fluted cups and leaf tufts
assets.description: The engraved roundel from the third of the sheet's four square corner panels, cut to the circle without the panel's ruled square. Inside an egg-and-dart rim a central rosette sits in a fluted boss; at the four cardinal points a fluted shell-topped cup with a small acanthus bud stands over paired C-scrolls, and tufts of acanthus leaves tied with a band fill the four diagonals; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four corner roundels of the sheet's page-frame scheme; the four are interchangeable and read as a set at the corners of a frame made from the two strips.
Closest to rosselli-roundel-second, which has masks in the cardinal cups instead of buds.

assets.title: Rosselli roundel, palmettes and shells

assets.title: Arched lace point with checker fans and spoked star
assets.description: An arched lace point. A central square framed by rows of sawtooth triangles holds a circle with eight spokes and a dotted scalloped rim. Above it rises a semicircular checkerboard fan under lobed scallops with pointed tips; smaller checkerboard fans sit at the left and right, and a small spoked wheel stands at each corner of the square. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.
The checkerboard fans and the corner wheels read well on their own at small sizes.

assets.title: Arched lace point with compass star
assets.description: An arched lace point built on an eight-pointed compass star. Two concentric rings enclose a sunburst of triangular rays around a small lobed rosette; eight long pointed rays with net-hatched fill extend beyond the rings, and between them lobed scallops filled with fish-scale lace end in small pointed tips, the topmost rising as a spire. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with petal rosette and spokes
assets.description: An arched lace point. A ladder-like beaded ring encloses a rosette of twelve lobed petals around a small gridded centre; eight straight spokes run out from the ring to an outer beaded arch set with sawtooth triangles. Five lobed semicircles with dotted edges and small triangles sit around the arch and a pointed spire tops it. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with pointed quatrefoil
assets.description: An arched lace point. Inside a tall beaded arch a quatrefoil of four long pointed petals filled with fish-scale lace meets at a small gridded centre, with crossed sawtooth rays between the petals forming a four-pointed star. Five lobed semicircles filled with scale lace crown the arch, each capped by a pointed tip, the top one a spire; dotted edges run along the rims. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with four floral diamonds
assets.description: An arched lace point. Under a beaded arch four diamond-shaped medallions are set two by two, each a straight-lined lozenge with a small lobed flower at its centre and lobed sprays at its points; four net-filled triangles meet at the middle. A dotted semicircle with sawtooth teeth and a tall spire tops the arch, and sawtooth bands with lobed scallops hang at both sides. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with large rosette
assets.description: An arched lace point. A large rosette of eight broad rounded petals in two layers, their rims scalloped and dotted, fills a beaded arch around a small gridded centre; eight pointed rays run out between the petals. Around the arch sit lobed scallops filled with scale lace and triangular points, with a pointed spire at the top; vertical beaded bands with sawtooth edges stand at the lower corners. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with spoked wheel
assets.description: An arched lace point. A wheel of about twenty-four thin spokes radiates from a small gridded centre to a dotted scalloped rim, with four longer pointed rays on the axes, all inside a beaded arch. Lobed scallops filled with scale lace, sawtooth triangles and a pointed spire surround the arch; small lobed arcs hang at the lower sides. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Arched lace point with wheels and star
assets.description: An arched lace point. Under a beaded arch a central star of eight triangular rays is surrounded by four lobed quatrefoils on the axes and four spoked wheels with dotted rims on the diagonals; the lower two wheels are cut by the lower edge. Around the arch run rows of sawtooth triangles and lobed scallops, with a scale-filled spire at the top. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut straight along the lower edge.
usage_notes: The straight lower edge is where the printed cell ends, not a finished border; butt it against a rule or page edge, or hang one of the set's drop pieces below it.

assets.title: Hanging bell drop
assets.description: A small hanging lace drop. Two pierced bands run down in a V from the upper corners to a point, with short sprigs on either side and a stem with a small cross at the top; below the point hangs a bell-shaped pendant filled with a square lattice and ending in a looped base. A fragment of a neighbouring curved band remains at the upper right. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: A hanging drop cut where it left its medallion; place it directly under a flat-bottomed arched medallion of this set.
Crop away the loose band fragment at the upper right if the drop is used alone.

assets.title: Hanging lace drop with pointed loop
assets.description: A hanging lace drop. From a ring with crossed sprigs at the top, cut by the top edge, two pierced bands curve out and down to form a pointed loop; inside it a small bell-shaped tassel hangs over an arrow-shaped leaf pointing down. Smaller curled pierced bands hang at either side and the loop ends in a small forked tip. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: A hanging drop cut where it left its medallion; place it directly under a flat-bottomed arched medallion of this set.

assets.title: Inverted lace triangle with lattice flower
assets.description: An inverted triangular lace drop. Two pierced bands with barbed outer edges descend to a bottom point ending in a small tassel; inside, a flower of six pierced lattice petals surrounds a ring with a cross, and a lattice bud hangs from it on a vertical stem. The upper petals and the band ends are cut by the top edge. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: A hanging drop cut where it left its medallion; place it directly under a flat-bottomed arched medallion of this set.

assets.title: Lace roundel with eight-pointed star
assets.description: A small lace roundel. Two overlapping four-pointed stars form an eight-pointed star inside a circle; a ring of small arcs and triangular teeth surrounds it. The roundel sits in a diagonal lattice with small roundels at the crossings, and a straight page rule runs along the right edge; fragments of the neighbouring cells remain at all four edges. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Crop to the circle for a clean roundel; the lattice and the rule at the right edge belong to the surrounding page cell.

assets.title: Small lace triangle finial
assets.description: A very small triangular lace finial. A triangle outlined by dotted, barbed bands holds a vertical stem crossed by a horizontal bar with short leaves, like a small fir sprig, with a lobed tip at the apex. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Use at or below its native size; the drawing is only about a hundred pixels wide.

assets.title: Square lace cell with four-pointed star
assets.description: A small square lace cell. Straight bars bound the cell on the left, top and bottom, with a thinner partial bar at the right; inside, four long triangular rays on the diagonals meet at the centre, and four lobed petals sit between them on the axes, with small ties at the corners. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The right-hand bar is incomplete; crop inside the bars to use the star alone.

assets.title: Square lace panel with cross medallion
assets.description: A square lace panel of nine cells divided by straight lines. The central cell holds a medallion of four pointed petals in a cross around a dotted ring with a small ring at the centre, with lobed scale lace filling the quadrants. The side cells are split on the diagonals with sawtooth triangles and a small spoked roundel each, and the corner cells hold lobed quarter-circles. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut at all four edges.
usage_notes: Cut from a continuous grid, so the outer cells are incomplete; crop to the central cell for a clean medallion, or keep the whole for a lace-panel texture.

assets.title: Square lace panel with pierced-petal medallion
assets.description: A square lace panel. In the central cell eight narrow pierced petals with dotted edges radiate from a ring holding a small eight-lobed rosette; four large overlapping looped arcs enclose them, and pierced fir-like sprigs point outward on the diagonals and axes. Straight lines divide the panel, and lobed quarter-circles of scale lace fill the corners. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut at all four edges.
usage_notes: Cut from a continuous grid, so the outer cells are incomplete; crop to the central cell for a clean medallion, or keep the whole for a lace-panel texture.

assets.title: Square lace panel with petal rosette and fans
assets.description: A square lace panel of cells divided by straight lines. The central cell holds a rosette of many narrow petals radiating from a dotted ring, with net-filled triangles pointing into its four corners and a dotted lobed rim. Each side cell holds a semicircular fan filled with rows of sawtooth triangles and a scalloped rim, and the corner cells show lobed quarter-circles. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut at all four edges.
usage_notes: Cut from a continuous grid, so the outer cells are incomplete; crop to the central cell for a clean medallion, or keep the whole for a lace-panel texture.

assets.title: Square lace panel with triangle star and ovals
assets.description: A square lace panel. A central roundel holds an eight-pointed star of triangles inside a dotted ring; straight double bands with sawtooth edges cross it on the axes and thin lines on the diagonals. Eight oval pierced medallions with central slits sit around the roundel, and net-filled triangles point in from the corners. Tan printed lace lines on a transparent ground, cut at all four edges.
usage_notes: Cut from a continuous grid, so the outer cells are incomplete; crop to the central cell for a clean medallion, or keep the whole for a lace-panel texture.

assets.title: Battle frieze with charging cavalry
assets.description: A wide etched landscape band of a battle. At the right a mass of cavalry charges to the left under raised lances and pennants, horses rearing over fallen men; at the left scattered foot soldiers and skirmishing riders fight across open ground; clouds of gun smoke drift above both halves and a tree closes each end. Dark brown-black ink with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the figures and the ground; the sky and everything outside the drawn edge are transparent.
usage_notes: Use once as a horizontal header or footer band; both ends are closed by a tree and it does not repeat.

assets.title: Four star flowers on a branching leafy stem
assets.description: A branching stem carrying four six-petalled star-shaped flowers, two on the upper branches and two on the lower, and one closed bud, with long narrow leaves that curve outward and droop at the tips; the stem is cut square at the foot. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Narcissus cluster between two sword-shaped leaves
assets.description: A cluster of five small cupped star flowers of narcissus form opening at the top of two tall folded sword-shaped leaves that cross as they rise; a short second stem at the lower right carries one nodding flower and a single leaf. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Landscape frieze with courting pairs and a flock
assets.description: A long horizontal landscape frieze. At the left a seated woman and a standing man in a plumed hat clasp hands under a tree, each holding a tall staff, with a dog and a grazing flock beside them; across the open middle ground stand six more courting pairs, one woman holding a man by his long hat plume, with a leafy tree behind them; at the right a flock of birds flies over a hilltop town with towers and a wind-blown shrub closes the scene. Streaky clouds above, hatched ground and reclining figures below. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete frieze; every pair, animal, tree and shrub in it is also published as its own crop in this group.
The streaky clouds and the faint sky speckle are part of the print; crop below the horizon for a clean ground-level band.

assets.title: Courting pair, man seen from behind
assets.description: A small standing pair: at the left a man in a short cloak and breeches seen from behind with his head turned to the right, at the right a woman in a long gown with a broad collar turned three-quarters towards him; their arms meet between them. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Woman holding a man by his hat plume
assets.description: A woman at the left in a long gown and cap reaches up and grips the long plume of the hat worn by a man at the right, who stands with ragged sleeves and breeches, legs apart, facing her; the plume bridges the two heads. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Seated woman and standing man with staffs
assets.description: A woman in a long dress sits at the left holding a tall staff upright in her left hand and takes the hand of a man standing at the right, seen from behind and turned towards her; he wears a plumed hat and a belted doublet and grips a second tall staff with his outstretched right arm, so the two staffs lean outward like a V. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The dog that stands beside this pair in the frieze is published separately as small-curled-tailed-dog.

assets.title: Crown imperial with drooping bell flowers
assets.description: A crown imperial: a thick straight stem topped by a tuft of long upright and spreading leaves, beneath which a whorl of large drooping bell-shaped flowers hangs all round the stem with their stamens showing below the petals. The stem is cut square at the foot and the leaf tuft is cut flat at the top. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Cup-shaped bloom with a dark centre on a straight stem
assets.description: A single upright bloom whose ruffled petals curl around a dense dark cross-hatched centre, set on a long straight stem with a single narrow leaf rising from the left. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Cupped flowers and buds on a tall leafy stem
assets.description: A tall upright stem with three open five-petalled cup-shaped flowers, two at the top and one at the right, three closed buds, narrow serrated leaves along the stem and a pair of broad serrated leaves at the foot; the stem is cut square at the bottom. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Five tulips with broad curled leaves
assets.description: Five tulips on long stems rising from one foot: two tall closed blooms at the top left and centre, two opening blooms at the left and right and a small bud at the lower right, with three broad curled basal leaves twisting outward. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Grazing sheep seen from behind
assets.description: A single grazing sheep seen from behind and slightly from the side, its head lowered to the ground at the left, its rounded fleeced hindquarters at the right and four legs beneath. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Mounted hunter on a rearing horse with raised arm
assets.description: A hunter in a plumed hat and flying cloak sits a rearing horse facing left, his right arm raised and holding a long thin rod; the horse's forelegs are lifted and its tail streams behind. Cut from the right foreground of the stag hunt frieze. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Four tulips with folded basal leaves
assets.description: Four tulips on long slender stems from a single foot: a tall pointed bloom at the top, two fuller blooms at the left and right and a closed bud at the lower left, with long folded basal leaves, one of them twisting up to the right. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Large double bloom on a curving stem
assets.description: A large double flower head with many ruffled, overlapping petals, turned to the left at the top; the stem arches down to the right, carrying a pair of narrow lance-shaped leaves halfway down and a whorl of deeply lobed leaves at the base. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Tall tulip with pointed petals and one folded leaf
assets.description: A single tulip with pointed, slightly flared petals on a long straight stem, with one long folded leaf rising beside it from the foot. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Tulip with broad petals on a long bare stem
assets.description: A single tulip with broad, loosely opening petals leaning to the left at the top of a long bare stem that runs straight down to the foot without a leaf. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Leafy tree with a walking pair beneath
assets.description: A broad-crowned leafy tree on a thin trunk rising from a hatched bank, with a lower bush at the left; beneath the crown a woman and a man carrying a stick over his shoulder walk to the right, and a dark hatched mound closes the base at the right. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The pair alone is small-contacting-pair-beside-central-tree; crop the crown above their heads for a tree on its own.

assets.title: Leaping stag with a hound at its heels
assets.description: An antlered stag leaps to the left with its forelegs tucked and its hind legs stretched out behind; beneath the hind legs a hound runs left with its head raised toward the stag's belly and its tail curled up. Cut from the stag hunt frieze. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Mounted hunter on a galloping horse
assets.description: A hunter in a hat with one arm flung up rides a horse at full gallop to the left, its legs stretched fore and aft and its tail flying; a thin rod trails from the rider's hand. Cut from the stag hunt frieze, where he rides closest to the stag. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Running hound with raised head and curled tail
assets.description: A slim hound runs to the left with its head lifted and mouth open, ears back, forelegs reaching forward, hind legs stretched out behind and a long tail curled over its back. Cut from the stag hunt frieze, where it runs beside the stag; tiny in the source. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Tree with hanging foliage over a hatched bank
assets.description: A tall vertical crop from the left end of the frieze: a tree trunk at the upper left with sprays of foliage hanging to the right, above a steep bank of diagonal hatching; at the foot of the bank a small animal lies with its head raised. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The reclining animal at the foot is also published alone as small-reclining-curled-tailed-animal.

assets.title: Stretched running hound with hooked tail
assets.description: A lean hound at full stretch running to the left, ears pricked, body low and legs extended fore and aft, with its tail raised in a hook. Cut from the stag hunt frieze, where it runs between the riders; the smallest piece of the plate. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Nodding bloom on an arching stem
assets.description: A single bell-shaped bloom with pointed, slightly flared petals hanging downward to the left from the end of a stem that arches over from the right; a dotted centre shows inside the open mouth. Two narrow curving leaves rise from the base of the stem at the lower right. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Opening bloom tilted left on a tall straight stem
assets.description: A large bloom with broad, wavy petals just opening, tilted towards the upper left on a long straight stem; a whorl of lance-shaped leaves spreads from below the flower, two to the left and three fanning out to the right. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Two roses on one branch with a leafy shoot
assets.description: Two double roses on a single prickly branch: a fully open bloom at the bottom seen face on, its stamens at the centre, above a pair of serrated leaves; a second bloom higher up to the right seen from the side; and a shoot of five serrated leaflets branching off to the upper left. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Reclining foreground figures
assets.description: A low, loosely etched group from the foreground of the frieze: a few reclining forms drawn with long shared strokes, reading as one or two figures lying on the ground with a stick beside them, too small in the source to resolve further. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Wind-blown shrub
assets.description: A low shrub of tufted leaf clusters on thin branches, all leaning to the left as if blown by the wind, over a base of close diagonal hatching; from the right end of the frieze. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Low running hound with turned head
assets.description: A hound runs to the left with its body low and stretched, its head turned slightly toward the viewer with both eyes showing, ears flapping and a short tail curled up. Cut from the stag hunt frieze, near the right-hand rider; tiny in the source. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Walking pair, man holding his hat
assets.description: A woman in a long gown at the left and a man at the right in a doublet and breeches walk together towards the right; the man holds his broad hat in his lowered right hand and turns his head back to her. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Open flower on a bent stem with long leaves
assets.description: A single open flower turned to the right at the end of a stem that bends over at the top, its petals flaring and a curled stamen reaching out; from the foot rise five long narrow wavy leaves fanning left and right, and one broad serrated leaf lies at the lower right. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Standing pair facing the viewer
assets.description: Two small figures standing close together and facing the viewer: a woman at the left in a long gown and a man at the right in a plumed hat and long coat, their near arms linked. Dark brown etched ink, very grainy at this size, on a transparent background.

assets.title: Walking pair with a stick over the shoulder
assets.description: A woman at the left in a long gown and a man at the right in a hat, carrying a stick over his shoulder, walk side by side towards the right. Dark brown etched ink, heavily grainy at this size, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The same pair stands under the tree in leafy-tree-on-mound-with-contacting-figures, which gives it a ground.

assets.title: Standing dog with a curled tail
assets.description: A small dog standing in profile, facing right, with a shaggy head, a body ribbed with short dark strokes and a tail curled up over its back. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Stands beside courting-pair-with-two-staffs in the frieze.

assets.title: Low shrub tufts on a hatched mound
assets.description: A low, wide strip of foreground ground: tufts of leaves over a mound of horizontal and diagonal hatching, with small bushes rising at the left and the right. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Small tulip on a slanting stem with a bent leaf
assets.description: A small tulip with pointed petals on a stem that slants up to the left, with one long leaf beside the stem and a second leaf bent sharply over near the foot. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Small mounted hunter on a prancing horse
assets.description: A small hunter in a plumed hat on a prancing horse facing left, one foreleg raised, with a long weapon slanting back over his shoulder. The most distant of the three riders, cut from the middle of the stag hunt frieze and tiny in the source. Dark brown-black etched line, cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outline, transparent ground.

assets.title: Reclining dog with a curled tail
assets.description: A small animal lying on the ground, facing left with its head raised and a tail curling up at the right; most likely a dog, but the print is too small to be sure. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Closed tulip bud between pointed leaves
assets.description: A closed tulip bud on a short straight stem, flanked by four long pointed leaves that rise from the foot, two curving up at the left and two at the right. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Standing courting pair, man gesturing right
assets.description: A woman at the left in a long gown, turned to the right, stands beside a man in a plumed hat, doublet and breeches who faces the viewer and points away to the right with his outstretched arm. Dark brown etched ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Small star flower on a slender stem
assets.description: A small star-shaped flower seen from the front at the top of a long slender stem with one joint, and one folded leaf rising on the right from a sheath near the foot. Dark gray-brown ink only: the paper between the strokes is transparent, so the piece is open line work rather than a filled cutout, with a softer edge than the rest of the plate.

assets.title: Stag hunt frieze with three mounted hunters
assets.description: A wide etched landscape band of a stag hunt running from right to left. A stag leaps left at the left of centre with a hound at its heels; two mounted hunters gallop after it across open ground and a third on a rearing horse in the right foreground raises a long thin rod; two more hounds race between them. Bushes and trees close each end, a town with towers sits on the horizon and layered clouds fill the sky. Dark brown-black ink with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the ground and figures; the sky and the outside of the band are transparent.
usage_notes: Use once as a horizontal header or footer band; it does not repeat.
The three hunters, the stag with its hound and the two other hounds are also cut out as separate pieces, so the hunt can be recomposed at any width.

assets.title: Flowering stem with tubular flowers and paired serrated leaves
assets.description: A tall upright stem with pairs of broad serrated oval leaves, whorls of tubular two-lipped flowers springing from the leaf axils and a spike of small flowers at the top; the stem is cut square at the foot. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Two open flowers over a fan of pointed leaves
assets.description: Two open five-petalled flowers, one at the left facing the viewer with a star-shaped centre and one at the right turned three-quarters, above a fan of long pointed lance leaves spreading from a single foot, with one bud between them. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Narcissus with a nodding bud on a curving stem
assets.description: A slender stem rises past one long folded leaf, bends over at the top and ends in a drooping flower in a papery sheath pointing right; a side stalk carries an open six-petalled star flower with a central cup facing the viewer. Dark brown-black etched line with the cream paper kept as an opaque fill inside the outlines; the ground outside the plant is transparent.

assets.title: Two rose stalks with a drooping bud
assets.description: Two prickly rose stalks whose stems cross: an open double rose at the top seen face on with a small centre of stamens, a second open rose at the lower right seen from the side, a drooping bud with long pointed sepals at the right, and serrated rose leaves in threes and fives at the left and along the stems. Fine etched hatching; dark brown ink on a transparent background.

assets.title: Oval chain border, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of the oval chain printed along the top of the page frame: a large horizontal oval loop followed by two small round loops, drawn as a doubled cord that crosses itself between them, over a thin rule along the bottom. Soft, heavily inked impression in dark brown-black on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.
Cut from the top band of mixed-oval-chain-and-floral-printer-frame; the bottom band of that frame is horizontal-palmettes-and-four-lobed-scroll-cycle.

assets.title: Braided knot and fleur-de-lis border, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: a quatrefoil cartouche encloses a braided knot of two diagonal dotted straps crossing at the centre, flanked left and right by a column of pointed leaves set as a cross around a fleur-de-lis, with C-scrolls and dots in the corners and half motifs cut at the top and bottom edges. Thin rules run along the top and bottom. Dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The cycle is barely longer than it is tall, so it is not declared a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along x, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Interlaced knots and four-lobed foliate scroll panel
assets.description: Complete horizontal panel from the page: at each end a tall interlaced knot of pointed straps with a small rosette outside it, and in the centre a dotted lozenge boss from which four heart-shaped lobes filled with trefoil leaves curl up and down, joined to the knots by stems with five-petalled flowers and leaf sprigs. A band of short vertical hatching between two rules closes the bottom. Heavy dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Complete strip with its own ends; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Diagonal leafy scrolls and paired rosettes, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: diagonal bands of curling leaves form a lozenge that encloses two daisy-like rosettes on leafy stems, with a column of paired C-scrolls around dots at the right, small trefoil leaves at the top and bottom edges and half rosettes cut at the edges. Thin rules run along the top and bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The cycle is barely longer than it is tall, so it is not declared a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along x, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Figure-eight loops and floral diamonds panel
assets.description: Complete horizontal panel: two diamonds enclosing eight-petalled rosettes stand side by side in the centre, with an eight-pointed leaf star between them above and below, and at each end an interlaced figure-eight loop with a curled acanthus leaf turned inward; small quatrefoils and dots fill the field. A band of short vertical hatching between two rules closes the bottom. Heavy dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Complete strip with its own ends; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Fleuron border with four-lobed scrolls, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of the wide band along the bottom of the page frame, built from printer's fleurons: units of paired leafy C-scrolls whose volutes turn toward each other into a four-lobed figure alternate with a cross-shaped unit of four leaves around a central dot. Worn, heavily inked impression in dark brown-black on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.
Cut from the bottom band of mixed-oval-chain-and-floral-printer-frame; the top band of that frame is bow-and-oval-chain-cycle.

assets.title: Chevron strapwork and eight-pointed stars, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: a lattice of interlaced angular straps with dotted terminals forms a zigzag chevron knot across the centre, flanked at the left by an eight-pointed star of pointed leaves around a dot, with half stars cut at the right, top and bottom edges. Thin rules run along the top and bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The cycle is barely longer than it is tall, so it is not declared a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along x, or use the frame atlas.

assets.title: Interlaced diamonds and rosettes, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: two chains of interlaced diamond straps run through each other across the centre and enclose a seven-petalled rosette, with a rosette above and below in the field at the right and small dots between; a double rule runs along the top and a band of short vertical hatching between two rules along the bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The cycle is barely longer than it is tall, so it is not declared a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along x, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Knotted straps with flowers and leaves
assets.description: A section of a large knotwork page: an upright figure-eight loop of doubled strap at the left and a braided square knot at the right, linked by looped straps, with five-petalled flowers, curled leaves and sprigs filling the gaps; a vertical braided band is cut along the left edge and a further loop is cut at the right edge. Heavy dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Not a complete piece: straps run off the left and right edges, so crop or mask it at a strap crossing.

assets.title: Lattice knot and palmette border, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: a square lattice knot of dotted straps with looped corners at the left and an upright palmette at the right, its two volutes curling outward from a bar at the base beneath a stepped crest, joined by small loops; paired C-scrolls around dots fill the sides, a scalloped leaf band runs along the bottom and half crests are cut at the top and bottom edges. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: The cycle is barely longer than it is tall, so it is not declared a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along x, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Looped straps and cross-flower diamonds, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: an interlaced strap with looped ends and dotted bands alternates with a square set on its corner that holds a four-petalled cross flower around a dot, the strap looping through the square's corners; dots fill the field, a thin rule runs along the top and a band of short vertical hatching between two rules along the bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Floral wave strip with central knot
assets.description: Complete thin strip: an interlaced lozenge knot of straps in the centre, from which a wavy stem scrolls out to each side carrying curled leaves, five-petalled flowers and dots, each end turning down into a leaf scroll; the two halves mirror each other. A thin rule runs along the bottom. Dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Complete strip with its own ends; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Printer's frame of oval chain and fleurons
assets.description: The complete rectangular frame printed around the page, with its interior cleared: an oval chain of doubled cord along the top with a small asterisk in it, a column of leafy scroll fleurons down each side and a wider band of paired-scroll and four-leaf fleurons along the bottom. The four sides do not match and the bands run slightly uneven. Worn, heavily inked impression in dark brown-black; inside and outside the frame transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed frame: scale it as a whole and place content in the transparent interior; the four sides differ, so it is not a border-image.
For a band of any length use bow-and-oval-chain-cycle (the top band) or horizontal-palmettes-and-four-lobed-scroll-cycle (the bottom band).

assets.title: Chain links with leaf scrolls and figure-eight knots, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border: two interlocking rings joined by dotted oval chain links run across the centre, with a pair of curled leaves sprouting up and down from the join, and at the right an interlaced figure-eight knot whose four loops each hold a dot; a thin rule runs along the bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.
The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Printer's frame of palmette fleurons
assets.description: The complete rectangular frame printed around the page, with its interior cleared, built from printer's fleurons of paired leafy scrolls around a small palmette repeated along all four sides; the top band is narrower than the other three and the corner joins are as printed. Heavily inked impression in dark brown-black with some broken strokes; inside and outside the frame transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed frame: scale it as a whole and place content in the transparent interior; the top band is narrower than the others, so it is not a border-image.
For a band of any length use upper-row-palmettes-and-paired-scroll-cycle (the narrow top band) or upright-palmettes-and-four-lobed-scroll-cycle (the wide band of the other sides).

assets.title: Thin strip of oval loops and star knots
assets.description: Complete thin strip: at each end a run of pointed oval loops of doubled strap with a dot inside each, and in the centre three eight-pointed star knots separated by crossed straps and dots; a short vertical bar closes the left end. Dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground, only 56 px tall.
usage_notes: Complete strip with its own ends; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Knotted diamonds with rosettes and star loops, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of a woodcut border in two registers: in each register an elongated diamond of straps with bound corners encloses a lobed rosette, set between figure-eight loops of doubled strap cut at the left and right edges, with eight-pointed leaf stars in the gaps; a heavy rule runs along the top and a thin one along the bottom. Dark brown-black line on a transparent ground.

The four corner components are mitres cut at the four phases of the cycle; only corner-top-left goes into the atlas, the other three are for hand-composed frames.

assets.title: Flower vases and braided diamonds panel
assets.description: Complete horizontal panel: two fluted vases on stepped, patterned pedestals, each holding a trefoil leaf and flowers on stems, alternate with two tall braided diamond knots of dotted straps; five-petalled flowers and dots fill the field. The left vase stands on a zigzag base and the right one on a scalloped base. Dark brown-black woodcut line on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Complete strip with its own ends; it does not repeat.

assets.title: Narrow fleuron border, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of the narrow band along the top of the page frame, built from printer's fleurons: paired leafy C-scrolls alternate with a small upright palmette between two leaves. Heavily inked impression in dark brown-black with partly broken strokes, on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.

Cut from the top band of palmette-scroll-printer-frame; the wide band of its other sides is upright-palmettes-and-four-lobed-scroll-cycle.

assets.title: Wide fleuron border, one cycle
assets.description: One cycle of the wide band along the sides and bottom of the page frame, built from printer's fleurons: a unit of four leafy C-scrolls around a small heart-shaped palmette, repeated with a flourish of leaves between. Heavily inked impression in dark brown-black with some filled-in strokes, on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes this cycle with corner-top-left, mirrored for the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Wavy rule band, three waves

assets.title: Trophy of crossed weapons
assets.description: A hanging trophy of arms engraved in brown line on a transparent background, the paper tone kept inside the outlines. A long bow curves across the bundle from upper left to lower right, several slender shafts and a hilted sword cross behind it, and a short tubular case points down at the bottom; the pieces are bound together at the centre. It was cut from the lower left of the letter B sheet, where it hung from the letter's strapwork by a cord with a tassel.
usage_notes: On the sheet this hangs at the lower left and the foliate trophy at the lower right; the two work as a matched pair flanking a title or a rule.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Bouquet of flowers and buds
assets.description: An upright bunch of flowers engraved in brown line on a transparent background. A round many-petalled bloom sits at the top, a large open flower at the left, several closed buds and long pointed leaves spreading to both sides, and a cluster of stems gathered at the bottom. The vase that held it on the letter B sheet is excluded, so the stems end in a cut at the lower edge.
usage_notes: The stems are cut flat at the bottom where the vase began; set the bouquet into a vase, a cup or behind a rule rather than leaving the cut visible.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Foliate trophy tied with a ribbon
assets.description: A hanging trophy engraved in brown line on a transparent background. A broad fluttering ribbon knotted at the centre with its two ends turned outward binds a tall feathered frond rising to the upper right, leafy sprigs spreading to the right and lower left, and two slender rods crossing behind and pointing down to the lower left. It was cut from the lower right of the letter B sheet, where it hung from the strapwork by a cord with a tassel.
usage_notes: On the sheet this hangs at the lower right and the trophy of weapons at the lower left; the two work as a matched pair flanking a title or a rule.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Hanging fruit with gourd pendant
assets.description: A hanging cluster of fruit engraved in brown line on a transparent background. A large round fruit at the upper left sits among a bunch of small round berries and short leaves, and a long smooth teardrop-shaped gourd hangs from it down the lower right, narrowing to a stalk at the top. On the letter B sheet this cluster hung from a hook at the upper left of the letter's strapwork.
usage_notes: Reads as a pendant, so hang it from a hook, a rule or the end of a banner rather than placing it on a baseline.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Winged putto holding a strap end
assets.description: A curly-haired winged putto sits facing the viewer with a cloth across his lap, his right arm stretched out to the left and his left hand raised to grip the curling end of a strapwork band at the upper right, which ends in a small animal head and has a flower-shaped pendant hanging from it; a small bud and leaf hang below his right hand. Engraved in brown line with the paper tone kept inside the figure, on a transparent background. On the letter B sheet he sits on the top of the letter's strapwork frame, which is excluded.
usage_notes: The strap end with the animal head is part of the letter's frame and is kept so the raised hand holds something; crop it at the wrist if only the figure is needed.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Seated man pulling a cord
assets.description: A nude man with a cloth draped over his shoulder and lap sits with his knees bent and his head thrown back, facing right, both arms raised to grip a thin cord that runs down past him; a small flower-shaped pendant hangs on the cord beside his hands, and a second cord with a small fruit cluster hangs below at the right. Engraved in brown line with the paper tone kept inside the figure, on a transparent background. On the letter B sheet he sits inside the lower bowl of the letter, which is excluded.
usage_notes: The cord and the hanging ornaments at the right are part of the pose; crop them away only at the hands if the figure alone is needed.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Small bird flying left
assets.description: A small bird in flight with both wings spread wide, the head turned to the left and the tail trailing to the lower right, engraved in brown tone on a transparent background. It flew beside the putto at the upper right of the letter B sheet.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Oval sunburst with open centre
assets.description: An oval ring of short radiating rays, faint gray on a transparent background, with the centre left empty. On the letter B sheet the glory surrounds the Hebrew Tetragrammaton at the upper right; the lettering is excluded here so the centre is open.
usage_notes: The open centre held a short word on the sheet; it takes a monogram or a few letters in a dark face.
The ink is very light; it only reads on a pale background.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Smoking urn on a pedestal
assets.description: A plain cylindrical urn on a round pedestal, seen from the front, with a tall column of billowing smoke rising from the flames at its mouth and curling into rounded clouds that lean to the upper left. Engraved in brown line on a transparent background; the foot of the pedestal is cut flat where it met the letter's strapwork on the letter B sheet.
usage_notes: The pedestal is cut flat at the bottom; stand it on a rule or a baseline so the cut is hidden.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Stepped ribbon meander
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border strip, taller than wide. A gold and green stepped ribbon with white edges winds in right angles around dark teal stepped blocks, with triplets of white dots on small dark red patches at the turns, on an opaque ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the right edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it along its height with background-repeat.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Green ribbon spiralling a striped rod
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border strip, about twice as tall as wide. A blue rod with white stripes runs down the centre and a green ribbon edged in gold spirals around it, with small gold C-scrolls filling the sides, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the left edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Hearts on a gold ribbon wave
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, wider than tall. A gold ribbon waves along the strip carrying two hearts outlined in white and gold, one upright and one inverted, over a dark green zigzag, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the top and bottom edges. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it along its width with background-repeat.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Blue scrolls and dots on dark red
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, wider than tall. Blue C-scrolls with white highlights swing along the strip, a wide swag on the left holding a small olive leaf, with white-centred blue dots set between and above the curls, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the top edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Red scroll cartouches on dark red
assets.description: One repeat of a long border strip, about three and a half times wider than tall. Two pointed-oval cartouches outlined in bright red are filled with symmetrical red C-scrolls and spirals around dark olive quatrefoils; a small white-ringed boss sits between them, with olive scroll tufts above and below it and olive discs in the four corners, on an opaque dark maroon ground. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Heart leaves with blue trefoils
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border strip, about twice as tall as wide. Two tan heart-shaped leaves outlined in red, blue and white hang point down in a column, each holding a blue trefoil with small gold sprigs, with white C-scrolls edging both sides, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the right edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Blue palmette column
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border strip, more than twice as tall as wide. Two blue palmettes with white-edged lobes and a central white spike rise one above the other from tan bases outlined in red, with red berries at the heart of each, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the right edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Acanthus wave scroll
assets.description: A long horizontal strip, more than five times wider than tall. A gold stem rolls in two waves along the strip, throwing off dark green acanthus leaves edged in white, with red tongue-like leaflets, small white dots and a gold spiral at each crest, on an opaque dark maroon ground. Both ends are cut by the plate edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Its ends do not match, so it neither terminates cleanly nor repeats; use it as one piece.

assets.title: Interlocking arches with striped lunettes
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, wider than tall. White arcs cross one another to form interlocking circles; the two central half-circles are filled with gold and green stripes, the outer ones with dark red and black bands, and small white dots fill the pointed spaces between the arcs, on an opaque ground. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it along its width with background-repeat.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Red and green leaf vine
assets.description: One repeat of a long border strip, more than three times wider than tall. A dark olive vine scrolls along the strip with orange-red tendrils, a green veined leaf, a small round red flower on an olive ring, a red and green bud and a red fleuron, on an opaque dark maroon ground. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Lattice with cross and saltire nodes
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, about twice as wide as tall. A green lattice edged in white encloses dark red cells cut at the corners, with red square nodes at the junctions holding alternately a white upright cross and a white saltire, on an opaque ground with a narrow orange-red rule along the bottom edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Stepped meander with crescents
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, about twice as wide as tall. Gold, blue and green bands step up and down in interlocking stepped arches, a gold crescent over a white one hanging in the upper arch and a green ring over a white crescent standing in the lower one, on an opaque dark maroon ground with a thin gold rule along the top edge. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Fan palmette column
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border strip, taller than wide. Scalloped fan palmettes stack one above the other, each with black and cream radiating segments below a crown of gold and green lobes, with white dots in the spandrels on both sides, on an opaque dark red ground with an orange-red rule along the left and right edges. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Four cream spirals on red
assets.description: One repeat of a border strip, slightly wider than tall. Four cream spirals outlined in orange-red fill the unit in two rows, the upper pair curling outward and the lower pair inward so they read as two facing C-scrolls, on an opaque dark red ground with a row of small red squares along the top and bottom edges. Nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it along its width with background-repeat.
The frame atlas composes it with the corner component for border-image use.

assets.title: Dark petal cross border cell
assets.description: One repeat of a border, a cream square panel holding four dark red pointed petals on the diagonals and a thin orange cross of rods with knobbed ends between them, a small cream ring at the centre; to its left a narrow dark red bar with a cream C-curl at each end and a small gold ring in the middle. Orange-red rules run along the top and bottom. The cell chains when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: One period of the plate border; repeat along x for a strip, the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical run.
The frame atlas puts one panel and link between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Two-roundel border cell with fleuron link
assets.description: One repeat of a border, two roundels in concentric red, cream and dark red rings, the left one with a black field and the right one with a gold field, each holding an orange disc off centre; between them a small gold ring with a gold fleuron sprouting up and another down. Dark red ground with a thin orange rule along the bottom. The roundels are cut at the sides so the chain continues when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: One period of the plate border, two roundels long; repeat along x for a strip, the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical run.
