The frame atlas puts one period between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Red acanthus stem vertical border
assets.description: A vertical border repeat, an undulating orange stem outlined in dark red winding up the strip with dark red acanthus fronds springing from it on both sides, two small blue trefoil flowers edged in orange at the bends and small cream ring beads on the stem, over a mottled tan and olive ground. Four times taller than wide; the stem crosses the top and bottom edges so the strip joins when stacked. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run.
The frame atlas puts one full stem period between two corners; use border-image with round fitting. The corner is a small cut piece, so check the join at large sizes.

assets.title: Stacked shell palmette vertical border
assets.description: A vertical border repeat, a stack of four overlapping shell-shaped palmettes with radiating ribs and a cream central tongue, their colours changing down the strip from blue to orange and dark red, to gold and blue, to olive grey, with small cream dots in the spandrels between them; orange-red rules edged in cream run down both sides. The stack continues across the top and bottom edges when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run.
The frame atlas puts one stack of four palmettes between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Floret and leaf cross border strip
assets.description: A border repeat of four square cells, a dark red panel with a cream floret of four C-curled petals and an orange border, a cream panel with an olive-brown four-leaf cross around a blue dot and blue drop accents, the same floret panel with a blue border, and the leaf cross again; a thin orange-red rule runs along the bottom. Nearly four times wider than tall; the cells chain when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: Repeats along x; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical run.
The frame atlas puts the four-cell period between two leaf-cross corners; use border-image with round fitting so whole cells land on each side.

assets.title: Linked oval border cell
assets.description: One repeat of a border, a chain of rings made of paired C-shaped arcs edged in cream, red arcs on the outer ring and blue arcs on the next, each ring holding an upright oval with a tan centre and an orange rim, and small tan squares linking the rings; dark red ground with a faint olive pattern, orange rules along the top and bottom. Two rings wide, cut through the rings at both sides so the chain continues when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: One period of the plate border; repeat along x for a strip, the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical run.
The frame atlas puts two rings between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Scrolling stem vertical border
assets.description: A vertical border repeat on cream, a symmetrical pair of dark olive-brown stems that fork from the centre line into two inward volutes at the bottom and two outward curls with dark red tips higher up, small dark red dashes between them, and a blue three-lobed leaf in each upper corner; a dark red rule runs down each side. The stems continue across the top and bottom edges when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run.
The frame atlas puts one period between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Nested loop vertical border
assets.description: A vertical border repeat of tightly nested hairlines in dark olive, cream and dark red that bend into a column of heart-shaped loops, each loop opening downward around the one below it like fingerprint ridges, with narrower loops filling the sides; a brown-red rule runs down each side. The ridges continue across the top and bottom edges when repeated. Opaque, no transparent background.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run.
The frame atlas puts one period between two corners; use border-image with round fitting.

assets.title: Greek key corner, top-left
assets.description: An L-shaped top-left corner with two arms of equal length. The outer band is blue with a running cream and gold wave scroll; the inner band is dark olive green with a row of red Greek key cells, each a square meander; thin orange-red rules edged in cream separate the bands and close the edges, and a diagonal mitre joins the two arms at the vertex. The inside of the L is transparent.
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a box; flip or rotate for the other three corners, the pattern is symmetrical about the mitre.
The arms are cut square at their ends and do not repeat; it is a complete corner, not a border-image atlas.

assets.title: Zigzag ribbon corner, top-left
assets.description: An L-shaped top-left corner with two arms of equal length. Wide gold-ochre bands run along the outside and inside of each arm; between them a dark red band carries a blue zigzag ribbon edged in cream and tan with a tan C-scroll in every triangle it leaves, and at the vertex a fan of five cream and black darts radiating out of the angle. The inside of the L is transparent.
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a box; flip or rotate for the other three corners, the fan sits on the diagonal.
The arms are cut square at their ends and do not repeat; it is a complete corner, not a border-image atlas.

assets.title: Blue dragon head with orange tongue
assets.description: The head of a blue dragon in profile facing left, cut from the terminal of an initial. It has a pointed snout, a white-rimmed eye, a swept-back blue crest with white hatching and an open mouth with a dark red interior and white teeth, from which a long orange tongue curls out to the lower left. A short stub of neck remains at the right. Black outlines; transparent background.
usage_notes: Head only; the neck is cut where it met the letter, so place it against a stem, a letter or the end of a border.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:19

assets.title: Blue serrated floret with gold centre
assets.description: A small loosely painted floret of about seven blue serrated petals around an orange-red centre topped with a gold disc, one of the florets scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; keep it small.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Blue webbed fan leaf
assets.description: A fan-shaped blue leaf spreading to the left from a narrow base at the right, its six pointed hooked tips joined by pale ribbed webbing like a bat's wing, with a tall curling tendril at the top and a pink-red lobe folded behind it at the upper right. Outlined in black on a transparent ground.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: King David playing the harp
assets.description: King David, crowned in gold, with brown hair and beard, sits turned slightly to the right in a loose brown robe with an ermine-spotted collar and red pointed shoes, his right hand at the strings of a gold harp held at his side beside a small purple flower. He looks out at the viewer. Cut from the historiated initial; the background is transparent.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29

assets.title: Crowned two-faced winged figure with serpent chalice
assets.description: A standing barefoot figure with two faces under one gold crown set with blue stones, a bearded profile looking left and a beardless one looking right. The long robe is gold and red on the left half and black on the right. A gold feathered wing spreads at the left, its lower part coiling into a spiral with a small head, and a blue wing with white drop markings spreads at the right. The right hand holds a dark gold-rimmed chalice from which three green serpent heads rise. Cut from the miniature; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut-out of the figure in two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene, without the ground; the feet end flat where they stood on the rocks.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Sprig with four dark seed pods
assets.description: An upright sprig on a mottled yellow-green stem that forks into four curving stalks, each ending in a hanging oval seed pod painted dark brown-black with a glossy highlight. Cut from the ground of the miniature at the right of the figure; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The better-preserved of the two sprigs flanking the figure in two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene; the stem is cut flat at the bottom where it met the ground.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Diving brown bird with red face
assets.description: A brown bird with pale cream underparts dives to the lower left, both wings raised above its back and its forked tail at the upper right; its head is ringed in red around the eye and bill. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29

assets.title: Horizontal floral spray with blue flowers
assets.description: A long horizontal spray of green, white-highlighted stems running from a blue acanthus curl with a pink-tan leaf at the left to a slender blue and gold leaf at the right, with a tuft of green grass at its centre. Along it hang two pale blue many-petalled flowers, green strap leaves, orange buds and gold discs, and small gold-centred blue florets and orange dots are scattered around the stems. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Finite horizontal piece with terminal ends, not a repeat; it comes from the same border as tall-floral-bar-with-knotted-red-blue-ribbons, which it meets at right angles.
The loose florets and the gold disc from the same border can be scattered around it as in the source.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Gold panel with blue star column and red and blue vines
assets.description: A rectangular panel on a burnished gold ground, cut from a border. Gold bars with a blue stripe and red curled ends run along the top and bottom and extend into pointed gold finials at the four corners. A vertical blue column in the centre holds three squares, each filled with white radiating strokes around a central dot. On either side, curling red and blue stems carry three-lobed leaves in red, blue and green with white highlights and dots. Opaque within the panel; transparent outside.
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its own gold ground; place it as a plate or a headpiece, not as a cut-out.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:20

assets.title: Small red and gold painted disc
assets.description: A small round dab of orange-red paint with a gold disc laid over it, its brushed edge uneven, one of the gold-centred dots scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; it is tiny, keep it near native size.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Faded sprig with gold seed pods
assets.description: The remains of an upright sprig, a dark green stem with two curving side stalks and faint traces of about six gold and red seed pods around it, most of the paint lost so that the pods survive as scattered flakes without outlines. Cut from the ground of the miniature at the left of the figure; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Kept as it survives; use it for a worn, ghostly plant or pair it with dark-seed-pod-sprig as in the source, where the two flank the figure.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Grapevine with two purple grape clusters
assets.description: A vertical grapevine on a green stem with curling tendrils, carrying two clusters of purple grapes with white highlights, three large green vine leaves, three red lily-like flowers, a small rosy apple-like fruit at the right and gold-edged leaves. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; opaque paint on a transparent ground.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29

assets.title: Green feathered floret with gold centre
assets.description: A small four-pointed floret of fine green hatched strokes forming a diamond with feathered tips around an orange-red centre topped with a gold disc, one of the florets scattered beside the floral bars of the initial. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Scatter it beside the floral bars of the same group as in the source; keep it small.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Gold and green leaf flourish with yellow flowers
assets.description: A flourish from the upper left of an initial. A broad ochre-gold leaf curls into spirals at the top right and at the bottom, a green acanthus leaf fills the centre, a blue curled leaf sits at the lower right, and thin green stems with spiral tendrils and fern-like fronds spread outward. A spray of yellow bell-shaped flowers on green stems rises at the top, and a tapering red beaded curl extends to the left. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Sat at the upper left of the initial, with pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish below; the red beaded curl at the left is the natural outer edge.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7

assets.title: Green lobed leaf with pointed tip
assets.description: A broad dark green leaf with three rounded lobes above and a pointed lobe below, veined with pale brown-white strokes and outlined in black, with a few flecks of gold at the tips; a thin pale fringe remains along the outline where it was lifted from the blue stroke of the initial. The background is transparent.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19

assets.title: Inhabited initial S with a winged dragon
assets.description: The letter S drawn as a rose-red band with white dots and a black outline, curling into a loop that encloses a blue winged dragon. The dragon's blue head with pointed ears faces right at the top right, an orange bat wing spreads across the centre, and its blue hind leg rests on the lower curve beside a blue and red lobed leaf. Red, blue and orange acanthus sprays with a small blue creature head grow from the left side of the letter. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The whole inhabited letter, its S body and the foliage at the left included; the letter and the dragon are one piece and do not separate.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:3

assets.title: Red and blue leaf scroll panel
assets.description: A dense panel of blue and red-orange leaf scrollwork outlined in black. Thin blue and red stems curl into two large spirals, one at the upper left and one at the lower right, and throw off lobed, trefoil and heart-shaped leaves in blue, red and orange with white dots and vein lines; an orange lobed terminal with a curled tip closes the top. The panel is roughly rectangular, its left and right sides cut straight where the scroll met the border bars. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: The straight left and right edges are cuts, so it reads best butted against a rule or bar on those sides, as in the source border.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: Interlaced blue and rose stems with lobed leaves
assets.description: Two stems, one blue and one rose-red, each with a white centre line and black outline, loop through each other in a symmetrical knot of interlaced circles. Three-lobed leaves in orange, blue and rose sit inside the loops and at the centre, and larger lobed leaves in orange and blue spread from the four corners, all with white dots and highlights. Transparent background.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:19

assets.title: Agnus Dei, lamb lying with cross staff and banderole
assets.description: A cream-white lamb lies with its legs folded, body to the right and head turned slightly towards the viewer, with pink ears and muzzle and dark hooves. A thin gold cross staff leans diagonally behind its head, and a blue-grey banderole with traces of lettering winds around the staff and flutters off to the right. Shaded in tan and grey; transparent background.
usage_notes: The Agnus Dei from the counter of a historiated initial A; the two flourishes from the same cutting are green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish and pink-flower-and-green-scroll-flourish.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7

assets.title: Large red-brown butterfly with cream wing bars
assets.description: A large butterfly in profile facing left, its russet red-brown wings closed above the body and crossed by broad cream bars with rows of red and black spots along the margins; the body and the underside of the lower wing are pale blue-grey, with thin brown legs and two long clubbed antennae. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with small-spotted-butterfly, which faces right at a smaller scale.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29

assets.title: Two bell flowers and gold berry on black twig
assets.description: Two scalloped bell-shaped flowers with orange-red petals and dark green calyces hang from a thick black stem, one above and one below, with a gold disc berry on a stalk at the left and thin black tendrils curling to the right. The stem runs off the lower edge. Black line and paint on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Same twig and flowers as upper-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-berry, from the left side of the same border; hide the cut stem end behind a rule or another piece.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: Blue S-curved vine with lobed leaves
assets.description: A blue stem with a white centre line and black outline winds in an S-curve and branches into short side shoots. Six three-lobed leaves hang from it, two orange-red, two green and two blue, each with white highlights and a line of white dots along the centre. Transparent background.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:13

assets.title: Curving ivy trail with gold flower, lower half
assets.description: A thin pale pink stem with a black outline curves from the upper left down to the lower right and gives off short side stems. Pointed ivy leaves alternate along it in red, blue and tan, each drawn out into a black hairline tip, and a round gold flower with black hairline rays hangs at the right end. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The lower half of one ivy trail; upper-trail-of-pointed-ivy-and-gold-flower is the upright half from the same cutting, and the two hang together as a margin border, the upright piece above and this piece running along the bottom.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:2

assets.title: Gold acanthus spray with blue and pink leaves
assets.description: A spray fanning out from a cut stem at the right; two gold and orange acanthus leaves with white vein lines reach left and upward, and below them a long pointed blue leaf with white highlights wraps around a pink lobe bearing a white circle and a small white sprig mark, with a short red stub hanging below. Cut from the decorated initial; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The lower of the two leaf sprays that sprang from the letter; set its cut stem end at the right against a rule or letter.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19

assets.title: Saint Michael and angels fighting the dragon and demons
assets.description: The figures of a miniature cut from their ground. Saint Michael in gold armour, with a halo and green, blue and red wings, stands at the centre with his sword raised and one foot on a brown winged dragon with a gold tail. Four angels in white, pink and red robes strike down with swords around him, while a red-clad demon with a bat wing falls at the left behind a blue shield with gold stars and a grey demon with blue bat wings sprawls at the lower right. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Figures only, the painted sky and ground of the miniature are removed; place it as a complete scene and keep its proportions.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 15:14

assets.title: Winged hybrid with orange head and bearded mask
assets.description: A hybrid creature facing right, with an orange-red beast head with pointed ears and open jaws on a gold-feathered neck and wing, a body curled into a large blue spiral with white hatching and a gold-dotted band, a bearded human face in orange-brown at its rump at the right, and two dark green clawed feet. Outlined in black; cut from the decorated initial, the background is transparent.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19

assets.title: Pink and dark red lobed leaves on a knotted blue stem
assets.description: Two large curling lobed leaves, the left one rose-pink with white highlights and dotted lines, the right one dark red with gold-edged lobes and white highlights, meet over a small pink pod. A blue stem with a white centre line loops into a knot below them and ends at the bottom. Black outlines; transparent background.
usage_notes: From the same initial as red-flower-and-blue-leaf-on-pale-forked-stem, in the same hand and palette; the two pair well on one page.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:4

assets.title: Green scroll flourish with pink flowers and blue bead chain
assets.description: A flourish from the lower part of an initial. A red bell-shaped flower with a blue calyx sits at the top right, a chain of blue beads tapering upward curves away from it to the upper left, and green curling leaves and stems spiral downward carrying three pink five-petal flowers, an orange curled leaf and a dark green pod, with a red beaded curl at the lower left. Darker outlines and white highlights; transparent background.
usage_notes: Sat below the initial, with green-gold-leaf-and-flower-flourish above; the blue bead chain is the stem that joined the two, so keep it when pairing them.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 17:7

assets.title: Reclining green dragon biting a gold rod
assets.description: A long green dragon with russet shading lies stretched out facing left, its jaws closed on a gold rectangular rod; it has a slender curved neck, small clawed forelegs, a dark feathered wing with a gold-brown underside raised over its back at the right and a tail trailing to the right. Cut from the ground of the miniature; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut-out of the dragon at the foot of two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene; it lies flat along its belly and reads well as a base-line piece.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Dark red and blue lobed leaves on a pale forked stem
assets.description: Two curling lobed leaves joined by a pale pink forked stem with a black outline, a dark red leaf with orange and white highlights at the left and a blue leaf with white highlights at the right, with a small ribbed pod where they meet. The stem ends in a short fork at the bottom. Transparent background.
usage_notes: From the same initial as pink-and-red-lobed-leaves-on-blue-stem, in the same hand and palette; the two pair well on one page.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:4

assets.title: Red lobed leaf on blue looped stem
assets.description: A fat red-orange lobed leaf with white dots and gold-filled hollows, outlined in black, hangs below a blue and white striped stem that loops over itself and ends in a blunt curled tip at the right. The piece is cut straight along the lower right where it met the border bar. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Hide the straight cut at the lower right against a rule or bar, as in the source corner.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: Resurrection of Christ with four soldiers
assets.description: Christ steps out of a grey stone tomb towards the viewer, right hand raised in blessing and a long gold cross-staff with a trefoil cross in his left, wearing a red mantle lined green over his bare chest, fastened with a gold brooch. Four soldiers in grey plate armour surround the tomb, one slumped asleep at the left, one lying on the green grass below, one in a blue surcoat sitting with a halberd at the right and one crouching behind the tomb with hands raised. Cut from the inside of the initial; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete scene from the inside of the initial, standing on its own strip of grass; place it as a picture.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Blue vine with six lobed leaves
assets.description: A blue stem with a white centre line and black outline curves down from a curled tip at the top left and branches to both sides. Six five-lobed pointed leaves hang from it, three orange-red, two blue and one green, each with white highlights and a line of white dots down the middle. Transparent background.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:4

assets.title: Small spotted butterfly
assets.description: A small butterfly in profile facing right, its closed wings dark brown along the top and orange-cream below with black and white spots and a blue-green patch near the body; a hairy brown body, thin legs and two antennae. Cut from the border of the historiated initial; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with large-red-brown-butterfly-with-cream-wing-bars, which faces left at a larger scale.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 31:29

assets.title: Tall floral bar with red and blue strapwork knot
assets.description: A tall vertical bar on a green and gold stem carrying, from top to bottom, blue and gold leaf curls, a large green, pink and gold acanthus fan over a blue and red leaf collar, a pink and gold star flower with a blue centre, a blue and gold acanthus scroll, a blue tulip-like flower, a gold and blue scroll, an interlaced red and blue strapwork lozenge over gold, a blue flower in gold leaves, a red bud and a pink tasselled flower at the foot. Gold discs and small blue and green gold-centred florets are scattered beside the stem. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Finite vertical piece, every motif different, not a repeat; it comes from the same border as floral-spray-with-blue-flowers, which it meets at right angles.
The loose florets and the gold disc from the same border can be scattered beside it as in the source.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 67:3

assets.title: Thin red and gold miniature frame
assets.description: A thin rectangular frame, taller than wide, of pink-red paint with worn patches of gold leaf and a thin dark line along its inner edge; the four bands run slightly askew, the top band rising to the right and the left band leaning. Only the paint is opaque; the interior and everything outside the frame are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, scaled as a whole with content placed in its transparent interior; it is not a border-image because the bands run askew and vary in width.
It is the frame of two-faced-alchemical-figure-and-dragon-scene.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Crowned two-faced figure with dragon on rocky ground
assets.description: An alchemical figure with two faces under one gold crown, a bearded profile looking left and a beardless one looking right, stands barefoot on green rocky ground in a robe gold and red on the left and black on the right, a gold feathered wing ending in a spiral coil at the left and a blue wing at the right, holding a chalice from which three green serpent heads rise. A green dragon lies on the ground biting a gold rod, and two seed-pod sprigs grow beside the figure, the left one faded. Cut from the miniature; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The whole picture field of the miniature without its frame; thin-red-and-gold-fixed-miniature-frame is the frame it sat in, and the figure, dragon and both sprigs are also cut out separately.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 28:26-27

assets.title: Red, blue and gold leaf spray with curled tip
assets.description: A spray fanning out from a cut stem at the right; a long red-brown leaf with white vein lines reaches left, a gold acanthus lobe hangs below it, and a blue leaf curls over at the top around a pink inner lobe with white sprig marks. Cut from the decorated initial; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The upper of the two leaf sprays that sprang from the letter; set its cut stem end at the right against a rule or letter.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 23:19

assets.title: Red lobed leaf terminal
assets.description: A tall red-orange leaf with three pointed lobes curving to the left, outlined in black with pale highlight strokes and a dark curled tip at the right, the terminal of a scroll; its base is cut where it left the stem. Opaque paint on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Terminal of a scroll; set its cut base against a stem or rule.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: Upright ivy trail with gold flower, upper half
assets.description: A thin pale pink stem with a black outline rises vertically and gives off short side stems to left and right. Pointed ivy leaves alternate along it in tan, red and blue, each drawn out into a long black hairline tip, and a round gold flower with black hairline rays sits to the left of the middle. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The upright half of one ivy trail; lower-curving-ivy-trail-with-gold-flower is the lower half from the same cutting, and the two hang together as a margin border, this piece above and the curving piece along the bottom.
Tall piece (about 1 to 2.7); it suits a side margin or a column divider.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 12:2

assets.title: Two bell flowers and gold bud on black twig
assets.description: A fine black twig with a gold oval bud at its tip ringed by short strokes and a long tendril rising above it; thin black tendrils curl out from the stem, and at the left and right hang two scalloped bell-shaped flowers with orange-red petals and dark green calyces. Black line and paint on a transparent ground.
usage_notes: Same twig and flowers as left-two-flower-black-twig-with-gold-berry, from the top of the same border; the stem is complete at the bottom.
assets.attribution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection Lewis E M 13:5

assets.title: Curling leaf ornament on a long stem
assets.description: A tall foliate ornament of broad lobed leaves that curl into two spirals, one at the top left and one at the top right, with smaller curled leaves sprouting between them; a long thin stem sweeps down from the foliage to the lower right and a short forked twig branches off it toward the lower left. Engraved in dark brown-black line with hatched shading, the leaf and stem interiors filled with the cream paper tone, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall piece (about 2:3); the bare stem at the bottom can be cropped away to keep only the leaf cluster.

assets.title: Curling thistle ornament
assets.description: A tall thistle ornament in which a thick stem rises from a short rooted base at the bottom right, curves up and to the left, and breaks into spiky, deeply cut thistle leaves that spread in a loose crown across the top; smaller spiky leaf sprays grow from the stem at the right and at the lower left. Engraved in dark brown-black line with hatched shading, the leaf and stem interiors filled with the cream paper tone, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Stands upright on its rooted base; works as a tall side ornament or a tailpiece.

assets.title: Hop vine and leaf scroll panel
assets.description: A wide rectangular panel filled edge to edge with foliage, broad curling lobed leaves on thick stems interwoven with a thinner hop vine that carries serrated leaves and hanging hop cones, the thick stems looping into a large ring at the centre; a thin engraved plate rule runs along all four sides. Engraved in dark brown line only, with the ground showing through between the hatch lines, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Line work only; the ink is partial alpha and the page shows between the lines, so it reads best on light or cream grounds.
The thin plate rule on all four sides is part of the master; crop just inside it for a borderless panel.

assets.title: Crested bird flying right
assets.description: A small crested bird in flight, seen from the side and facing right with its beak open, both wings raised high above the body and the short tail trailing at the lower left. Engraved in dark brown-black line with hatched shading, the body and wings filled with the cream paper tone, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the left middle of the owl sheet, where it flies right toward the owl; pair it with the sheet or with the other flying bird.

assets.title: Owl mocked by day birds in a leafy scroll
assets.description: A tall panel of broad curling lobed leaves on thick thorny stems, with a shaggy lettuce-like leaf cluster in the middle. At the bottom centre an owl with spread wings perches on a stem and looks straight at the viewer, a crested bird sits below it at the left, a small bird flies left at the top centre, a crested bird flies right at the left middle, a long-necked bird pecks down a stem in the upper centre, and two more birds are cut off by the right edge. Engraved in dark brown line only, with the ground showing through between the hatch lines, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Line work only; the ink is partial alpha and the page shows between the lines, so it reads best on light or cream grounds.
The two flying birds (top centre and left middle) are also delivered as separate cut-outs, upper-flying-day-bird and lower-flying-day-bird.

assets.title: Small bird flying left
assets.description: A small bird in flight, seen from the side and facing left, with both wings raised and swept back and a pointed tail trailing at the upper right. Engraved in dark brown-black line with hatched shading, the body and wings filled with the cream paper tone, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the top centre of the owl sheet; pair it with the sheet or with the other flying bird, which faces the opposite way.

assets.title: Scowling pale cat with angular face
assets.description: A pale cream shaggy cat-like creature with a narrow, angular human face sits upright and scowls at the viewer, with slanted eyes under a heavy brow, a small red mouth, long whiskers and a forked beard. Tall pointed ears with pink interiors, matted fur speckled with brown, and a thick tail curling up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Mournful brown cat with long beard
assets.description: A brown and cream shaggy cat-like creature sits upright and looks at the viewer with a long, mournful human face, heavy-lidded eyes, a red mouth, long whiskers and a full pale beard flowing into a matted cream bib. Small pointed ears, brown speckled flanks and a thick brown tail curling up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
Same pose and beard as cat-pale-bearded in a darker coat.

assets.title: Hunched charcoal cat with moustache
assets.description: A rounded charcoal grey cat-like creature crouches with high hunched shoulders and looks at the viewer with a compact human face, wide eyes, a red mouth, a pale moustache and a short pale beard. Small pointed ears, dense dark fur streaked with cream, pale paws and a dark tail curled up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Sleepy cream cat lying down
assets.description: A low, round cream cat-like creature lies on its paws with a very broad, sleepy human face turned to the viewer, half-closed eyes, a faint smile and a stubbly chin. Small pointed ears with pink interiors, soft fur speckled with brown and a long tail wrapped around its forepaws at the lower right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Reclining brown cat with drooping cheeks
assets.description: A long, reclining brown and cream cat-like creature rests on its forepaws and looks at the viewer with a sagging human face, drooping cheeks, uneven heavy-lidded eyes, a long closed mouth and pale whiskers parted over a shaggy beard. Small pointed ears, matted brown fur and a thick spotted tail looping up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
The widest piece of the series; suits a low horizontal slot.

assets.title: Pale cat with long beard
assets.description: A pale cream cat-like creature sits upright and looks at the viewer with a high-browed human face, dark eyes, a red mouth, long whiskers and a long shaggy beard. Tall pointed ears, matted cream fur lightly speckled with brown, slender legs and a thin tail curling up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
Same pose and beard as cat-brown-bearded in a paler coat.

assets.title: Anxious russet tabby cat
assets.description: A russet cat-like creature with dark tabby stripes along its flanks sits on small paws and looks at the viewer with an anxious human face, wide eyes, a red mouth, long whiskers and a full pale beard. Pointed ears, cream chest fur and a bushy striped tail curling up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Worried russet cat with tall brow
assets.description: A wiry russet cat-like creature sits upright and looks at the viewer with a tall, domed human forehead above a worried face, unequal hooded eyes, a slightly open mouth and a short pale beard. Pointed ears, matted fur speckled with brown, high narrow shoulders and a thin tail curling up behind it to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Stern brown dog with broad brow
assets.description: A stocky dark brown dog-like creature with a mane of shaggy curls crouches on its forepaws and looks at the viewer with a broad, square human face, a heavy flat brow, small stern eyes, a wide red mouth and a short pale beard. Dense curly fur over the whole body and a low plumed tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Solemn charcoal dog with pale beard
assets.description: A charcoal grey dog-like creature with long cream-streaked fur sits and looks at the viewer with a solemn human face, a high forehead, dark eyes, a red mouth and a broad pale beard falling into a long shaggy bib. Dark flanks, pale paws and a tall feathered tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Crouching dark dog with crooked face
assets.description: A long, dark grey-brown dog-like creature crouches low and looks at the viewer with an asymmetrical human face, uneven eyelids, one brow raised, a crooked red mouth and a sweeping pale moustache over a short beard. Shaggy curled fur along the back, dark paws and a broad low tail trailing out to the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
The widest piece of the series; suits a low horizontal slot.

assets.title: Pale dog with long face in profile
assets.description: A pale cream dog-like creature sits facing left and turns an elongated human face to the left in profile, with a long curved nose, hooded eyes, a red mouth, a pointed beard and long hanging locks in place of ears. Shaggy fur speckled with brown, slender legs and a flowing feathered tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
The only creature of the series in profile; place it at the right of a row so it looks inward.

assets.title: Pale dog lifting a forepaw
assets.description: A pale cream shaggy dog-like creature sits with its left forepaw lifted and looks at the viewer with a worried human face, raised brows, dark eyes, a red mouth and a long curling beard flowing into a matted bib. Long hanging locks, fur speckled with brown and a high plumed tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Worried russet dog sitting
assets.description: A squat russet dog-like creature sits on broad paws and looks at the viewer with a round, worried human face, raised brows, dark eyes, a red mouth and a short pale beard over curls of cream chest fur. A shaggy russet mane, speckled flanks and an upright plumed tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
Same russet dog as dog-russet-smiling with both paws down and a worried face.

assets.title: Smiling russet dog lifting a forepaw
assets.description: A round russet dog-like creature with a mane of shaggy curls sits with its left forepaw lifted and looks at the viewer with a cheerful human face, small eyes, a short broad nose, an uneven open smile and a short pale beard. Speckled russet fur and a bushy plumed tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.
Same russet dog as dog-russet-seated with a lifted paw and a smile; the only smiling creature of the series.

assets.title: Sorrowful umber dog crouching
assets.description: A long, dark umber dog-like creature crouches on short legs and looks at the viewer with a narrow, sorrowful human face, raised brows, downturned eyes, a red mouth and a hanging pale beard. Dense shaggy fur in dark brown and tan over the whole body, dark paws and a large feathered tail curling up at the right. Painted in the manner of a bestiary miniature, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure; keep proportions and do not display wider than its native size.

assets.title: Rabbit playing a lute among ivy
assets.description: A brown rabbit with a cream chest and belly stands upright on its hind legs in profile facing right and plays a red lute with a gilt rose, long ears raised, one paw on the neck and the other over the strings. Beneath it a green ivy vine with gold leaves and tendrils curls across the ground to both sides. Painted in the manner of a manuscript miniature with fine white fur strokes and gold details, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete figure with its ivy ground; keep them together and keep proportions.
The ivy spreads wider than the rabbit at the base, so the piece sits best on a baseline with free space to both sides.

assets.title: Five animals in a vine frieze
assets.description: A low engraved frieze of five small animals in a vine of curling stems, lobed leaves and a bunch of grapes. Left to right, a crouching hare faces right, a fox-like animal runs right head down, a curled animal with a bushy striped tail sits in the middle head tucked under, a boar-like animal runs left, and a slender long-tailed animal runs right looking back. Sepia-brown line work with cream hatching on a transparent background; the vine closes in loose scrolls at both ends, so the strip is complete and does not repeat.
usage_notes: Complete finite strip from one plate; both ends close in scrolls, so place it whole as a headpiece or footer band rather than repeating it.
Companion of the bird frieze from the same 1557 series, cut to nearly the same length; the two stack as a matched pair of bands.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1911.604

assets.title: Arabesque cartouche on dark ground
assets.description: A wide symmetrical cartouche printed as a near-black brownish ground with the ornament left in reserve, so the arabesque reads as light lines and leaves cut out of the dark field. The outline is scalloped, with pointed ogee finials at top and bottom centre, two knotted interlace loops over the top finial, scrolled lobes at the four corners and squared bracket terminals at left and right. A band of running scrolls frames an inner field of interlaced strapwork and dense leaf scrolls around a central lozenge. Only the dark ink is opaque; the ornament itself is transparent.
usage_notes: The ornament is the transparent part, so it only reads on a light background; on a dark page the whole piece disappears into a silhouette.
Complete finite cartouche; it works as a label, title plaque or medallion, not as a repeat or frame.

assets.title: Birds and parrots on a flowering frieze
assets.description: An engraved frieze crowded with birds on a thin ground of grass tufts and small flowers, with leafy branches rising between them. Left to right, a small lizard climbs a stem at the far left, a peacock fans its tail, a second peacock walks right trailing its tail, a crested bird perches, a long-necked waterfowl rears with raised wings, birds hover and hang from branches, a crested hook-beaked bird of prey spreads its wings facing left, and several parrots perch among flowers at the right end. Sepia-brown line work with cream hatching on a transparent background; complete, it does not repeat.
usage_notes: Complete finite strip from one plate; the ends are open silhouettes, not a continuous pattern, so place it whole as a headpiece or footer band rather than repeating it.
Companion of the animal frieze from the same 1557 series, cut to nearly the same length; the two stack as a matched pair of bands.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1911.605

assets.title: Blue vine with alternating lobed leaves
assets.description: One vertical repeat of a vine in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. A thin stem loops into two rounded coils, each enclosing a large five-lobed leaf, the leaves pointing alternately up to the right and down to the left, with small three-leaf clusters on short tendrils in the gaps. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Blue stencil scroll with alternating leaves
assets.description: One horizontal repeat of a stencilled scroll in bright royal blue on the untouched white sheet, whose grey graph-paper grid shows through. Two S-curved stems with round bud-like ends carry curving acanthus leaf tips and small teardrop leaves, the second curl being the first turned over; the stencil bridges leave every shape as a separate cut piece. The left and right edges join seamlessly. The ground is opaque.
usage_notes: The graph-paper background is intentional; the paper grid and the ornament repeat have different periods, so the grid steps slightly at each join.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Blue border with wading bird, fan and palmette
assets.description: One repeat of a border in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. Two heart-shaped scroll loops rise side by side, the left one enclosing a serrated fan on a curled stem and the right one a long-necked wading bird standing on a leaf and facing right; a fan-shaped palmette fills the gap between them below, with small leaf sprigs along the bottom edge. The left and right edges join when repeated, but the repeat is barely wider than it is tall. Not transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is barely longer than its thickness, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along its width, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Blue stencil band with three-leaf sprigs
assets.description: One horizontal repeat of a stencilled band in bright royal blue on the untouched white graph-paper sheet. A wavy stem throws off two curling S-scrolls, each carrying a sprig of three leaves with a pointed central one, the sprigs pointing alternately up and down; a straight stencil-cut rule with bridge gaps runs along the top and bottom edges. The left and right edges join seamlessly. The ground is opaque, with the sheet's grey grid visible.
usage_notes: The graph-paper background is intentional; the paper grid and the ornament repeat have different periods, so the grid steps slightly at each join.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Blue looped quatrefoil
assets.description: A single quatrefoil in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. Four pointed oval loops meet at the centre, each holding a trefoil bud on a pointed leaf, with a small three-lobed sprig in each diagonal gap. The motif is symmetric about both axes and its edges join when the piece is repeated, but it is about as tall as it is wide. Not transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is about as long as it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it with background-repeat in either direction, or use the frame atlas.
Also works alone as a small square ornament.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Blue oak leaf and acorn strip
assets.description: A narrow vertical strip of four clusters of lobed oak-like leaves with cross-hatched acorns, in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. The two upper clusters sweep one way and the two lower ones are the same pair turned 180 degrees, so the strip reads the same from either end; leaf tips and acorns reach the strip's edges. The ends do not join as a repeat. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical strip; its ends are not a seamless join, so use it whole rather than stacked.

assets.title: Blue scroll border with small leaves
assets.description: One repeat of a vertical border in flat mid blue on an opaque pale blue ground. C-scrolls with dotted terminals are stacked in two staggered columns along a central stem, and each throws off small pointed leaves and a fan of serrated leaves so that the leaves of one column point into the gaps of the other. The top and bottom edges join when stacked, but the repeat is about as tall as it is wide. Not transparent.
usage_notes: The repeat is about as long as it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along its height, or use the frame atlas.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Gold panel of butterflies with crimson finials
assets.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border, holding a column of about twelve painted butterflies and moths in white, cream, brown, orange and speckled grey, with small blue flowers and sprigs of red berries between them. At each end a crimson acanthus finial with a small blue flower cap grows out of the border. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical panel with its finials; keep it whole and upright, it does not repeat.
One of five panels of the same height from one sheet; they stand side by side as page margins.

assets.title: Gold panel of roses and blue birds with blue finials
assets.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border. From the top it holds a white rose with a small fly, an orange and black butterfly, a pink rose with a bud, a blue bird clinging head downward to a stem, a second pink rose, a purple butterfly, a yellow rose, a second blue bird head downward on a crimson rose, and a dark beetle, all on thin green stems. At each end a bright blue acanthus finial with a gold leaf cap grows from the border. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical panel with its finials; keep it whole and upright, it does not repeat.
One of five panels of the same height from one sheet; they stand side by side as page margins.

assets.title: Gold panel of flowers and finches, first copy
assets.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border that ends in a cusped arch with a scroll finial and a small pink knob at both ends. From the top it holds a snail on a leaf, a red rose, a blue star-shaped flower, a brown butterfly, a purple pansy, a fly, a goldfinch facing right, a pink flower, a speckled butterfly, a strawberry with white blossoms, a red-breasted finch facing right, violets, a round leaf, a brown butterfly and a blue iris. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical panel with its end caps; keep it whole and upright, it does not repeat.
The same design painted twice on the sheet; floral-bird-panel-right is the second copy, not a mirror image, and the birds face right in both. Flip one horizontally for a mirrored pair.
One of five panels of the same height from one sheet; they stand side by side as page margins.

assets.title: Gold panel of flowers and finches, second copy
assets.description: A tall narrow panel on a mottled gold ground inside a dark brown ruled border that ends in a cusped arch with a scroll finial and a small pink knob at both ends. From the top it holds a snail on a leaf, a red rose, a blue star-shaped flower, a brown butterfly, a purple and white pansy with a yellow centre, a fly, a goldfinch facing right, a pink flower, a speckled butterfly, a strawberry with white blossoms, a red-breasted finch facing right, violets, a round leaf, a brown butterfly and a blue iris. The sheet outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical panel with its end caps; keep it whole and upright, it does not repeat.
The same design painted twice on the sheet; this is the second copy of floral-bird-panel-left, not a mirror image, and the birds face right in both. Flip one horizontally for a mirrored pair.
One of five panels of the same height from one sheet; they stand side by side as page margins.

assets.title: Gold acanthus scroll with blue bellflowers
assets.description: A horizontal flourish drawn in flat gold with black outlines on an opaque white ground. A long S-curved acanthus stem with curling leaf ends at both sides throws off five blue and white bellflowers on short stalks, two hanging below the stem and three standing above it. A thin black rule runs along the top edge. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Complete flourish with its curled ends; it does not repeat.
The rule along the top edge is part of the drawing; crop the top row if it is not wanted.

assets.title: Olive leaf and red berry vine
assets.description: One horizontal repeat of a vine drawn in flat colour with black outlines on an opaque white ground. A thin black stem undulates along the strip carrying olive-green leaves with darker shading, a large leaf curling up at the left and smaller ones below, and a single red berry hanging on a forked stalk at the right. A thin black rule runs along the top edge. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The rule along the top edge is part of the drawing and continues across the join.

assets.title: Painted vine with serrated flowers on ochre
assets.description: One horizontal repeat of a painted border on an opaque ochre ground between thin red rules. An olive stem with spiky teal and olive leaves carries two large flowers, each a red bud wrapped in cream serrated petals, one leaning left and one right, with small cream and red buds and teal leaf sprays between them. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Painted vine with tulip, rosette and carnation on ochre
assets.description: One horizontal repeat of a painted border on an opaque ochre ground between thin red rules. Along an undulating olive vine with narrow leaves stand, from the left, a red tulip-shaped bud, a round flower of cream petals around a red and teal centre, a red fan-shaped carnation with a teal calyx, and a star rosette of teal and red rays around a cream centre. The left and right edges join seamlessly. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its width; the build's rotated ladder gives the vertical use.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Painted scrolling floral panel on yellow
assets.description: A broad horizontal painted panel on an opaque yellow ground with a thin red rule along the top and bottom edges. Tan scrolling stems with spiky serrated leaves sprawl across the whole width, carrying flowers of several kinds, a large pink and teal flower, a round red and teal rosette, small blue flowers with red centres, cream buds and olive leaves. The stems are cut at both ends and there is no repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel; the rules at top and bottom are continuous end to end but the stems are cut at both ends, so it does not repeat.
One of three panels of the same width cut from one sheet; they stack as bands of one wide border.

assets.title: Painted mirrored leaf panel with square trim
assets.description: A broad horizontal painted panel on an opaque yellow ground. Along the top, under a gold rule, hangs a row of alternating olive and red-brown squares; below it pairs of long tan lanceolate leaves curve outward from red stems in a mirrored pattern, with round flowers of teal petals and red centres on short stalks, clusters of small berries, and a tan palmette at the centre of each pair. The ends are cut and do not repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel; the mirrored leaf pairs look periodic but the ends are not a seamless join, so use it whole.
One of three panels of the same width cut from one sheet; they stack as bands of one wide border.

assets.title: Painted three-band panel with carnations
assets.description: A broad horizontal painted panel of three stacked bands separated by thin gold rules. The narrow top and bottom bands, on an opaque dark red ground, carry interlacing tan and teal straps with small red and cream flowers; the wider middle band, on a yellow ground, carries a tan strapwork vine with olive leaves, red fan-shaped carnations and a tan palmette at the centre. The ends are cut and do not repeat. Flat colour with fine brown contours; not transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel with all three bands; the ends are not a seamless join, so use it whole.
One of three panels of the same width cut from one sheet; they stack as bands of one wide border.

assets.title: Purple vine with opposed scroll loops
assets.description: One vertical repeat of a vine in dark purple on an opaque pale blue ground. A thin stem bends into a large loop that encloses two opposed inner curls, each tipped with pointed leaf blades and small split leaves, and the whole turns over at each half repeat so that successive loops face alternate ways. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Purple oval scroll and rosette border
assets.description: One vertical repeat of a narrow border in dark purple on an opaque pale blue ground. A tall pointed oval of mirrored stems with inward curls and leaf tips alternates with a small round rosette of lobed petals around a pierced oval centre. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Russet floral vine with bud side bands
assets.description: One vertical repeat of a wide painted border. The centre band, on an opaque russet ground, carries a sage-green vine with large cream and tan peony-like flowers, white daisies, pink tulip-shaped flowers and grey-green serrated leaves; on each side a narrow peach band holds a sage vine of small dark red and grey-blue buds, set off by thin dark and sage-green rules. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The centre band alone is russet-opposed-flowers-and-sage-leaves and the side band alone is sage-leaf-and-russet-bud-vine, for a narrower border in the same style.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Russet floral vine, centre band
assets.description: One vertical repeat of the centre band of the russet floral border on its own. On an opaque russet ground a sage-green vine carries two large flowers of cream and tan petals facing opposite ways, white daisies on thin stems, pink tulip-shaped flowers and grey-green serrated leaves with white veins, bounded on each side by a thin sage-green rule and a dark rule. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The same band flanked by its bud side bands is russet-floral-vine-with-bud-borders; sage-leaf-and-russet-bud-vine is that side band alone and pairs with this one.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Sage vine with russet and grey buds
assets.description: One vertical repeat of the narrow bud band from the russet floral border. On an opaque peach ground a sage-green stem with pale leaves winds up the strip, carrying at every turn a three-petalled bud whose petals are dark red and grey-blue, the buds pointing alternately left and right, between a dark rule and a sage-green rule on each side. The top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. Not transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along its height; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The side band of russet-floral-vine-with-bud-borders on its own; it pairs with russet-opposed-flowers-and-sage-leaves as an outer band.
The frame atlas composes one repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Spiral ribbon column
assets.description: A tall slender column on a mottled gold ground wrapped from top to bottom in two spiralling ribbons, one plain blue and one red striped with white, with tiny green flowering sprigs painted in the gold spaces between the turns. At the top a plume of green leaves, white curling acanthus and a red-brown flower spike rises from the last turn; the bottom ends on the lowest turn of ribbon. The sheet around the column is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical piece with its plume at the top; keep it upright, it does not repeat.
One of five panels of the same height from one sheet; they stand side by side as page margins.

assets.title: Centaur drawing a bow
assets.description: A galloping centaur with a pale human torso, a white coif and a blue dappled horse body draws a red bow, aiming its arrow up and to the right, on a transparent background. The whole figure moves to the right in strict profile.
usage_notes: The figure runs to the right; it sits naturally at the left of a heading or along a bottom margin pointing into the text.

assets.title: Elephant carrying a castle
assets.description: An orange elephant walks to the right carrying a cream stone castle with a red crenellated parapet and a blue domed turret; a hooded man in blue leans out of the castle at the left and a second small figure peers over the battlements at the right. The scene sits on its original opaque panel, red with white vine scroll above and blue with white tendrils below, with a brown ornamental terminal at the upper left; only the area outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: The painted panel is part of the asset; place it as a self-contained picture rather than as a cut-out figure.

assets.title: Horse playing pipe and tabor
assets.description: A blue dappled horse stands upright on its hind legs, facing right in profile, blowing a three-hole pipe held in one hand while beating a red-rimmed tabor drum, slung from a red strap over its shoulder, with a curved stick in the other hand. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall narrow figure suited to a side margin; it faces right, so place it to the left of the text it accompanies.

assets.title: Rabbit ringing church bells
assets.description: A brown rabbit stands on its hind legs at the left, facing right, and pulls two red twisted bell ropes that hang from the arched doorway of a cream stone church. The church has a blue chevron-tiled roof, a square belfry with two bells, a dark quatrefoil rose window and a tower with a gold cross at the right; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The rabbit faces into the church, so keep the whole group together; it reads well as a bottom-margin or corner scene.

assets.title: Brown beast with trefoil in its tail, facing left
assets.description: A brown dragon-like quadruped walks to the left on four clawed feet, with a long arched neck, an open mouth, a pointed ear and a long tail that curls into a spiral behind it with a gold trefoil inside the curl. The body is brown with small cream drop-shaped marks and black contours, with thin green fringes from the initial's ground along parts of the outline; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The gold trefoil inside the tail curl belongs to the piece; in the initial the two beasts face each other, so this one pairs with brown-quadruped-facing-right on the other side of a title or heading.

assets.title: Brown beast with trefoil in its tail, facing right
assets.description: A brown dragon-like quadruped walks to the right on four clawed feet, with a long arched neck, an open mouth, a pointed ear and a long tail that curls into a spiral behind it with a gold trefoil inside the curl. The body is brown with small cream drop-shaped marks and black contours, with thin green fringes from the initial's ground along parts of the outline; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The gold trefoil inside the tail curl belongs to the piece; in the initial the two beasts face each other, so this one pairs with brown-quadruped-facing-left on the other side of a title or heading.

assets.title: Lobed leaves in gold medallions, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a horizontal band: three burnished gold roundels ringed in olive green hold a red, a blue and a gray-blue lobed leaf on a dark ground, joined by green stems with small curled leaves between them; a thin red rule with a pale line runs along the bottom edge. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; the strip above the band and a thinner one below the red rule are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; the generated rotated tile gives the vertical band. The red rule is the inner edge, keep it toward the framed content.
The frame atlas mirrors corner-top-left into all four corners, so every corner carries the gray-blue leaf; corner-top-right is the red-leaf variant for hand-built frames.

assets.title: Opposed leaves in gray interlace, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a vertical band on burnished gold: a pale gray-mauve ribbon outlined in black loops into four heart-shaped compartments on a dark ground, the outer two holding red three-lobed leaves that point outward and the middle two blue leaves that point in toward each other; a red rule with a white line runs along the left edge. The pattern continues across the top and bottom edges and the band is fully opaque.
usage_notes: Repeat along y; the generated rotated tile gives the horizontal band. The red rule is the inner edge, keep it toward the framed content.

No frame atlas: the corners are about 98 px deeper than the band inside the red rule and would protrude into the framed area, so build a frame by hand from the band and the two corner components, aligning the red rules.

assets.title: Gold scroll with three trefoils
assets.description: A burnished gold band winds in a serpentine from a large spiral at the left through two smaller loops to a jagged cut end at the right, each loop holding a gold three-lobed trefoil, with a short tendril dropping from the lower curve. Thin black contours edge the gold, which keeps the crackled texture of the leaf and a faint pale paper line along some edges; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The right end is cut where the scroll met the stroke of the letter S; use it as the trailing end of a flourish or tuck it under another element.

assets.title: Blue chevron inlay strip
assets.description: A narrow vertical strip of the painted inlay from the gold margin rod of the folio, a deep blue ground carrying a chain of cream opposed chevrons and short hooked bars drawn by hand in a loose zigzag, about three cycles tall. The painted edges are ragged and darken to black where the paint meets the gold of the rod; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite strip at the native size of the inlay; for a run of any length use blue-white-opposed-chevron-repeat, which is one cycle of this strip.
The pink strip of the same rod is pink-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain; the two alternate on the rod.

assets.title: Blue chevron inlay, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the blue painted inlay of the gold margin rod, cut so the top and bottom edges join when stacked. A deep blue ground carries one hand-drawn cream chevron pair with short hooked bars, the paint ragged along the two long edges and darkening to black at the rim; the thin margins outside the paint are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run. One cycle only, so the hand-drawn irregularity of the strip repeats every tile.
The frame atlas mirrors corner-top-left; the three other corner masters are the rotated phases for anyone composing a frame by hand with the chevrons running one way round.
The whole native strip is blue-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain; the pink tile of the same rod is pink-white-opposed-chevron-repeat.

assets.title: Taurus, brown bull
assets.description: The Taurus sign from the zodiac initial. A reddish-brown bull walks to the left in side view with its head raised and mouth open, two dark curved horns, a lighter muzzle and belly, dark hooves and a tail that curls up behind the hindquarters. Darker brown shading with white highlights and black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Scorpio, dark green scorpion
assets.description: The Scorpio sign from the zodiac initial, drawn as a dark green lizard-like creature rather than a bird. A plump body lies diagonally with a long tapering tail pointing to the upper left, two tufts of spiky legs on the underside and a small curled head with bristling appendages at the lower right. Dark green with gold-brown streaks and black shading; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.
The pointed end at the upper left is the tail, not a beak; the head is the small curled end at the lower right.

assets.title: Gemini, embracing twins
assets.description: The Gemini sign from the zodiac initial. Two fair-haired figures with curly gold hair sit side by side and embrace, the left one in a blue gown with a red belt looking up at the other, the right one in a brown-mauve gown with its arm round the first; their blue-clad legs stretch out together to the right. Cream faces and hands, black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Tree of life with red fruits
assets.description: A tall tree with a straight olive-brown trunk edged in gold that spreads into a flat base of short roots and branches into three rounded clumps of dark green foliage, one above the other two. Twelve round rust-red fruits hang among the leaves, each with a dark stalk, and the leaves carry pale grey highlights and flecks of gold where the paint has worn. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: The main miniature of the folio; the two margin rods of the same folio (upper-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r, lower-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r) frame it on the page.

assets.title: Leo, golden lion
assets.description: The Leo sign from the zodiac initial. A tawny gold lion walks to the left with its head turned towards the viewer, mouth open and red-tipped, its mane and flanks drawn in wavy darker strokes with white highlights; the long tail curls up over the back and ends in a leafy tuft above the hindquarters. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Libra, balance with two blue pans
assets.description: The Libra sign from the zodiac initial. A blue beam edged with white rests on a gold and blue two-legged post topped by a small bird-like finial with a pale head and a red-spotted body; from each end of the beam three gold cords hang a round blue pan with white highlights. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Gothic fountain of life
assets.description: The stone fountain from the Fountain of Life miniature, seen from slightly above. A grey-green octagonal basin on a stepped base carries an upper hexagonal basin and a central Gothic pavilion with pointed arches, crockets and a tall crocketed spire ending in a cross; two spouts in the upper basin and six spouts round the lower basin pour wavy white and blue jets of water down the sides. Gold highlights along the right edges, dark green shading; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Centrepiece of the miniature, flanked by left-dark-leafy-tree and right-dark-leafy-tree; the water jets end at the basin foot, so set it on a ground or a dark panel.

assets.title: Aries, grey ram
assets.description: The Aries sign from the zodiac initial. A grey-cream ram stands facing left in side view with its head lowered, two dark spiralling horns, a fleece drawn in curling brown strokes over a pale body and small dark hooves. Gold flecks over the fleece, white highlights and black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Capricorn, grey goat
assets.description: The Capricorn sign from the zodiac initial, drawn as an ordinary goat. A grey goat stands facing right in side view with two long dark horns sweeping back from its head, a small beard, a shaggy coat drawn in wavy white and dark grey strokes and dark cloven hooves. Gold flecks over the coat and black outlines; the background is transparent.
