usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Slender tree with grey fruits, left
assets.description: A tall slender tree from the Fountain of Life miniature. A dark olive-brown trunk with gold flecks curves up from a cut base at the lower left to a small crown of dark green lobed leaves at the top, with pale grey-white fruits hanging among the upper leaves and a few leaves scattered down the right side of the stem. Painted edges, no outline; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Stood to the left of the fountain in the miniature, with right-dark-leafy-tree on the other side; the trunk is cut flat at the base where it met the ground.

assets.title: Margin rod with foliate branch, lower, fol. 19v
assets.description: A bottom-left corner piece of the page border. A short vertical gold rod edged in pink ends above in a pink curl with gold trefoil leaves and a red flower, and below in a gold leaf cluster from which a long pink stem runs to the right along the bottom, throwing off gold trefoil ivy leaves, a blue and a pale green-white bell flower, two red flowers and fine black hairline curls. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the bottom-left of a page; upper-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-19v is its top-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the Fountain of Life miniature.

assets.title: Margin rod with foliate branch, lower, fol. 74r
assets.description: A bottom-left corner piece of the page border. A short vertical gold rod edged in pink ends above in a pink spiral with a gold trefoil leaf and a blue flower, and below in a gold leaf cluster from which a long pink stem runs to the right along the bottom, throwing off gold trefoil ivy leaves, red and blue flowers with white centres and fine black hairline curls. Black outlines throughout; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the bottom-left of a page; upper-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r is its top-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the tree of life.

assets.title: Margin rod with ivy spray, fol. 10r
assets.description: A bottom-left corner piece of the page border. A vertical gold rod edged in pink, with a blue and a pink chevron inlay set into it, ends above in a pink curl with a blue flower and gold trefoil leaves and below in a gold leaf cluster, from which a pink stem runs to the right along the bottom carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves, blue and rust-pink flowers and fine black hairline tendrils. The stem is cut at the top edge where it continued up the margin; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the bottom-left of a page with the rod up the left margin and the spray along the bottom; the rod's top is cut, so hide it or continue it with a drawn rule.
The two chevron inlays of the rod are also available as strips and repeat tiles (blue-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain, pink-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain).

assets.title: Margin rod with ivy spray, fol. 12r
assets.description: A bottom-left corner piece of the page border. A tall vertical gold rod edged in pink, with a pink chevron inlay set into its middle, ends above in a pink curl with a gold trefoil leaf and below in a gold leaf cluster from which a pink stem runs to the right along the bottom carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves, blue and red-orange flowers with white centres and fine black hairline tendrils; a small sprig with two gold buds hangs beside the rod. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the bottom-left of a page with the rod up the left margin and the spray along the bottom; upper-left-pink-ivy-flourish is its top-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the zodiac initial.
The chevron inlay of the rod is also available as a strip and a repeat tile (pink-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain, pink-white-opposed-chevron-repeat).

assets.title: Pisces, lower fish
assets.description: The lower fish of the Pisces pair from the zodiac initial. A long silver-grey fish swims to the left in side view with its mouth slightly open, a darker blue-grey back, white highlights along the belly and gold flecks; the dorsal, pectoral and pelvic fins and the forked tail are edged in red. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pisces is the pair; in the initial this fish swims below upper-silver-fish-with-red-fins, both heading left.
One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Oval night sky with stars and crescent
assets.description: A tall oval of deep blue sky with a rim of lighter blue brushstrokes following its edge. Three gold six-pointed stars sit in the upper left and upper right, a gold disc crossed by dark curved bands lies right of centre, and a dark worn crescent with its horns down sits at the bottom left. A fourth star and much of the lower half are abraded to a pale green-grey ground. Opaque inside the oval, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete painted field with its own ground; place it as a picture. The disc and the crescent are also cut out as worn-gold-curled-celestial-roundel and worn-gold-crescent-moon.

assets.title: Pink chevron inlay strip
assets.description: A narrow vertical strip of the painted inlay from the gold margin rod of the folio, a dusty pink-brown ground carrying a chain of pale cream opposed chevrons and short hooked bars drawn by hand in a loose zigzag, about three cycles tall. The painted edges are ragged and darken to black where the paint meets the gold of the rod; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite strip at the native size of the inlay; for a run of any length use pink-white-opposed-chevron-repeat, which is one cycle of this strip.
The blue strip of the same rod is blue-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain; the two alternate on the rod.

assets.title: Pink chevron inlay, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the pink painted inlay of the gold margin rod, cut so the top and bottom edges join when stacked. A dusty pink-brown ground carries one hand-drawn pale cream chevron pair with short hooked bars, the paint ragged along the two long edges and darkening to black at the rim; the thin margins outside the paint are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeats along y; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal run. One cycle only, so the hand-drawn irregularity of the strip repeats every tile.
The frame atlas mirrors corner-top-left; the three other corner masters are the rotated phases for anyone composing a frame by hand with the chevrons running one way round.
The whole native strip is pink-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain; the blue tile of the same rod is blue-white-opposed-chevron-repeat.

assets.title: Cancer, red crab
assets.description: The Cancer sign from the zodiac initial, drawn like a crayfish. A red-orange crustacean lies diagonally with its head and two black-dot eyes at the upper left, two large claws raised above it, four thin legs spread to the right and below, and a segmented tail curving down to the lower right. Dark red shading, gold flecks and black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.
The body runs on a diagonal from the lower right to the upper left; rotate about 45 degrees clockwise for an upright crab.

assets.title: Round bushy tree with grey fruits, right
assets.description: A round-headed tree from the Fountain of Life miniature. A dense dark green crown with a scalloped outline fills the upper two thirds, with brown branches, pale grey-white fruits and a few lighter leaves showing through it; two thin grey-brown trunks run down from the crown and cross near the cut base at the bottom. Painted edges, no outline; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Stood to the right of the fountain in the miniature, with left-dark-leafy-tree on the other side; the trunks are cut at the base where they met the ground.

assets.title: Small profile head facing right
assets.description: A tiny head in profile facing right, drawn in purple contours on a pale cream and grey ground with a rounded cap-like top, a long nose and a dark eye, isolated from a gilt roundel in the margin decoration. The paint is weathered and the contours soft. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Keep it small; the face only reads at thumbnail size and dissolves into pigment grain when enlarged.

assets.title: Sagittarius, hoofed archer
assets.description: The Sagittarius sign from the zodiac initial. A satyr-like archer with a bare pale human torso, curly gold hair and brown furred goat legs with black cloven hooves sits on his haunches facing left and draws a tall gold bow with both hands; a thin tail curls out behind him at the left. Pink shading on the skin, white highlights on the fur and black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Virgo, seated maiden with flowers
assets.description: The Virgo sign from the zodiac initial. A young woman with gold hair sits on the ground in a long brown gown whose folds spread to the lower right, her body turned to the right and her head tilted back towards the viewer; her raised right hand holds a thin stem with a gold flower and a second gold-flowered sprig rises from her lap. Pale face and hands with pink shading, white highlights on the gown and black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Seven-pointed gold star
assets.description: A small hand-painted gold star with seven uneven rays of different lengths radiating from a lumpy centre, the gold speckled with dark pits where it has worn. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: A loose star from the folio, not one of the three six-pointed stars inside oval-celestial-scene-with-stars-and-crescent; scatter it over a dark ground.

assets.title: Dark crescent moon, horns down
assets.description: A crescent moon lying like an arch with both horns pointing down, cut from the bottom of the oval night sky of the folio. Its paint is a dark, tarnished green-black with a streak of dull gold along the inner left limb and traces of the blue ground at the rim. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from oval-celestial-scene-with-stars-and-crescent in its original orientation; rotate it for a horns-up moon.

assets.title: Two gold leaves on a crossed stem
assets.description: A tall narrow sprig in black pen with two pointed gold leaves outlined in black, one at the top and one at the bottom, joined by a thin stem that crosses itself in a loose knot at the middle and throws out short curls; a hooked tendril closes each end. The gold is worn and dull. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Vertical by design, about two and a quarter times taller than wide; it works as a slender column divider beside text.

assets.title: Ivy sprig with blue and rust flowers
assets.description: A sprig of three flowers on a dark green-black stem that curls in a loop at the centre and ends in fine hairline tendrils. A blue flower with white highlights sits at the upper left, a second blue one hangs at the bottom, and a rust-orange flower with a dark red bud opens to the right; all are outlined in near-black. The paint is worn, with pale parchment showing through the petals. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: From the upper margin of the folio whose left and lower margins are lower-left-rod-with-ivy-flourish-10r; it reads as a loose spray and needs no stem to attach to.

assets.title: Margin rod with foliate branch, upper, fol. 19v
assets.description: A top-left corner piece of the page border. A tall vertical gold rod edged in pink, with a pink chevron inlay set into its middle, ends below in a pink spiral holding a gold trefoil leaf, with a red flower and gold leaves beside it; at the top a gold leaf cluster sends a pink stem to the right along the top edge carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves, red and blue bell flowers and fine black hairline curls, and a small sprig with two gold buds hangs beside the rod. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the top-left of a page; lower-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-19v is its bottom-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the Fountain of Life miniature.
The chevron inlay of the rod is also available as a strip and a repeat tile (pink-inlay-with-white-opposed-chevron-chain, pink-white-opposed-chevron-repeat).

assets.title: Margin rod with foliate branch, upper, fol. 74r
assets.description: A top-left corner piece of the page border. A tall vertical gold rod edged in pink, with a pink chevron inlay set into its middle, ends below in a pink curl with a gold trefoil and a red flower; at the top a gold leaf cluster sends a pink stem to the right along the top edge carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves, red and blue flowers with white centres and fine black hairline curls, and a small sprig with two gold buds hangs beside the rod. Black outlines throughout; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the top-left of a page; lower-gold-rod-with-foliate-branch-74r is its bottom-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the tree of life.

assets.title: Curled ivy stem with gold trefoils
assets.description: A thick grey-pink stem edged in white curls into a spiral at the lower centre and sends branches up and to the left, each ending in a gold trefoil ivy leaf with a white centre; a blue three-lobed flower with white highlights sits inside the spiral and a cluster of gold leaves closes its tail at the lower left. Fine grey hairline tendrils trail from the leaves. The paint is worn, with parchment showing through the gold. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: From the upper-left margin of the folio whose rod is lower-left-rod-with-ivy-flourish-10r; the cut stem at the upper right is where it joined the rod.

assets.title: Ivy spray corner, upper left, fol. 12r
assets.description: A top-left corner piece of the page border without a rod. A pink stem edged in white rises from a spiral at the lower left, where a gold trefoil leaf and a blue flower sit inside the curl, bends over and runs to the right along the top carrying gold trefoil ivy leaves with white centres, two blue and two red-orange bell flowers and fine black hairline tendrils; a second small spiral with a gold leaf closes the stem at the bottom. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Sits at the top-left of a page with the spray along the top edge; lower-left-rod-with-ivy-flourish-12r is its bottom-left partner from the same folio, where the two frame the zodiac initial.

assets.title: Pisces, upper fish
assets.description: The upper fish of the Pisces pair from the zodiac initial. A long fish swims to the left in side view, its back dark blue-grey and its belly silver-grey with white highlights and gold flecks; the dorsal fin, pectoral and pelvic fins and the forked tail are edged in red. Black outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pisces is the pair; in the initial this fish swims above lower-silver-fish-with-red-fins, both heading left.
One of eleven zodiac signs cut from the same initial; they share a scale and were painted on a gold ground, so they sit well on a gold or dark panel.

assets.title: Gold disc with curved bands
assets.description: A roughly circular gold disc crossed by five dark curved bands that sweep from the upper left like the ribs of a shell, cut from the oval night sky of the folio. The gilding is worn, with the dark blue ground showing through across the lower half and the edge ragged. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from oval-celestial-scene-with-stars-and-crescent; it carries traces of the blue ground, so it reads best on a dark background.

assets.title: Angel bust with a small gold instrument
assets.description: Half-length angel turned to the right, in a mauve-pink mantle with gold highlights over a green gown, a pale green veil over the hair and a dark blue, gold-flecked wing behind. The left hand cradles a small rounded gold instrument bound with an orange strap, raised towards the mouth; the right hand is lifted beside it with the fingers at the mouth. The figure ends at the painted hem of the mantle, as much as was visible in the miniature. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Only the upper body was visible in the miniature; place it behind another element or at a lower edge so the missing lower half is not noticed.

assets.title: Angel bust with trumpets behind
assets.description: Half-length angel in a green gown with a white collar, blond hair, the head turned slightly to the left and both hands joined in prayer at the chest; pinkish, gold-streaked wings rise behind the shoulders. Two red and gold trumpets stand up behind the figure, one long and leaning to the upper left, the other a short bell at the upper right; neither is held by this figure's hands. The lower body is cut flat across the chest where it was hidden in the source. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Only the upper body survives from the miniature; place it behind another element or at a lower edge so the flat cut is hidden.

assets.title: Four-sided floral page margin, fol. 285r
assets.description: Page margin surrounding a transparent text area on all four sides. The wide right column grows from blue and orange acanthus, with a green stem of strawberry plants bearing red fruit and pink flowers; the bottom strip has a grey-blue urn of orange flowers at the centre between blue and pink acanthus; the top and left sides are thin gold ivy sprigs with blue and red buds, broken into short pieces where the text and miniature stood. Gold ivy leaves on fine black stems fill the ground throughout. Transparent inside and outside the border.
usage_notes: The top and left sides are fragmentary sprigs, so the frame reads best with content set in the open interior and the right column and bottom strip kept whole.
The three figures of fol. 285r stood inside this margin in the source.

assets.title: Four-sided floral page margin, fol. 291v
assets.description: Page margin surrounding a transparent text area on all four sides. The wide left column has blue and orange acanthus at the top and bottom, with a green stem of red and pink flowers and blue flowers with yellow centres growing from a grey-blue urn at mid-height; the bottom strip has blue and orange acanthus at both ends with pink flowers between; the top and right sides are thin gold ivy sprigs with blue and red buds, the right side broken into two pieces. Gold ivy leaves on fine black stems fill the ground throughout. Transparent inside and outside the border.
usage_notes: The top and right sides are fragmentary sprigs, so the frame reads best with content set in the open interior and the left column and bottom strip kept whole.
Saint Margaret and the two angel busts of fol. 291v stood inside this margin in the source.

assets.title: Green-robed angel playing a lute
assets.description: Full-length angel standing turned to the right, in a long green gown with gold-lined cuffs and hem and a white collar, blond hair, and tall wings of blue, red and pink rising behind the head. Both hands hold a gold lute across the body, its rounded back towards the viewer and the neck pointing right, the right hand plucking the strings. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with right-blue-robed-angel-with-lute, which faces left at the same scale; in the source they flank Saint Adrian.

assets.title: Left and lower floral page margin, fol. 276v
assets.description: L-shaped page margin running down the left side and along the bottom. The left column holds blue and orange acanthus at the top and bottom with a green stem of pink carnation-like flowers, a blue flower, red and pink strawberries and green leaves between them; the bottom strip has blue and pink acanthus at both ends with an orange flower and a pink thistle between. Gold ivy leaves and tendrils on fine black stems fill the ground. Transparent, with the open interior above and to the right.
usage_notes: Use as a bottom-left corner piece with content set in the open area above and to the right of it.
The Salvator Mundi and the two blue-robed angels of fol. 276v stood inside this margin in the source.

assets.title: Blue-robed angel playing a pipe
assets.description: Full-length angel turned to the right, kneeling or floating with the robe gathered below, in a long blue gown with gold-dotted collar, cuffs and hem over a white undercollar, blond hair, and one tall wing of red, blue and gold rising high to the left. Both hands hold a straight cream and gold pipe to the mouth, pointing down to the right. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with right-blue-robed-angel-with-harp, which faces left at the same scale; in the source they flank the Salvator Mundi.

assets.title: Blue-robed angel playing a harp
assets.description: Full-length angel turned to the left, in a long blue gown with gold-dotted collar and hem over a white undercollar, blond hair, and two tall narrow wings of grey-green, blue, red and gold rising high above the head. A gold harp with a curved neck stands in front of the figure and is plucked with both hands. The robe gathers below as if kneeling or floating. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with left-blue-robed-angel-musician, which faces right at the same scale; in the source they flank the Salvator Mundi.

assets.title: Blue-robed angel bowing a vielle
assets.description: Full-length angel standing with the head bowed to the left, in a long teal-blue gown with gold highlights, cuffs and hem and a white collar, blond hair, and wings of red, green and blue spread above the shoulders. The left hand holds a flat gold vielle (a medieval fiddle) with a round sound hole against the chest, its neck pointing up to the right, while the right hand draws a long bow across the strings. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with green-robed-angel-with-stringed-instrument, which faces right at the same scale; in the source they flank Saint Adrian.
The instrument is a bowed vielle, not a lute; the lute is played by the green-robed companion.

assets.title: Saint Adrian with sword, anvil and lion
assets.description: A standing man facing the viewer in a blue knee-length tunic trimmed with brown fur, green hose and black shoes, under a long mantle lined with white ermine and faced in pink with gold, fastened by a red jewelled brooch; he wears a white hat with a gold brim and a red jewel. The right hand raises a grey sword, the left holds a grey anvil on a block at shoulder height. A brown lion lies at his feet facing left. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: The lion is part of the cut-out and carries the figure's feet; keep them together.
In the source the lute- and vielle-playing angels of fol. 285r stand on either side of this figure.

assets.title: Saint Margaret rising from the dragon
assets.description: A haloed woman with long blond hair, in a blue mantle over a gold brocade gown, rises from the back of a pale yellow-green dragon and holds a gold cross-staff in her right hand. The dragon faces left with open jaws clutching the hem of her blue mantle, ribbed green wings, clawed feet and a curling tail at the right. Below, a low grey crenellated wall runs in from both sides over green grass with small white and red flowers. The wall is cut straight along the bottom and both outer edges; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The crenellated wall is the painted foreground of the miniature and is cut flat; set it on a baseline, or crop above the wall tops to keep only the saint and the dragon.

assets.title: Salvator Mundi with book and orb
assets.description: Christ standing facing the viewer in a long brown robe with gold hatching and a gold hem, long brown hair and beard, and a gold rayed halo behind the head. The right hand is raised in blessing; the left holds an open book with red lettering. The bare feet rest on a gold orb banded in green at the bottom. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: In the source the two blue-robed angels of fol. 276v play on either side of this figure.

assets.title: Winged eagle head, symbol of John
assets.description: The eagle of John from the canon table, a pale blue-grey eagle head in profile facing left with a hooked beak and a brown breast, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two pale blue wings with mauve tips spread to either side and droop below the halo. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

assets.title: Winged lion head, symbol of Mark
assets.description: The lion of Mark from the canon table, a frontal tan lion face with a curling orange mane, round eyes and a small muzzle, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two pale yellow-green wings spread upward to either side with white and green feather strokes. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

assets.title: Winged ox head, symbol of Luke
assets.description: The ox of Luke from the canon table, a frontal pale yellow ox head with two short gold horns, flared ears, dark brows and a long muzzle, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two dusty rose-mauve wings spread to either side and droop below the halo. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

assets.title: Winged man's head, symbol of Matthew
assets.description: The man of Matthew from the canon table, a rose-pink head turned three-quarter to the right with the eyes looking right, blond hair, and the top of a pink tunic at the neck, inside a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and a beaded dark border. Two gold wings with white feather strokes rise and spread to either side. The lower edge is cut straight where the sill of the canon table covered it. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four winged evangelist symbols of the canon table, all at the same scale; stand it on a rule or band to hide the cut lower edge.

assets.title: Evangelist Matthew writing at his lectern
assets.description: The Evangelist Matthew sits on a gold bench with a blue cushion, turned to the right, his head raised and eyes looking up. He wears a pale blue tunic under a mauve-red mantle, holds a pen in his left hand over a gold lectern on a blue-grey stand and raises a pale knife in his right, with a red book with an orange clasp under his arm. His halo is deep blue with a beaded white rim and his hair is red. His bare feet rest on a red footstool. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete seated figure with its furniture; on the page it sat between the columns of fixed-twisted-column-arcade-with-scalloped-arch, under winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book.

assets.title: Arcade with twisted columns and scalloped arch
assets.description: The architectural arcade of the Matthew portrait page, emptied of its figure. A red-brown semicircular arch with a white scalloped leaf pattern and a burnished gold inner band rests on a gold lintel painted with a row of small arches; two tall columns spiralled in red-brown and pale blue bands carry green acanthus capitals with orange leaves on blue-grey abaci and stand on orange bases over blue-grey and brown plinths. Open at the bottom. Only the paint is opaque; the inside of the arch and the surround are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, open at the bottom; scale it as a whole and place content between the columns. On the page it enclosed matthew-writing-at-lectern, with winged-haloed-angel-holding-closed-book above the lintel.
The small notch at the apex of the gold band is where the angel's wing overlapped the arch; place the angel there to cover it.

assets.title: Half-length angel holding a closed book
assets.description: A half-length angel, the symbol of Matthew, seen to the waist with the head turned three-quarter to the left and the eyes looking left. Blond hair under a burnished gold halo with an orange rim and beaded border; a green mantle over a pale blue tunic; two long gold wings with mauve-red upper coverts spread to either side. Both hands hold a closed book with a gold cover dotted in red. Cut straight at the waist where the lintel of the arcade covered it; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Ends at the waist, so stand it on an edge or behind a band; on the page it rose above the lintel of fixed-twisted-column-arcade-with-scalloped-arch, its right wing crossing the apex of the arch.

assets.title: Taurus, the bull
assets.description: The bull of the zodiac wheel, drawn in brown ink over a pale tan, parchment-toned body. It lunges diagonally down to the left with its head lowered and short horns forward, the forelegs folded under the chest, the hind legs stretched up to the right and the tail curling over the rump; a small red fleck marks one hoof. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Sagittarius, the centaur archer
assets.description: The centaur archer of the zodiac wheel, a pale tan horse body with a green-faced human torso, galloping to the left while drawing a bow with the arrow pointed left. The mane and tail are streaked brown with a red tip, the hooves are dark, and the outlines are brown ink over parchment tone. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Cancer, the crab
assets.description: The crab of the zodiac wheel seen from above, a pale tan oval body with a dotted brown spine, a small round head with two scroll-shaped eyes at the top and four pairs of forked legs curling upward on either side; the body tapers to a pointed tail at the bottom. Brown ink with faint green traces along the legs. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Libra, seated figure with scales
assets.description: The Libra figure of the zodiac wheel, a seated person in a long pale robe with short curly hair, turned to the right with both arms extended to hold a balance whose beam tilts upward and carries a hanging pan at each end; one bare foot shows below the hem. Brown ink over parchment tone with light green shading. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Capricorn, goat with fish tail
assets.description: The Capricorn of the zodiac wheel, a goat with long curved horns, a bearded head and raised forelegs facing right, whose body ends at the left in a coiled fish tail with a mask-like knob at the tip. The body is tan with brown ink, the tail and belly are washed green, and a red band circles one foreleg. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Leo, the lion
assets.description: The lion of the zodiac wheel striding to the right with its mouth open, a shaggy mane, a long tail that curls up over the back and ends in a tuft, and four clawed paws. The body is pale tan parchment tone outlined in brown ink, and it leans slightly as it sat on the wheel. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Gemini, twin soldiers with one shield
assets.description: The twins of the zodiac wheel as two soldiers in mail coifs and knee-length hauberks standing with a tall kite-shaped shield between them; the left one raises a sword with a red-tipped hilt, the right one holds a mace. Brown ink over parchment tone with a small red mark on the shield. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Aries, the ram
assets.description: The ram of the zodiac wheel facing left with a large spiral horn, a shaggy fleece drawn in flame-like brown strokes along the neck and back, cloven hooves and a tail curling down at the right. Pale tan parchment tone outlined in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Red quatrefoil from the wind wheel
assets.description: A single red quatrefoil, four rounded lobes around a square centre, painted with a soft uneven brush edge and slightly darker at the top lobe. One of the fillers painted on the green ring between the roundels of the wind wheel. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Small motif; it repeats well as a bullet or a filler between items. Each quatrefoil on the wheel is hand-painted and differs slightly; only this one is cut out.

assets.title: Aquarius, water bearer with jar
assets.description: The water bearer of the zodiac wheel, a figure in a green pleated robe striding to the right with a large round green jar raised at shoulder height, from which a wavy tan stream of water pours out to the right. Brown hair, bare feet and brown ink outlines. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Virgo, woman with outstretched arms
assets.description: The Virgo figure of the zodiac wheel, a woman in a long flowing olive-tan robe whose skirt spreads to the left, with both arms stretched out and her head turned to the right; the hands and hem carry touches of green. Brown ink over worn parchment tone. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Pisces, two linked fish
assets.description: The two fish of the zodiac wheel, one above the other and swimming in opposite directions, the upper fish heading right and the lower heading left. Both are mottled green over tan with brown fins, and a long brown cord runs from the mouth of the upper fish in a loop to the mouth of the lower one. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Rota of the winds with twelve heads
assets.description: The complete wind diagram of the folio, a wheel whose broad green outer ring holds twelve roundels, each with a pale profile head blowing a green ray of breath toward the centre, with red quatrefoils between the roundels. Inscriptions in brown and red fill the ring and run along twelve red-ruled spokes from a small central disc through two inner concentric rings. The blank parchment inside the rings and outside the wheel is transparent.
usage_notes: The inscriptions, spokes and rings are part of the diagram and are kept; for a single blowing head use the wind-head assets, which are cut from this master and turned upright.
Blank parchment is transparent, so the counters of the lettering show whatever sits behind the wheel; it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Wind head 1, 12 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 12 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Long hair streaked brown and green falls behind the head to the shoulder, the ear shows, the open mouth holds a green tongue of breath, the cheek and forehead carry red patches, and a long neck with a hint of collar runs to the bottom. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 2, 1 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 1 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. A round head with hair combed back in brown strokes, a large ear, an open mouth with a green puff of breath and a red cheek; the back of the head and the chin follow the circle of the roundel. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 3, 2 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 2 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair in long brown strokes with red streaks, red lips around a green ray of breath blown to the right, a red cheek and a small crescent of neck below. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 4, 3 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 3 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Long straight hair in brown strokes, an ear, a green ray of breath blown out to the right, a red cheek, and a long chin and neck; the master is cropped flush at the left. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 5, 4 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 4 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. The head tips forward so the face looks down to the right, the hair carries green strokes, a green blot of breath sits at the mouth, the cheek is red, and a wide crescent of bare neck fills the lower left. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 6, 5 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 5 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair streaked brown, green and orange, a stubby nose, green breath at the open mouth, an orange cheek and a crescent of neck below. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 7, 6 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 6 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair in green and brown strokes, an ear, a long green ray of breath blown to the right, a red cheek and a rounded chin. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 8, 7 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 7 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair in red and brown strokes, a greyish-brown smudge on the cheek, green breath at the mouth and a crescent of neck below. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 9, 8 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 8 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. A tall narrow head with green-streaked hair and no ear shown, green breath at the mouth, a pink cheek and a crescent of neck below. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 10, 9 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 9 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. A compact head with hair in brown, green and orange strokes, a prominent ear, green breath at the mouth and a pink cheek; the smallest of the twelve. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 11, 10 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 10 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. Hair in brown, green and orange bands, a red patch on the forehead, red lips with a broad green ray of breath blown to the right, a pink cheek and the neck at the bottom. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Wind head 12, 11 o'clock
assets.description: The profile head from the roundel at the 11 o'clock position of the wind rota, facing right with the mouth open and blowing. The head tilts down so the face looks to the lower right, hair in brown strokes with green, an ear, a green ray of breath blown down to the right, a red dot on the cheek and a crescent of neck at the left. Pale parchment-toned face drawn in brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Cut from the wind diagram of fol. 1v and turned upright to face right; in the rota the twelve heads face the centre. All twelve are at the same scale.

assets.title: Scorpio, winged creature with two necks
assets.description: The creature standing for Scorpio on the zodiac wheel, a winged beast with two long necks rising from a feathered body, one ending in a beaked head at the top and the other looping down to the left; the broad wing spreads to the right and the tail ends in a red band and a cross-hatched tip. Tan parchment tone with brown ink. Transparent background.
usage_notes: One of the twelve signs cut from the zodiac wheel of fol. 1r, all at the same scale, so they can be set in a ring or a row together.

assets.title: Ape climbing a leafy stalk
assets.description: A brown ape stands on its hind legs facing right and grips a red stalk with both hands. The stalk carries a red trefoil leaf and a white leaf at the top, a pink leaf at mid height and a rose-red leaf curling at its foot, with a small red bud at the hands of the ape. Dark outlines, white hatching on the fur; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Hung from the upper sprig of foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border in the source; it stands alone as a figure.

assets.title: Ape jousting on a ram
assets.description: A brown ape rides bareback on a leaping shaggy ram with curled gold horns, facing left. It levels a red lance with a three-pronged tip to the left and holds a pale shield charged with a black lion rampant. The ram's cream fleece is marked with dark curling strokes, and everything is drawn with a black outline. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Charges to the left; jousting-ape-with-shield-and-lance charges to the right, and the two face each other in the lower margin with the trumpeter beside them.

assets.title: Ape riding a unicorn, bitten by a hound
assets.description: A brown ape sits astride a grey, shaggy, long-necked mount running to the left and raises a gold sword over its head with both hands; a cream hound behind bites the mount on the rump, where red marks show. The Walters record calls the mount a unicorn; no horn is visible. Dark outlines over grey, tan and cream washes; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Stood on the bottom stem of foliate-left-and-bottom-margin-border in the source, filling one of its gaps.

assets.title: Haloed apostle with inscribed scroll
assets.description: Bust of a grey-haired, bearded apostle with an orange-red halo, cut from the initial. He faces slightly to the right, wrapped in a grey-green mantle over an orange-red robe, and holds across his chest a pale scroll bearing a line of pseudo-inscription. Flecks of the gold ground remain along the halo and the right edge, and the right end of the scroll is ragged. Transparent background.

assets.title: Long blue and rose line filler with three gold discs
assets.description: A long horizontal line filler in two fields between thin white rules: the left third deep blue with three burnished gold discs and a white X cross, the right two thirds dusty rose with white X crosses alternating with small white rings. Dark outline, slightly ragged ends; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Blue line filler with two gold roundels
assets.description: A long blue painted bar pointed at both ends, with two gold roundels at the left end, a white wavy line along the upper half, a row of short white hatch strokes and a long white rule along the lower half, and a curled white terminal at the right. The paint is grainy and the edge of the bar is uneven. Transparent background.

assets.title: Blue line filler with gold disc and crossed strokes
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler on a deep blue ground between thin white rules: a burnished gold disc at the left end, then two white X crosses with small ticks beside them. The blue field has a dark outline and slightly ragged, hand-cut ends; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Crouching ape reaching forward
assets.description: A brown ape kneels low with its back arched, facing right, both arms stretched forward with open hands. Its belly and rump are pale cream and its head bald, drawn with a heavy black outline and fine white highlights. Transparent background.
usage_notes: From the same margin as mitred-owl-and-ape-with-shared-staff; it reaches towards that pair on the page.

assets.title: Crouching hare
assets.description: A grey-green hare crouches facing left with its long ears laid back along its neck, a dotted line down its spine, its forelegs tucked under and its hind legs bent, and a small round tail at the right. Dark green outline over a pale wash, transparent background.

assets.title: Crouching unicorn
assets.description: A grey-green unicorn lies low with its body stretched to the right and its head turned to the left, a long gold horn pointing left, a black bristling mane, folded forelegs, extended hind legs and a tail curling down at the right. Black outline with pale highlights. Transparent background.

assets.title: King David striking bells with two hammers
assets.description: A crowned, bearded king in a blue mantle over a rose-brown tunic sits on a cream bench with green arcading and gold leaf finials, turned to the right, and swings two green hammers at four blue bells hung from an orange rod above him. Gold crown, worn gilding on the bells, dark outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The bells and their rod belong to the figure; keep the whole group together.

assets.title: King David pointing to his eye, holding a book
assets.description: A crowned, bearded King David in a blue robe over a grey-mauve mantle lined with green stands facing left, his right hand raised to point at his eye and his left hand holding a green book. An orange drapery with white dots hangs at the left and grey shoes show below. Gold crown, dark outlines; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Faces haloed-god-with-orb-pointing-from-clouds in the same initial; place God to its left.

assets.title: Falconer with hawk above a vine
assets.description: A standing man with curly hair, in a long grey-brown gown with a gold hood thrown back on his shoulders, turns his head to the left towards a grey long-tailed hawk with a red-brown head perched on his raised left hand. Beneath his feet a blue vine stem with orange and grey-green leaves curls downwards. The right edge of the gown is cut where the page was cropped. Transparent background.
usage_notes: The vine under the feet is kept as the figure stands on it; crop below the hem for the falconer alone.

assets.title: Blue line filler with four white loops
assets.description: A short blue painted bar with a white rule inset along each long edge, joined at the left end, and four white loop marks in a row along the middle. The ends are uneven and the paint grainy. Transparent background.

assets.title: Rose line filler with gold disc and double cross
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler on a dusty rose ground between thin white rules: a burnished gold disc with a dark rim at the left, then a white double cross of two upright bars with ticks and a small white mark. Dark outline with irregular ends; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Blue line filler with gold roundel and white wave
assets.description: A blue painted bar with a gold roundel at the left end, a white wavy line running the length of the middle and a white rule inset along each edge. Uneven ends and grainy paint. Transparent background.

assets.title: Rose line filler with two gold roundels and looped wave
assets.description: A long rose-brown painted bar with two gold roundels at the left end, a white looped wave running to the right end and a white rule inset along each edge, the whole edged in dark brown. Transparent background.

assets.title: Gold wave line filler with white zigzag, blue over rose
assets.description: A horizontal line filler split by a burnished gold wave into a deep blue upper field with a fine white zigzag and a dusty rose lower field, between thin white rules. Dark outline, ragged left end; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Gold wave line filler, dotted blue over rose
assets.description: A horizontal line filler divided by a burnished gold wave into a deep blue upper field scattered with white dots and a dusty rose lower field, between thin white rules. Dark outline, finite ends; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Rose line filler with two gold discs and white scroll
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler on a dusty rose ground between thin white rules: two burnished gold discs with dark rims at the left, a small white leaf mark between them and a white curling scroll stroke filling the right. Dark outline, the right end fading out; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Rose line filler with white zigzag and dots
assets.description: A short rose-brown painted bar with a white zigzag running its length, a white dot in each angle above and below, and a white rule inset along each edge, joined at the ends; a small red mark sits at the left end. Uneven edges and grainy paint. Transparent background.

assets.title: L-shaped margin border, left and bottom
assets.description: An L-shaped bar border for the left and bottom margins of a page. A thin blue and gold spine runs down the left, with a cluster of folded blue leaves on a gold ground a third of the way down in which two small animals, one red and one rose, curl in roundels; at the top the stem bends right to a sprig of red and white leaves. Along the bottom a thin brown stem runs right with an orange forked leaf, a gold knot and a dark terminal, broken by gaps; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Use as one piece at page scale; it has no repeat and no corner component to compose with.
The gaps in the bottom stem are where margin figures covered it in the source: ape-gripping-leafy-stalk hung from the upper sprig and ape-rider-and-interacting-hounds stood on the bottom stem.

assets.title: Blue and gold foliate margin border
assets.description: An L-shaped margin border running down the left and across the top of the page. At the top-left a bar of blue and burnished gold with serrated gold edges knots into a loop of curling blue leaves and a small brown leaf; from it a thin stem bows down the whole left side and ends in a fork of three leaves in grey-blue, brown and orange, while along the top a slender stem ends in a gold roundel and a brown leaf. Gaps where the initial and figures overlapped it are left open. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Place as a whole page corner with content inside the L; the long left stem and the top stem mark the text-block edges.
The apes, hound and hare of the same folio sit along this border on the page.

assets.title: Blue and rose line filler with foliate wave and four gold roundels
assets.description: A long painted bar, blue over its left two thirds and rose-brown over the right third, with a white waving stem carrying small trefoil leaf sprigs along its whole length and four gold roundels set in the blue part near the middle. Edged in dark paint and slightly tapered at the right. Transparent background.

assets.title: God blessing from above, bust with orb
assets.description: The bust of God from the top of an initial: a youthful face in grey-cream wash with rose cheeks inside a red cruciform halo, in a grey robe with orange-brown lining. The left hand points to the left and the right arm cradles a green-banded orb at the right. The lower edge is cut straight where the frame of the initial covered the figure; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Blesses praying-figure-emerging-from-undulating-water in the same initial; place it above the water, and give the cut lower edge a rule or frame to sit on.

assets.title: Rose line filler with gold disc and curled stroke
assets.description: A short horizontal line filler on a dusty rose ground between thin white rules: a burnished gold disc at the left and a white S-shaped stroke with pointed ends and a small white mark to its right. Dark outline with irregular ends; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Green-headed bird perched on an orange leaf
assets.description: A bird with a green head and green wing, cream breast and long grey tail faces left, perched on a small cluster of orange trefoil leaves from which a thin green stem curves down. Soft wash with a dark outline; the background is transparent.

assets.title: God pointing from clouds with orb
assets.description: A haloed figure of God leans out of a bank of purple-brown and grey curled clouds edged with white, facing right: a youthful face in grey wash inside a red cruciform halo, a grey robe, a cross-marked orb held in the left hand and the right hand pointing to the right. The lower right is cut straight along an orange strip where the frame of the initial covered the figure; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Faces crowned-david-with-book-pointing-to-eye in the same initial; place David to its right.

assets.title: Hound seizing a running hare
assets.description: A grey hare runs to the left with its long ears laid back, and a cream hound close behind bites its back, where red marks show. Both animals are in profile facing left, drawn with dark outlines over soft grey and cream washes; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Hound biting a leaping deer-like beast
assets.description: A cream hound with a red collar bites the rump of a grey-brown, long-eared beast leaping up to the right, its head turned forward and forelegs raised; the tail of the hound curls back at the left. The Walters record calls the quarry a unicorn, but no horn is visible. Dark outlines over cream and grey washes; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: running-spotted-hound is the second dog of the same chase; it runs in from the left.

assets.title: Human-headed fleecy beast with gold spiral horn
assets.description: A crouching hybrid faces left: a human face in profile looking down, a fleecy blue-grey curly coat, a large gold spiral horn above the head, four pale legs stretched out flat and a gold tuft on the rump. Dark outlines over blue and grey wash; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Hunter spearing a boar
assets.description: A bareheaded hunter with curly fair hair, in a red-orange tunic and green hose, strides to the right and drives a long spear into a grey boar lying on its back with its legs in the air. Red strokes of blood spurt above and below the wound. Black outlines, transparent background.

assets.title: Jousting ape with cross shield
assets.description: A tan ape sits with its legs crossed, facing right, holding an orange shield charged with a black cross against its chest and levelling a long red lance with a three-pronged tip to the right. Black outline with pale highlights. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Charges to the right; ape-jouster-riding-ram charges to the left, and the two face each other in the lower margin with the trumpeter beside them.

assets.title: Long-beaked bird hybrid with human-faced tail
assets.description: A grey-green bird-like creature faces left with a long open beak showing teeth, a long neck dotted with white, two orange feathered wings, one raised and one spread back, and orange legs; its tail ends in a bearded human face in profile looking right, trailing wavy flame-like wisps. Dark outlines over flat colour; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Tall brown vine bar with coloured leaves
assets.description: A tall vertical margin vine on a thin brown stem: a pointed brown leaf curls at the top over a brown bud, the stem runs down with small thorns, then carries a blue leaf and a green bud, a yellow-green leaf and grey-blue leaves lower down, and ends in a small gold knob. Painted interiors are opaque and the loops of the stem open; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Vertical bar for a side margin; it does not repeat. The figure that sat beside it in the source is orange-robed-human-headed-winged-figure.

assets.title: Man carrying a horse on his shoulders
assets.description: A curly-haired man in an orange tunic and grey hose strides to the right with bare feet apart, carrying a tan horse across his shoulders with both hands; the head of the horse hangs down at the left, its tail flies out at the right, and the man looks back toward its head. Dark outlines, flat colour; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Striding man with grey bundle and green sprig
assets.description: A bald man with a fringe of hair, in a grey tunic with orange lining and bare legs, strides to the left. His right arm hooks over a grey basin-shaped bundle hanging in front of him, orange lining showing beneath, and his left hand holds out a green sprig of leaves. Dark outlines, grainy cream and grey wash; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Man in a basket of eggs
assets.description: A man in a grey-brown hooded robe sits in a woven basket full of pale eggs and looks out towards the viewer, his right hand raised and holding thin red cords. The cords hang from a gold disc with a sketched face under a scalloped grey-blue cap, which floats above him at the left. Soft dark outlines and muted colours on a transparent background.

assets.title: Merman with a spoon
assets.description: A merman swims to the right. His bare-headed human upper body wears an orange tunic and his long scaled grey-green fish tail trails away to the left; both arms reach forward holding a long-handled spoon with a round bowl. An orange-edged stroke crossing the bowl, the bill of the stork he feeds on the page, is cut at both ends, and the top of his head is clipped. Transparent background.

assets.title: Mitred owl and ape holding a staff
assets.description: A brown owl wearing a tall white mitre dotted with blue stands at the left facing the viewer, one foot gripping a long blue staff; at the right a brown ape stands in profile facing left and holds the top of the same staff with both hands. Black outlines with pale highlights, transparent background.
usage_notes: The two figures share one staff and are kept together; crouching-ape-with-outstretched-hands belongs to the same margin scene.

assets.title: Trumpeter in a pointed blue hat with green staff
assets.description: A standing young man faces left and blows a short gold horn held in his right hand. He wears a pointed blue hat with white dots, an orange tunic under a rose-brown shoulder cape, cream hose and bare feet, and carries a green leafy staff over his left shoulder. Dark outlines, soft colour; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Winged hybrid in an orange robe holding a gold object
assets.description: A tall hybrid faces right: a curly-haired human head on a long orange robe that tapers to a point below, a tall green feathered wing rising above, a grey draped wing or cloth hanging at the left, and two hands holding a small gold object at the right. Dark outlines, soft wash; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Rose and blue line filler with two gold discs and foliate wave
assets.description: A horizontal line filler in two fields between thin white rules: the left third dusty rose with two burnished gold discs in dark rims and a white leaf mark between them, the right two thirds deep blue with a white wavy vine throwing off small leaf sprigs. Dark outline; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Finite line filler with its painted end caps; place it whole, do not stretch or repeat it.

assets.title: Blue and rose line filler with two gold roundels and dotted waves
assets.description: A painted bar, blue over the left half with two gold roundels at its end and rose-brown over the right half, with a white wave and a white dot in each bend running the whole length and a white rule inset along each edge. Uneven edges and grainy paint. Transparent background.

assets.title: David praying in the water
assets.description: A figure rises from a half-disc of green water: the head at the left, tipped back and looking up with closed eyes, the hands joined in prayer above the surface, and the body showing through dark wavy lines of water. The flat top edge of the water is where the frame of the initial met it; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-bust-with-orb-and-raised-hand, the God who blesses him in the same initial; place God above the water.

assets.title: Reclining man in green holding a cross-marked disc
assets.description: A man in a long grey-green robe and green cap lies stretched out to the right, propped on a cream rectangular object hatched with green bands, and holds up a round cream disc marked with a cross in his left hand; green hose and blue shoes at the right. The top of the head is cut straight at the page edge; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Running hound with green collar
assets.description: A grey-brown hound with a long narrow snout, pricked ears and a green collar runs to the left, its forelegs stretched out, its hind legs trailing and its tufted tail raised. Drawn with a heavy black outline over a thin grey-brown wash. Transparent background.

assets.title: Low-running hound with green collar
assets.description: A pale grey-green hound with a long muzzle, a red nose, folded ears and a green collar runs low to the left, forelegs and hind legs stretched flat and its tail curling up over its back. Dark green outline over a thin wash, transparent background.

assets.title: Running hound, cream with black patches
assets.description: A cream hound with black patches and a red collar runs to the right, forelegs stretched forward, hind legs trailing and tail curled up over its back. Dark outline; the body has a grainy, mottled texture; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Runs toward hound-seizing-long-eared-animal in the same margin chase; place it to the left.

assets.title: Rose and blue line filler with gold roundel and looped wave
assets.description: A painted bar, rose-brown over the left third with a single gold roundel at its end and blue over the right two thirds, with a white looped wave running the whole length and a white rule inset along each edge. Uneven ends. Transparent background.

assets.title: Ape archer drawing a bow
assets.description: A grey-brown ape stands upright facing left and draws a long red and black bow, the gold-headed arrow pointing to the left. Its belly and rump are pale and the outline dark green; the feet are slightly ragged along the bottom edge. Transparent background.

assets.title: Ape raising a gold rod
assets.description: A grey-green ape stands upright in profile facing left with its head tilted back, gripping with both raised hands a long gold rod that widens to a flat head at the top right. Its legs are long and bent. The top of the rod and the toes of the rear foot are cut where the margin border and the page crop overlapped them. Dark outline, transparent background.

assets.title: Ape blowing a trumpet
assets.description: A brown ape stands upright in profile facing left, one hand on its hip, and blows a long straight orange trumpet with a flared bell rimmed in gold, held up to the left. Black outline with fine white highlights, transparent background.
usage_notes: Heralds the two jousting apes of the same margin, ape-jouster-riding-ram and jousting-ape-with-shield-and-lance.

assets.title: Blue and rose line filler with three gold roundels and zigzag
assets.description: A long painted bar, blue over the left half with three gold roundels at its end and rose-brown over the right half, with a fine white wavy zigzag running the whole length between a white rule inset along each edge. The bar tapers slightly to the right and its ends are uneven. Transparent background.

assets.title: White wave on blue, repeat tile with corner
assets.description: One cycle of a painted bar border: a white S-curling wave between two thin white rules on a deep blue ground, the pattern continuing across the left and right edges. The top and bottom edges are the ragged painted edges of the band itself, with a dark rim, and everything beyond them is transparent. A matching top-left corner component turns the rules around the angle with one curl inside.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a horizontal band, or use the generated rotated tile for a vertical one; the cycle is shorter than the band is thick, so it is a one-motif tile rather than a strip.
The frame atlas composes the tile with the top-left corner mirrored to the other three corners; use it with border-image and round fitting.

assets.title: Looped white wave on rose, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a rose-brown painted band, a white looped wave stroke between a white rule inset along each edge and a dark painted edge beyond. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; transparent beyond the band.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: White droplet loop on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a blue painted band, a single white droplet-shaped loop with a short tail between a white rule inset along each edge. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; transparent beyond the band.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: White foliate wave on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a blue painted band with a white waving stem that throws a trefoil leaf sprig into each bend, above and below. The band's bounding rules are left out so the tile is the inner pattern only. The pattern continues across the left and right edges, with a thin transparent strip above and below.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: White foliate wave on rose, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a rose-brown painted band with a white waving stem that throws a trefoil leaf sprig into each bend, above and below, and a dark painted edge along the bottom. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; transparent beyond the band.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: Looped white wave on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a blue painted band, a white S-shaped looped wave between a white rule inset along each edge and a dark painted edge beyond. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; transparent beyond the band.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: White wave with dots on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of a blue painted band, a white wave with a white dot in the bend above and in the bend below, between a white rule inset along each edge and a dark painted edge beyond. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; transparent beyond the band.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: White zigzag with dots on rose, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the inner field of a rose-brown painted band, a white zigzag with a white dot in the angle above and below. The band's bounding rules and outer edge are left out, so the cell is the pattern field alone. The pattern continues across the left and right edges.
usage_notes: Repeat along x for a band of any length. The frame atlas is built from corner-top-left and mirrors it; the other three corners are kept for hand-made layouts.

assets.title: Corner rod with a hooded head at the top
assets.description: An L-shaped piece of bar border. A thin tan and gold rod with a pink inner band and white dots rises from a lower-left knot and carries at its top a human head in a pale green hood, the face turned to the right. At the foot the rod meets a pink and blue angular knot with a white curl and a gold boss, from which a short horizontal bar of blue, white and gold runs to the right and ends in a gold leaf tip. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Bottom-left corner of a block; the long arm runs up the left edge and the short arm along the bottom.

assets.title: Dog dancing on its hind legs
assets.description: A pale grey-green dog rears up on its hind legs facing left, forelegs raised and bent in front of its chest, mouth open and ears back, its long tail curving out to the right and ending in a hooked tip. Heavy black contours with grey-blue shading on a cream-grey body; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Dances to the harp of seated-harp-player; placed to the right of the player the two face each other.

assets.title: Left-margin rod with two profile heads
assets.description: A tall vertical bar from the left margin. The upper half is a blue band with a row of white rings beside a pink band with a white wavy line; at mid-height a gold disc sits on the left edge where the bar narrows into a thin blue rod with a white zigzag. A bald head in profile faces right at the top, and the rod curves right at the bottom into a second profile head with a white cap band and a red cheek, also facing right. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Both heads look right, into the page; place it down the left edge of a block.

assets.title: Black pen-flourish with a leaf cluster
assets.description: A black ink flourish from the lower margin, a thin line sweeps down from the upper left, curves along the bottom and runs out to the right, carrying a cluster of small solid leaves at its centre and a knobbed terminal at the right end. The ink is grainy and slightly broken, as in the source. Black only; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Bottom-margin flourish of the fol. 52r border; reads best under a block, with right-black-leaf-curl-on-blue-and-gold-stem rising at its right.

assets.title: Long margin rod ending in a hooded profile head
assets.description: A tall vertical bar. For two thirds of its height it is a wide band of gold, pink with a white wavy line, and blue with white edges, cut flat at the top. It then narrows through a blue and pink angular leaf knot with a white lobe into a thin blue rod that curves to the left at the bottom and ends in a human head in profile with a white hood, facing left. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The head hangs below the rod and looks left; use it down the right edge of a block, or flip it for the left.

assets.title: Two monkeys playing chess
assets.description: Two tan monkeys with hatched fur sit facing each other on either side of an upright gold chequered board painted on a black ground between them. The left monkey holds up a small gold chess piece in one hand; the right monkey rests a hand on the board. Both sit with bent legs and splayed feet, in heavy black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: One scene; the board is held between the two players and both hands overlap it, so do not crop it apart.

assets.title: Two monkeys singing at a lectern
assets.description: Two cream monkeys with hatched fur stand upright one behind the other at the left, mouths open in song, facing right towards a tall brown lectern. The front monkey stretches an arm to the open book on the slanted desk, whose pages show ruled lines of text; the lectern stands on a tall ochre-brown foot. Black contours; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Small orange trefoil flower
assets.description: A small orange flower of three rounded lobes, one pointing up and two to the sides, with a short stub of stem below. Each lobe is edged with a painted white outline and carries a white dot or stroke; a thin dark contour surrounds the whole. The background is transparent.

assets.title: Black leaf scroll rising from a painted stem
assets.description: A painted stem of pink, blue and gold stripes runs diagonally from the lower left and ends in a blue and pink angular node, from which a thin black ink line climbs upward with small solid leaf blobs, loops once halfway up and ends in a hooked tip at the top. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Right end of the fol. 52r bottom bar; the flourish climbs the right edge of a block.

assets.title: Pointed blue and gold leaf swash
assets.description: A blue foliate swash rising from the lower left to the upper right, shaped like an angular leaf with a spiky pointed lobe at its right end. A gold stroke runs along its length, white lines and small white marks pick out the inner edges, and a thin black contour surrounds it. The left end is cut flat where it joined the decorated letter; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Seated harper in a gold tunic
assets.description: A man in a gold tunic and a white cap sits in profile facing right on a blue box-like bench and plays a tall triangular harp with an orange-red frame and white strings, one hand raised to the top of the frame, the other plucking the strings. Brown hose, one foot hanging below the seat, black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with dancing-dog, which dances to this harp; set the dog at the right so the two face each other.

assets.title: Short striped bar end curling down
assets.description: A short horizontal segment of bar border running to the right and curling down at its right end. It is built of parallel stripes of gold, brown, blue and white inside a black contour, the gold leaf flaking in places; the left end is cut flat where it left the bar, showing blue and white. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Right-hand end piece for a horizontal rule; butt its cut left edge against a bar of similar thickness.

assets.title: Two monkeys dancing hand in hand
assets.description: Two cream monkeys dance leaning away from each other, joined by their clasped inner hands at the centre, each raising the outer arm with a closed fist. The left monkey has hatched fur and faces right; the right one is smooth and faces left; both stand on bent legs with splayed feet. Black contours with light tan shading; the background is transparent.

assets.title: Top-margin bar with a crawling hybrid and three heads
assets.description: A long horizontal bar from the top margin. At the left it ends in a blue angular foliate knot with orange-tipped lobes and a gold disc; the bar runs right as a blue band with a white line, a pink band with white dots and a thin gold rule, then thins into a plain rod. On the right half a blue four-legged hybrid with a human head crawls to the right, a small bald grotesque head sits on the rod, and the bar ends in a larger head in a white hood. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Top side of the fol. 52r bar border; sits above a block with left-rod-with-two-profile-heads down its left edge.

assets.title: Woman driving a horse that drags a harrow
assets.description: A woman in an orange-red robe and white wimple walks at the right, facing left, and raises a long green switch over a cream horse that walks left in front of her. The horse wears a dark collar and harness lines that run back to a green triangular harrow with dark teeth, dragged along the ground at the far left by a short shaft. Black contours; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The harrow is a solid green panel with dark teeth; the thin harness lines between horse and harrow are intentionally kept, so crop around the whole group.

assets.title: Tall candelabrum panel with a seated satyr and a violin
assets.description: A very tall engraved candelabrum panel between thin vertical rules. From the bottom up, a bearded goat-legged satyr sits before a tasselled pedestal holding a violin and its bow; a blank cartouche between dolphins and trophies of arms; a large fluted urn with a bearded mask and cornucopias curling from its sides; two naked children embracing in a bower of acanthus and vine; a hanging cuirass with plumed helmet and shield; crossed staffs bound with a cord; and a lidded urn at the top among vine leaves and grapes. Dark brown-grey ink; the grey paper tone of the plate is kept at partial opacity.
usage_notes: Extremely tall (about 1:6.6); it works as a full-height side panel or margin filler. The engraved rules along both long edges are part of the master.
The tiers are stacked on one axis, so a crop of a single tier (the satyr base, the urn, the embracing children, the trophy of arms) stands on its own.
The plate area carries a faint grey paper tone, so it sits best on light grounds.

assets.title: Candelabrum panel with dragons, masks and instruments of war
assets.description: A tall symmetrical engraved candelabrum panel. A central shaft rises from a garlanded pedestal through a basket-weave bowl to a wide scale-patterned bowl at the top, where the plate edge cuts it. Two scaly dragons coil at the base; two winged sphinx-like creatures, one human-faced and one lion-headed, perch on the middle bowl facing each other; wheeled cannon jut out to both sides among a drum, a shield, a plumed helmet and a cuirass; two horned masks sprout acanthus at the top corners. Dark brown ink, the tan paper tone kept inside the forms, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall piece (about 1:2.2), symmetrical about the shaft; it reads well as a side panel or centred under a title.
The shaft is cut flat at the top edge of the plate, so place the top against a rule or the page edge, or crop to the lower tiers.
